instructions: Stand side ways to a pulley (you can also attach a theraband to a fixed point instead).
Hold the grip (or band) with the arm away from the pulley. Bring that arm by your side and bend it at 90°
Externally rotate the palm against the resistance. Your elbow should remain by your ribs throughout the movement
records.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 1

instructions: Stand on one end of a theraband with one foot and hold the loose end with your opposite hand.
Bring your elbow forward by 45° (at shouder) but maintain a 90° angle at elbow
Externally rotate against the resistance.
records.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 2

instructions: Abduct your arm at 90° (raise your arm to the side).
Keep a 90° angle at elbow, forearm parallel to the ground.
Externally rotate against resistance.
records.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 3

instructions: Lie on the floor and place a massage ball under your rotator cuff.
Support your elbow with your opposite arm.
Roll into the ball to increase pressure and away from it to reduce.
records.name: Rotator Cuff Mobilisation Lacrosse Ball

instructions: Stand or sit with your arm by your side, palm facing forward.
Reach your hand out to the side and over your head without bending the elbow
The thumb leads the movement.
records.name: Seated Shoulder Abduction

instructions: Stand up straight and hold a dumbbell in one arm. Perform a bicep curl across your body
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder and rotate palm and elbow out.
Point the elbow towards the ceiling while the dumbbell remains just over the shoulder.
Extend your elbow to raise the dumbbell over your head. Start lowering your arm to your side as you turn the palm to face down
records.name: Dumbbell Service Exercise

instructions: Lie on your side with the under arm outstretched in front of you.
Pull your shoulder back to stabilise the scapula.
Bend your elbow at 90° or more.
Use your top arm to press the palm of the under arm out.
records.name: Side Lying External Rotator Cuff Stretch

instructions: Stand up straight holding a dowel. The stretching arms palm should face forward
Push the dowel to the side with the opposite arm.
This in turn will raise the stretching arm over the head.
records.name: Standing Shoulder Abduction

instructions: Stand sideways to a wall.
Raise the arm that is on the side of the wall and place the blade of the palm against the wall.
Slide your arm up over your head and step in towards the wall to increase the stretch.
records.name: Shoulder Abduction Stretch

instructions: Wrap a loop band around your wrists and get yourself in a pushup position.
Support your body on one arm, while the other moves out taping the hour positions of the clock.
If you're moving your right arm it should be taping 12, 1, ..., 6.
If you're moving your left arm it should be taping 12, 11, ..., 6.
records.name: Pushup Position Shoulder Clock

instructions: Hold one end of a band with your arm to the side and behind your body.
Hold the other end in front of your body (overhand grip).
Move your arm away from your body and upward while externally rotating your shoulder.
Finish with your arm over your head and thumb up
records.name: Band Shoulder Y Raise

instructions: Externally and internally rotate the shoulder to mobilise the joint on the specific movement.
records.name: Shoulder External Internal Rotation

instructions: Lie on a bench facing down.
Bring your arm parallel to the ground and bent at the elbow, while holding a weighted ball.
Externally rotate your shoulder letting go of the ball.
Grab the ball before it falls to the ground.
records.name: Shoulder External Rotation Deceleration

instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over your shoulder, straight arm.
Slowly lower your arm towards the ground (overhead position).
Pause in the stretched position.
Bend your elbow to return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Pullover Eccentrics

instructions: From the standing position grab the dowel with one arm, thumb on top, in front of the centre of your body.
Grab the dowel with your other arm to the side and behind your body.
The arm that is back, guides the other in front of you and into the overhead position.
records.name: Standing Shoulder Flexion Mobility

instructions: Stand facing a wall.
Raise your arm above the head and place it on the wall, thumb facing back.
Slide the arm up and lean into the wall to increase the stretch.
records.name: Shoulder Flexion Wall Stretch

instructions: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.
records.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold

instructions: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm. Walk around holding the kettlebell in that position.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.
records.name: Kettlebell Walking Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold

instructions: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
Try to kneel and then stand up without allowing the kettlebell to fall over.
records.name: Kettlebell Kneel To Stand Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold

instructions: Stand facing a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.
records.name: Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles

instructions: Stand sideways to a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.
records.name: Side Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles

instructions: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.
records.name: Serratus Activation Plank

instructions: Support your weight with your forearms on the bosu and toes on the floor (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.
records.name: Bosu Serratus Activation Plank

instructions: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.
records.name: Bosu Serratus Activation Active Plank

instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell over your shoulder with a straight arm.
Form the sign of the cross adding a protraction (punch) on every end of the cross, including the middle position.
records.name: Serratus Activation Cross Punch

instructions: Place a tube roller or half tube on the ground parallel to your body.
Lie on the tube making sure your whole back and neck are supported.
Knees bent and on the ground, lower back flat on the tube and chin tucked in.
Bring your arms by you hips and pull shoulders back.
This is your starting position. Raise arms and drop them back towards the ground over your head
records.name: Shoulder Flexion Thoracic Extensions

instructions: Bring yourself on all 4's. Push the ground away from you, rounding back and shoulders as much as possible.
To enhance the spine flexion suck the belly button in and tuck the tailbone (coccyx) under. Hold this position for a brief moment
Now do the exact opposite, try to bend the spine backwards. Go back and forth on these positions
records.name: Thoracic Flexion And Extensions

instructions: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist bringing your front of your fingertips to your temple while leaning the head towards the the arm.
Lean the head away from the arm as you extend the elbow and flex the wrist.
Alternate between positions to mobilise the ulnar nerve.
records.name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Slider

instructions: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist to bring the palm to face the ceiling while leaning the head towards the opposite shoulder.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.
To increase the stretch, press the palm against the face and try to point the elbow up.
records.name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Tensioner

instructions: Stand against a wall with your back flat, arms at 90° by your sides.
Slowly raise arms overhead, keeping elbows and wrists in contact with the wall.
Lower arms back down to starting position, maintaining constant wall contact throughout.
records.name: Wall Angels

instructions: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Bend your elbow and wrist, bringing the fist close to the shoulder, while leaning the head to the opposite side.
Alternate between these positions to mobilise the median nerve.
records.name: Seated Median Nerve Slider

instructions: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Extend your wrist (point the fingers downwards).
Tilt the head to the opposite side making sure you do not bend the elbow.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.
records.name: Seated Median Nerve Tensioner

instructions: Stand up straight with your arms by your side and a light dumbbell or lever in your hand.
Point the dumbbell/lever to the ground before lifting it towards the ceiling.
Only move the wrist.
records.name: Resisted Radial Deviation

instructions: From the seated position bring your arm out to the side with the palm facing back.
Flex your wrist at the same time you are leaning your head towards your outstretched arm.
Bend your head away from the the outstretched arm while simultaneously extending the wrist.
records.name: Seated Radial Nerve Slider

instructions: Bend your elbow bringing your thumb to the centre of your chest.
Extend your elbow to the side with the palm facing back, and wrist flexed
As your extending the arm, lean your head towards the opposite shoulder
Once you reach maximum tension (without pain) hold the position
records.name: Seated Radial Nerve Tensioner

instructions: Stand up straight holding a dowel/lever/weight in one hand.
Hold the weight so it points behind you and towards the ground.
Squeeze your grip to raise the weight.
records.name: Ulnar Deviations

instructions: Stand upright with a braced core.
Choose the supporting leg and shift your weight on that, while lifting the other slightly off the ground.
Try to maintain your balance while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall or ground.
records.name: Single Leg Balance 2

instructions: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball.
records.name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Balance

instructions: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall.
records.name: Single Leg Bosu Ball Balance 2

instructions: Sit on a box or bench
Keep one foot off the ground by pulling onto your knee, or by crossing one leg over the opposite knee.
Try to form the letters of the Alphabet with your foot.
records.name: Alphabet

instructions: From the standing position, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.
records.name: Dorsal Flexion Hold

instructions: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and wrap the band around the balls of the working foot
Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video. Hold the end of the band with the opposite arm of the working foot
The ankle should be at 90° and turned inwards (inversion) before you start the movement. Turn the ankle out, without moving the rest of the leg.
records.name: Eversions

instructions: Sit or stand, lift one foot slightly off the ground.
Rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Complete the allotted amount of reps, then switch directions and repeat on the other foot.
records.name: Ankle Circle

instructions: While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly bring the weight back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Curl

instructions: Grab a barbell with a shoulder width pronated or supinated grip.
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
Pull the weight toward your upper abdomen.
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.
records.name: Barbell Bent Over Row

instructions: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
records.name: Barbell Reverse Curl

instructions: Stand perpendicular to the barbell and hinge forward with a staggered stance.
Grip the barbell end with your closest hand.
Pull your elbow upward, bringing the barbell toward your hip.
Lower the barbell until your arm is fully extended.
records.name: Landmine Meadows Row

instructions: Stand tall, hold EZ bar with shoulder-width underhand grip.
Curl bar upward, keeping elbows tucked and torso stable.
Pause and squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until arms fully extended.
records.name: Ez Bar Curl

instructions: Stand upright, hold EZ bar with narrow underhand grip, elbows pinned to sides.
Curl bar upward by flexing elbows, keep shoulders still throughout movement.
Squeeze biceps at top, pause briefly for maximum contraction.
Lower bar slowly under control until arms fully extended.
records.name: Ez Bar Close Grip Curl

instructions: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
records.name: Ez Bar Reverse Curl

instructions: Grab an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).
records.name: Ez Bar Drag Curl

instructions: Lay on an incline bench and hold an incline bench with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bat up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Ez Bar Spider Curl

instructions: Lay on an incline bench and hold the EZ bar with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Ez Bar Reverse Spider Curl

instructions: Position yourself on preacher bench; grasp EZ bar with underhand grip, elbows extended.
Slowly curl bar towards shoulders; keep upper arms stationary, focus on biceps.
Lower bar back to starting position; maintain control, repeat for reps.
records.name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl

instructions: Sit on preacher bench, grip EZ bar overhand at shoulder width, elbows resting on pad.
Curl bar towards chin, keep elbows stable.
Lower bar slowly to starting position, maintaining control throughout.
records.name: EZ Bar Reverse Preacher Curl

instructions: Grab a barbell with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).
records.name: Barbell Drag Curl

instructions: Grab a v bar and place it under the bar's collar.
Hinge forward with a flat back and pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.
records.name: Landmine T Bar Rows

instructions: Start on one knee facing the landmine, holding the end of the barbell with your hand on the side of your forward leg.
While keeping your elbow braced against the inside of your knee, curl the barbell upward towards your shoulder, then lower it back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Concentration Curl

instructions: Stand beside the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart while grasping the end of the landmine barbell with the hand farther away from the landmine attachment, palm facing up and your elbow close to your side.
Curl the barbell up towards your opposite shoulder, contracting your bicep muscles, then slowly lower the barbell back down.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Bicep Curl

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, pause briefly, and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Supinated Row

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart and your palms facing towards your body.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a pronated (overhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing towards your body (supinated grip), and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row

instructions: Grab the barbell with an overhand grip. Hinge forward while keeping your back flat until your torso is about parallel with the ground.
Let your arms hang freely.
Pull the bar to your torso while tucking your elbows in slightly.
Extend your elbows fully before initiating the next rep.
records.name: Barbell Pronated Row

instructions: Start hinged forward with a flat back and the plates resting on the floor. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
Pull the bar to your sternum.
Return the plates back to the floor and let the bar come to a full dead stop.
Then initiate the next rep.
records.name: Barbell Pronated Pendlay Row

instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing sideways with a staggered stance and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.
*Named after the late John Meadows
records.name: Barbell Meadows Row

instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.
records.name: Barbell Long Landmine Row

instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with a neutral grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.
records.name: Barbell Landmine Row

instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length.
Raise one dumbbell and twist your forearm until it is vertical and your palm faces the shoulder.
Lower to original position and repeat with opposite arm
records.name: Dumbbell Curl

instructions: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling).
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl

instructions: Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.
records.name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl

instructions: Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a flat back. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.
records.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row

instructions: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling). Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl

instructions: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl

instructions: Lay on an incline bench with your palms facing forward.
Flex at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps.
When you hit the top of the movement, rotate your palms and then lower the dumbbells slowly.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Zottman Curl

instructions: Start with a with a dumbbell in one hand and your elbow resting on the bench.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary on the bench.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Preacher Curl

instructions: Lay on an incline or preacher curl bench.
Let your arms hang freely off the edge of the bench.
Fully flex your elbow and fully extend your elbow on each rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Spider Curl

instructions: Start by placing your forearms on a flat bench and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Dumbbell Spider Curl

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while rotating your wrists so that your palms face your shoulders at the top of the movement.
records.name: Dumbbell Twisting Curl

instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Lean forward and place your elbow on the inside of your leg.
Curl the dumbbell while keeping your elbow against your leg. Make sure to fully extend your elbow on each rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl

instructions: The dumbbells should be set on the ground. Hinge forward while keeping a flat back.
Pull one elbow back toward the ceiling and then return the dumbbell to the ground softly.
Then pull with the other arm.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Pendlay Row

instructions: Place one hand and one knee on a bench. Make sure you keep a flat back.
Pull the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Make sure to avoid any jerking or rotating.
records.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single Arm Row

instructions: Lay on an incline bench that is between 30-45 degrees high.
Let your arms hang freely. Pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Row

instructions: The dumbbells should be placed on the floor.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grab the dumbbells.
Pull both dumbbells back and your elbows toward the ceiling.
Return the dumbbells back to the floor softly on each rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row

instructions: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row

instructions: Start by placing your elbow on one knee.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, with your palm facing inwards towards your body.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee

instructions: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on a bench/box. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat,  and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.
records.name: Lawnmower Row

instructions: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on your knee. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.
records.name: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row

instructions: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, maintain an underhand grip, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Supinated Row

instructions: Sit at preacher bench, hold dumbbells in each hand with arm extended, palm facing up.
Curl dumbbells towards shoulder, keeping upper arm stationary and elbows in.
Lower dumbbell slowly back to start.
records.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl

instructions: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl

instructions: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups

instructions: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on a bench.
Start with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling, then lower the dumbbells toward your sides.
Fully extend your elbows, but don't let your upper arm fall behind your torso.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying Curl

Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

Let your arms hang freely, then pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

The knee that is on the ground should be the same side as the working arm. Stick your chest out.

Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

Flex your elbows while keeping your arms high. Curl the band to your forehead.

Keep your elbows high. Curl until your fists are at your forehead.

Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down, arms extended straight in front of you.
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, pulling the band tight, then lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping tension on the band throughout the exercise.

Hold the band loop in one hand and pull your elbow straight back.

instructions: Stand sideways to anchor and hold band with arm slightly extended.
Pull arm across your body in a smooth arc without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly with control.
records.name: Band Pull Around

instructions: Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
Lower under control, maintaining core tension.
records.name: Mini Band Bent Over Row

instructions: Anchor band around foot, kneel tall holding ends.
Row elbow back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining upright torso.
records.name: Mini Band Kneeling Row

instructions: Hold plate in both hands.
Flex your elbows until the plate nears your chest.
Extend your elbows until they are fully extended.
records.name: Plate Bicep Curl

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back behind the head to the starting position of a tricep extension.
Push the plate back up overhead, then lower it back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension

instructions: Lower into a squat position, keeping the plate at chest height.
Slowly curl the plate towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Hold for a moment at the top of the curl before lowering the plate back to chest height.
Repeat the curls as you hold the squat position.
records.name: Plate Squat Hold Curl

instructions: Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
Pull the plate toward your upper abdomen.
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.
records.name: Plate Pinch Grip Row

instructions: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Weighted Chin Ups

instructions: Hold the TRX straps with an underhand grip and lean back and away from the anchor point.
Keep your elbows high as you flex your elbows. Pull your fists toward your forehead.
records.name: TRX Curl

instructions: Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Maintain a neutral grip. Flex your elbows and pull your fists to either sides of your temples.
records.name: TRX Hammer Curl

instructions: Stand facing the TRX straps and grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing away from your body.
Walk back until the straps are taut, keeping your arms straight.
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
records.name: TRX Reverse Curl

instructions: Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the strap is taut.
Start with an overhand grip. Pull your elbows back and rotate your grip.
By the time your elbows reach your side, your palms should be facing upwards.
records.name: TRX Rotating Row

instructions: Hold the TRX strap with one hand.
Lean back until the strap is taut. Fully extend your elbow.
Pull your elbow behind the body. Make sure to avoid twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.
records.name: TRX Single Arm row

instructions: Lie down on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Close your eyes and take deep breaths in through your nose and out through your mouth.
Allow your body to completely relax and let go of any tension.
Hold for several minutes and then slowly come back up to a seated position.
records.name: Corpse Pose

instructions: Begin in a squatting position with your feet together and your knees apart.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you, shoulder-width apart. Keep your arms straight and engage your core.
Slowly shift your weight forward and lift your feet off the ground, coming onto your tiptoes.
Bend your elbows and lean your weight onto your hands, shifting your knees towards your upper arms.
Gently lift one foot off the ground, and then the other, balancing on your hands. Hold the pose for a few breaths before releasing back to the ground.
records.name: Crow Pose

instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Spread your fingers wide and press down into your palms, making sure that your fingers are evenly spaced and facing forward.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the ground, straightening your legs as much as possible.
Press your hips up and back, bringing your body into an inverted "V" shape.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulder blades spread apart, and try to press your heels down towards the ground.
Hold the pose for several breaths, then release and return to your starting position.
records.name: Downward Dog

instructions: Begin in the same starting position as the previous exercise, with your hands and knees on the ground.
Spread your fingers wide and turn your hands so that your fingers are facing towards your feet.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the ground, straightening your legs as much as possible.
Press your hips up and back, bringing your body into an inverted "V" shape.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulder blades spread apart, and try to press your heels down towards the ground.
Hold the pose for several breaths, then release and return to your starting position.
records.name: Downward Dog With Fingers Facing Feet

instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog pose.
Slowly lift one leg up towards the ceiling, keeping your hips level and your toes pointed.
Bend your lifted leg and try to touch your toes to the back of your head.
Once you have a firm grip with your toes, slowly begin to twist your torso towards the lifted leg.
Keep your hands and feet firmly planted on the ground as you hold the pose for a few breaths. Release the pose and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Scorpion Twist Pose

instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, palms facing forward.
Cross your right arm over your left arm and interlace your fingers.
Pull your hands away from your body and hold for a few breaths, then release and repeat with the opposite arm on top.
records.name: Seated Arm Stretch

instructions: Hold the bosu vertically.
Flex your elbows curling the bosu toward your chin.
records.name: Bosu Ball Curl

instructions: Hold bosu and hinge forward.
Pull bosu towards chest, squeezing shoulder blades.
records.name: Bosu Ball Row

instructions: Hold the handles and maintain a neutral spine.
Pedal at a moderate pace and try to minimise rocking back and forth.
records.name: Stationary Bike

instructions: Hold handles, elbows close, and jump with both feet together.
Rotate wrists to swing the rope over your head.
Jump as it reaches your feet, keeping a steady rhythm.
records.name: Jump Rope

instructions: Step onto the pedals, grip the handles, and start moving your feet in a natural stride.
Adjust resistance and incline for desired intensity while maintaining a steady, controlled motion.
Keep your posture upright, engage your core, and maintain a consistent pace for an effective workout.
records.name: Elliptical

instructions: Stand tall, jog in place, bringing heels toward your glutes.
Keep your core tight and swing arms naturally.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady rhythm.
records.name: Butt Kick

instructions: Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level. Then keep the motion going with only your arms.
records.name: Cardio Assault Bike Arms Only

instructions: Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level.
Monitor heart rate and intensity; increase or decrease resistance for an effective cardio workout.
records.name: Cardio Assault Bike

instructions: Stand with a band looped under both feet and the band grasped in both hands.
Do a light hop and bring your feet outward while simultaneously flexing the elbows.
Bring both feet back together and extend the elbows.
records.name: Cardio Band Hammer Curl Jacks

instructions: Stand with the band looped under both feet and the other end of the band in both hands in an overhead press position.
Do a light hop and bring both feet outward while pressing the band overhead.
records.name: Cardio Band Press Jacks

instructions: Grab the band with a double overhand grip. Bring both feet outward while performing a little hop.
As you hop, pull the band apart.
records.name: Cardio Band Reverse Fly Jacks

instructions: Loop a band around your back. Start with both arms extended at your side.
As you perform the jack. Bring both arms together and make a little clap.
records.name: Cardio Band Seal Jacks

instructions: Stay light on your toes and tap both feet to the ground in quick succession.
Move in a square pattern.
records.name: Cardio Box Quick Feet

instructions: Perform a jumping jack while crossing the feet.
records.name: Cardio Criss Cross Jacks

instructions: With both feet, leap forward then back, then to the left, then to the right.
Repeat.
records.name: Cardio Diamond Hop

instructions: Perform s sprint in a figure eight pattern.
Make sure to stay low.
records.name: Cardio Figure Eight Sprint

instructions: Do a light hop and split your stance.
Land lightly on your toes, and then bring the opposing leg forward.
records.name: Cardio Forward Scissor

instructions: Bring one leg forward and then the other.
Bring the original leg backwards and then the other.
records.name: Cardio In And Out Forward

instructions: Start with both feet together.
Do a slight hop and bring your feet outwards, then back inwards.
records.name: Cardio In And Outs

instructions: Start with your feet side by side.
Bring one foot laterally, then the other.
Return the first foot to its starting position, then the other.
records.name: Cardio In In Out Out Shuffle

instructions: Stand with feet together, arms at your sides, ready to jump.
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead.
Return to starting position with legs together and arms at your sides. Repeat.
records.name: Cardio Jumping Jacks

instructions: Stand upright, feet together, facing forward, ready to move laterally.
Move right foot behind left, then step left foot to the side.
Alternate crossing and stepping, increase speed, maintain rhythm and balance.
records.name: Cardio Karaoke

instructions: Stand straight, feet hip-width apart, engage core.
Lift knees alternately, tap with same side hand.
Continue rhythmically, maintain posture, increase speed as able.
records.name: Cardio Knee Taps

instructions: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Quickly tap your feet while moving laterally.
records.name: Cardio Lateral Quick Feet

instructions: Start with a wide stance.
Shuffle sideways for a specified distance while maintaining a quarter squat position.
records.name: Cardio Lateral Shuffle

instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.
records.name: Cardio Long Jump

instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.
Shuffle back to the starting position.
records.name: Cardio Long Jump Shuffle Back

instructions: Quickly tap each foot to the ground.
records.name: Cardio Quick Feet

instructions: Make sure your feet are strapped in tightly.
Without bending your legs, pull the handle to your ribcage.
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.
records.name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Arms Only

instructions: Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
Push with legs, lean back slightly. Do four small pulls with increasing distance on each rep.
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.
records.name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Four Stroke Sprint Start

instructions: Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
Push with legs, lean back slightly, pull handle to lower ribs.
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.
records.name: Cardio Row Erg Rower

instructions: Strap your feet in tightly.
Keep your arms extended while flexing and extending at the hips and knees.
records.name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Legs Only

instructions: Stand with feet together, arms in front at chest level, palms touching.
Spread legs wide, simultaneously swing arms out to sides, palms facing forward.
Jump back to starting position, bringing arms together again quickly. Repeat rhythmically.
records.name: Cardio Seal Jacks

instructions: Set up two cones at a specified distance.
Stay low and sprint quickly to the second cone.
Hinge forward and tap the cone, then turn and sprint to the original cone.
Repeat for the desired time or reps.
records.name: Cardio Shuttle Sprint

instructions: Pick up one leg off the ground.
Hop forward and backward quickly while staying on your toes.
records.name: Cardio Single Leg Forward Hop

instructions: Pick up one leg off the ground.
Hop laterally quickly while staying on your toes.
records.name: Cardio Single Leg Lateral Hop

instructions: Stand, balance on right foot, left foot behind, slightly bent knees.
Jump to left, landing on left foot, right foot behind, swinging arms.
Continue leaping side-to-side, maintaining balance and speed, like a speed skater.
records.name: Cardio Skater

instructions: Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.
records.name: Cardio Skater To Single Leg Burpee

instructions: Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.
records.name: Cardio Ski Erg

instructions: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, ready to move.
Quickly drive knees up towards chest, alternating legs, pumping arms in rhythm.
Gradually speed up, maintaining high knees and arm movement, breathe steadily.
records.name: Cardio Sprint In Place

instructions: Stand tall, feet together, arms by sides, ready to move.
Step right foot out, simultaneously raise arms above head.
Step right foot in, lower arms, repeat left, maintain rhythm.
records.name: Cardio Step Out Jacks

instructions: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Stay on your toes, step right, tap your left toe to the ground, plant your right foot and raise your left leg.
Then repeat in the opposite direction.
records.name: Cardio Three Step Heismans

instructions: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.
records.name: Curve Treadmill

instructions: Step onto step, grip handles lightly, maintain tall posture and neutral spine.
Drive through midfoot, alternate steps smoothly, avoid leaning heavily on handles.
Set moderate pace, breathe rhythmically, keep knees tracking over toes.
records.name: Stair Climber

instructions: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a light jog.
records.name: Treadmill Jog

instructions: Get the treadmill up to a speed where you are doing a sprint.
records.name: Treadmill Sprint

instructions: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.
records.name: Treadmill Walk

instructions: Stand in front of a low box.
Bring one foot to the edge of the box and alternate as quickly as possible.
Only lightly tap your feet to the box.
records.name: Toe Tap

instructions: Face the opposite direction on the treadmill.
Hold on to the arms to find your balance.
Walk backwards pushing your toes through the front of your shoes.
records.name: Treadmill Backwards Walk

instructions: Face sideways on the treadmill.
Take a quarter squat position with a wide stance.
Shuffle sideways for a specified amount of time, then switch sides.
records.name: Treadmill Side Shuffle

instructions: Grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).
records.name: Smith Machine Drag Curl

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the bar with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the bar about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the bar straight up towards your chest.
As the bar reaches your chest, pause briefly, and then lower the bar back to the starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Underhand Row

instructions: Start hinged forward with a flat back. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
Pull the bar to your sternum.
records.name: Smith Machine Overhand Row

instructions: Kneel tall, arms long, palms forward.
Set shoulders down, engage core and glutes.
Bend elbows, curling hands toward shoulders without leaning back.
Extend arms slowly, maintaining upright posture and strap tension.
records.name: Reverse Expansion Bicep Curls Kneeling

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps, elbows straight.
Roll spine down sequentially while bending elbows into a bicep curl.
Pause briefly, keeping shoulders relaxed and core engaged.
Reverse the roll up, extending arms forward with controlled tension.
records.name: Back Rowing Preps Roll Down With Bicep Curl Seated

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
Start with arms straight, palms facing up, shoulders relaxed.
Bend elbows, curling hands toward shoulders without moving torso.
Extend arms slowly, maintaining control and constant tension on straps.
records.name: Back Rowing Preps Bicep Curls Seated

instructions: Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
Pull handle while rotating torso slightly.
Keep hips stable and movement controlled.
Return arm and torso to start.
records.name: Pilates Single Arm Rotations Back Rowing Seated Row

instructions: Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
Pull handle toward torso, squeezing shoulder blade.
Keep torso stable without rotation.
Extend arm forward under control.
records.name: Pilates Single Arm Back Rowing Seated Row

instructions: Sit tall, legs extended, hold straps with arms forward.
Pull handles toward torso, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Keep chest lifted and spine neutral throughout.
Extend arms forward under control.
records.name: Pilates Back Rowing Seated Row

instructions: Hold the Barbell with both hands and kneel on the floor with your feet up
Slowly roll the Barbell straight forward, stretching your body into a straight position.
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the starting position. This should be a slow and controlled movement.
records.name: Barbell Roll Outs

instructions: Hold the bar with a slightly wider than shoulder width grip. Push the bar up toward the ceiling and maintain that elbow extension.
Flex your abs and sit-up. Aim to get your torso vertical while maintaining the barbell overhead.
records.name: Barbell Situp

instructions: Measure your hands by the markings on the bar to make sure you're even. Then throw your elbows underneath the bar.
The bar should be set so high on your shoulders it digs into your neck a bit. Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Front Squat Olympic

instructions: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Unrack the bar then initiate the rep.
Bring the bar to your torso and tap your ribcage before pressing back to the ceiling.
records.name: Barbell Larsen Bench Press

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your legs extended towards the landmine attachment and your arms overhead, holding the landmine barbell with both hands while engaging your core muscles by pressing your lower back into the ground and drawing your belly button in towards your spine.
Lift your legs off the ground, keeping them together and straight, and simultaneously raise your upper body off the ground, reaching the landmine barbell away from your face.
Hold this position for the desired duration, then carefully lower the barbell to the ground.
records.name: Landmine Hollow Hold

instructions: Lay flat on the ground and hold the end of the bar with your arms extended.
Raise your back off the ground until you are sitting at a 90 degree angle.
Then lower slowly back to the floor.
records.name: Landmine Sit Up

instructions: Start in a bench press position with your feet planted on the bench and knees bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, positioning your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and lower it to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
records.name: Barbell Hooklying Bench Press

instructions: Sit on the floor and flex your knees and hips to a 90 degree angle.
Your feet should be hovering off the ground. (If that's too hard start with heels on the floor)
Rotate your upper spine to engage your obliques.
records.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your spine neutral. Extend you arms so your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
Sit-up by flexing your abs. Continue to reach for the ceiling for the entire rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Situp

instructions: Get into a plank position. Either from your knees or toes.
Start with the DB by your right hand. Reach with your left and pull the dumbbell to your left arm. Then repeat with the right.
records.name: Dumbbell Plank Pullthrough

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with a dumbbell overhead.
Pull your upper back and legs off the ground. Make a banana shape with your body.
The dumbbell should be held in your hands and your ears should be between your biceps.
records.name: Dumbbell Hollow Hold

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell over your clavicle.
Engage your core muscles and lift your torso off the floor until your shoulders are a few inches off the ground.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position, but avoid resting completely on the floor between reps.
records.name: Dumbbell Crunch

instructions: Start in a plank position. Hold one dumbbell.
Raise the dumbbell straight out in front of you (I), at a 45 degree angle (Y), out to the side (T), and then bend at the elbow while raising (W).
Going through IYTW counts as one rep.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.
records.name: Plank IYTW

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with a dumbbell. Point the soles of your shoes at the ceiling as well as the dumbbell.
Reach for your feet with the dumbbell before bringing your spine back to the floor.
records.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Crunch

instructions: Take a half kneeling position. Start with the dumbbell by your knee on the side of the kneeling leg.
Rotate at the upper spine, holding the dumbbell away from your body with nearly extended elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper

instructions: Start by getting into a plank position with a dumbbell in each hand. Your feet should be shoulder-width apart and your hands should be placed on the dumbbells, with your palms facing each other.
From this starting position, row one dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
Make sure to keep your body straight and your hips level throughout the movement.
records.name: Dumbbell Renegade Row

instructions: Start in a high plank position with a pair of dumbbells positioned under your shoulders. Your hands should grip the dumbbells, palms facing each other.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you row one dumbbell up towards your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Pushup to Renegade Row

instructions: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding dumbbells above chest.
Lower dumbbells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.
records.name: Dumbbell Larsen Press

instructions: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one dumbbell above chest.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Larsen Press

instructions: Sit upright with legs extended, holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press one dumbbell overhead without leaning backward.
Lower the dumbbell slowly, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Z Press

instructions: Sit upright with legs extended, holding one dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press the dumbbell overhead without leaning sideways.
Fully extend your arm while keeping your torso stable.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to your shoulder.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Z Press

instructions: Sit upright with legs extended, holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press both dumbbells overhead.
Fully extend your arms without leaning your torso backward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to shoulder height.
records.name: Dumbbell Z Press

instructions: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground, about a foot from your lower back.
Place your fingertips on your temples with your palms facing out.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor. Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Crunches

instructions: Lay on your back with your arms palms down on either side.
Keep your legs together and as straight as possible.
Slowly raise your legs to a 90° angle, pause at this position, or as high as you can reach your legs, and then slowly lower your legs back down.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
records.name: Laying Leg Raises

instructions: Start in a hand plank position and walk your hands further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.
records.name: Long Lever Plank

instructions: Grab the bar and hang, your body still and your legs straight.
Slowly draw your knees up to your chest

Once you have raised your knees as high as possible, lower your legs and repeat. Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
records.name: Hanging Knee Raises

instructions: Place forearms on the ground with your elbows bent at a 90° angle aligned beneath your shoulders, with your arms parallel at shoulder-width.
Your feet should be together, with only your toes touching the floor.
Lift your belly off the floor and form a straight line from your heels to the crown of your head and hold.
records.name: Forearm Plank

instructions: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump hands outward simultaneously while keeping feet planted and core tight.
Jump hands back under shoulders, maintaining stable hips and spine.
records.name: Bodyweight Hand Plank Jack

instructions: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet out wide while bracing core and keeping hips level.
Jump feet back together, maintaining plank alignment throughout.
records.name: Bodyweight Feet Plank Jack

instructions: Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, and clasp hands at chest.
Rotate torso to one side without lifting feet.
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.
records.name: Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back on a ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Engage your core muscles and flex your spine until you feel your abs contract.
records.name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Crunch

instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball, place forearms on top, and engage your core muscles.
Lift knees, balance on toes, and slowly move forearms in small controlled circles.
Maintain a stable torso, avoid excessive movement, and reverse direction after several rotations.
records.name: Stability Ball Stir The Pot

instructions: Start in a plank position with your feet on a stability ball and hands on the floor.
Engage your core and tuck your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball forward carefully.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.
records.name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck

instructions: Place your feet on the ball and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.
records.name: Stability Ball Pike

instructions: Place feet on a stability ball, hands on the floor in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push up while tucking knees toward your chest.
Extend legs back to starting position, maintaining control and stability throughout the movement.
records.name: Stability Ball Atomic Push Up

instructions: Lie on your back, legs extended, stability ball between your feet, arms out for support.
Engage your core, lift your legs, and rotate them side to side in a controlled motion.
Keep your upper body stable, move slowly, and return to center before switching directions.
records.name: Stability Ball Windshield Wiper

instructions: Lie on your back, holding a stability ball between your feet, arms extended overhead.
Engage your core, lift your legs and arms, passing the ball from feet to hands.
Lower arms and legs back down, then repeat, passing the ball back to feet.
records.name: Stability Ball V Up Pass

instructions: Hang from a bar with arms fully extended.
Lift legs to form an "L" shape.
Hold for allotted amount of time keeping your abs flexed.
records.name: Hanging L Sit

instructions: Start in a plank position.
Raise your arm out in front of you.
Return to the starting position, then raise the opposing arm.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.
records.name: Bodyweight Plank Arm Lift

instructions: Start in a plank position, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet wide, then back together, like a jumping jack.
Keep core tight, maintain plank form, repeat for desired time or reps.
records.name: Bodyweight Plank Jack

instructions: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Lower legs back down, maintain controlled movement.
records.name: Bodyweight Hanging Knee Tuck

instructions: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Hold that position for the specified amount of time.
records.name: Bodyweight Hanging L Sit

instructions: Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
Flex at the hips and knees until your hips land back on the bench, then kick your legs back out to the starting position.
records.name: Reverse Crunch Kick Up

instructions: Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
With your hips and knees extended, lower yourself slowly back to the start position.
records.name: Eccentric Dragonflag

instructions: Lie on your back, arms by sides, legs straight.
Lift one leg to a 45-degree angle.
Lower leg, lift opposite leg; alternate smoothly.
records.name: Laying Alternating Leg Raise

instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Raise both knees towards your chest.
Lower back down without touching the floor; repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Laying Bent Leg Raise

instructions: Lie on your back, legs bent and lifted off the ground.
Lower one leg to the ground until your foot taps the ground, keep your other leg up.
Alternate sides for the prescribed amount of reps.
records.name: Alternating Bent Leg Raise

instructions: Lie on your back, hands under your buttocks or on the ground for support.
Lift legs off the ground, alternate crossing them in a scissor motion.
records.name: Scissor Kick

instructions: Lift both legs off the ground.
Bring both legs outward, then cross both legs over one another.
Alternating which leg goes on top.
records.name: Sideways Scissor Kick

instructions: Lay flat on your back with both hands over one leg.
Reach toward your knee flexing your abs and obliques.
Do the prescribed amount of reps, then switch sides.
records.name: Reach And Catch

instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head.
Crunch up, flexing the spine and your abs.
records.name: Frog Crunch

instructions: Lay on your back with knees bent and your feet together.
Keep your arms extended overhead. Swing your arms to generate some momentum and sit up.
records.name: Frog Sit Up

instructions: Begin in an elbow plank position with your core engaged.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow.
Return to plank, then switch legs quickly. Repeat.
records.name: Elbow Plank Mountain Climber

instructions: To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a slow pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.
records.name: Slow Tempo Mountain Climber

instructions: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders.
Jump one foot forward, switch legs mid-air.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady plank.
records.name: Switch Jump Mountain Climber

instructions: Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders.
Drive knees toward left elbow.
Go back to starting position, then drive knees to right elbow, mimicking a zigzag slalom motion.
records.name: Slalom Mountain Climber

instructions: Begin in a plank position, hands under shoulders, feet together.
Jump feet forward, landing outside hands in a low squat.
Explode back to plank, repeat continuously for desired reps.
records.name: Jumping Mountain Climber

instructions: Grasp the rings, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down toward the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.
records.name: Ring Standing Roll Out

instructions: Hold the Ab Roller with both hands and kneel on the floor with your feet up and crossed.
Slowly roll the ab roller straight forward, stretching your body into a straight position.
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the starting position. This should be a slow and controlled movement.
records.name: Machine Roll Outs

instructions: Place your feet under the foot pads and grab the handles with your hands.
Flex your spine and bring your upper and lower body together.
records.name: Machine Crunch

instructions: Place your feet under the foot pads and grab the handles with your hands.
Flex your spine and bring your upper and lower body together.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Crunch

instructions: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.
records.name: Rower Pike

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a medicine ball.
Circle the ball around your head, maintaining control.
Complete the desired number of repetitions in both directions.
records.name: Medicine Ball Halo

instructions: Lie facing partner, knees bent.
Sit up, toss medicine ball to partner.
Catch and lower down. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Medicine Ball Partner Situp Toss

instructions: Place forearms on medicine ball, extend legs.
Maintain straight body position for desired time.
records.name: Medicine Ball Plank

instructions: Lift medicine ball overhead.
Slam ball down to ground with force.
records.name: Medicine Ball Slam

instructions: Lie on your back, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the ground, engaging core.
Hold the position while maintaining stability.
records.name: Medicine Ball Hollow Hold

instructions: Lie on your back, place a medicine ball between your extended arms and bent knees.
Lower opposite arm and leg to floor, keeping back pressed against ground and medicine ball in place.
Alternate sides, maintain core engagement, and repeat for desired reps or time.
records.name: Medicine Ball Dead Bug

instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.

Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
Tap the kettlebell lightly on the floor and bring the kettlebell back across your body to the starting position, rotating your chest towards the floor.
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.
records.name: Kettlebell Russian Twist

instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in one hand and extend your arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell above your head, lower the relaxed arm towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting potion, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Windmill

instructions: Lay flat on your back with straight legs and hold the kettle bell above your chest at arms length.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor with the kettlebell raised at arms length above your chest.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Situp

instructions: Sit upright with legs extended, holding kettlebells at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press both kettlebells overhead.
Fully extend your arms without leaning your torso backward.
Lower the kettlebells slowly to shoulder height.
records.name: Kettlebell Z Press

instructions: Sit upright with legs extended, holding kettlebells at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press one kettlebell overhead without leaning backward.
Lower it slowly, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Z Press

instructions: Sit upright with legs extended, holding one kettlebell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press the kettlebell overhead without leaning sideways.
Fully extend your arm while keeping your torso stable.
Lower the kettlebell slowly to your shoulder.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Z Press

instructions: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.
records.name: Kettlebell Larsen Press

instructions: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press

instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in your bottom hand and extend the other arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell inside your thigh, lower the kettlebell towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting position, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand

instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold kettlebells at your shoulders.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up

instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell at one shoulder.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up

instructions: Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
Step forward, lunge. Bringing your back knee to the floor.
Extend your knee and return to the starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge

instructions: Hold kettlebells close to chest.
Squat down, keeping chest up.
Stand up, extending hips fully.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat

instructions: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways, lunge.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge

instructions: Start with kettlebell in front rack.
Step back into lunge.
Return to start position.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)

instructions: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways into a lunge position.
Return to start position. Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)

instructions: Lay on your stomach on the floor with your forearms flat on the ground.
Extend your elbows and push your upper body upwards.
Push your upper body upwards until you feel a stretch in your abs, then return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Abdominals Stretch Variation One

instructions: Stand upright.
Reach with both hands upwards until you can interlock your fingers.
With your hands above your head, lean back until a stretch is felt in the abdominals.
records.name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Stand upright.
After completing the desired amount of reps with the left arm, switch to the right arm and lean to the left.
Reach up with your left arm and then lean slowly to the right. Lean until a stretch is felt in the obliques.
records.name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Lay on a ball or a Bosu ball with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Lean all the way back until you feel a stretch in your abdomen.
Crunch upwards and hold for a 1-2 count.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.
records.name: Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch

instructions: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.
records.name: Cable Standing Crunch

instructions: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward toward opposite shoulder.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.
records.name: Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper

instructions: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.
records.name: Cable Standing High To Low Wood Chopper

instructions: Stand facing cable, hold rope behind head with elbows tucked in.
Brace core and curl torso downward toward hips without pulling with arms.
Return slowly to standing tall, keeping constant tension on abs.
records.name: Cable Rope Standing Crunch

instructions: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.
records.name: Cable Bar Standing Crunch

instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.
records.name: Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper

instructions: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward and fall to a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.
records.name: Cable Bar Kneeling Crunch

instructions: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.
records.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Crunch

instructions: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.
records.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Oblique Crunch

instructions: Place the band at the highest anchor point you have available. Grab both ends of the band and fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back flexing at the spine.
Squeeze your abs and then extend at the hips and spine back to the starting position.
records.name: Band Crunch

instructions: Loop band around ankles, lie flat on back.
Raise both legs upward, keeping them straight.
Lower slowly without arching lower back.
records.name: Mini Band Leg Raise

instructions: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Step one foot forward under torso.
Alternate steps continuously, keeping hips stable.
records.name: Mini Band Walking Mountain Climber

instructions: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Drive one knee toward chest against resistance.
Alternate legs quickly while keeping hips stable.
records.name: Mini Band Mountain Climber

instructions: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank position.
Move one hand forward, outward, then back in circular pattern.
Alternate sides, keeping hips level and core braced.
records.name: Mini Band Around The World Plank

instructions: Loop band around ankles, lie on back.
Lift legs slightly off floor, core braced.
Alternate legs in controlled scissor motion.
records.name: Mini Band Scissor Kick

instructions: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank.
Step one hand outward against band tension.
Return and alternate, keeping hips level.
records.name: Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out

instructions: Loop band around ankles, hold high plank.
Step one foot outward, resisting band pull.
Return and alternate, maintaining stable hips.
records.name: Mini Band Plank Step Out

instructions: Start by standing upright with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a single weight plate overhead with both hands, keeping your arms extended straight above your head.
Begin walking forward, taking slow and steady steps while maintaining a straight line. Your focus should be on maintaining balance and control of the weight plate overhead.

As you walk, continue to keep your arms extended and the weight plate overhead. Try to maintain good posture and avoid leaning forward or backward, as this could result in losing control of the weight plate.
Continue walking for a set distance or for a certain amount of time, keeping your focus on proper form and technique. When finished, return to the starting position and repeat as desired.
records.name: Plate Overhead Carry

instructions: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground
Engage your core muscles by pulling your belly button toward your spine.
Slowly twist your upper body to the right, keeping your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold for a second and then twist to the left, holding for another second.
records.name: Plate Russian Twist

instructions: Start by lying on your back on a mat with your legs bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a weight plate over your head with both hands, making sure to keep your arms straight.
Engage your core and use your abdominal muscles to sit up, keeping the weight plate towards the ceiling.
records.name: Plate Situp

instructions: Get into a kneeling position with both forearms pressed into the ground.
Place a weight plate on your back (or have a partner do it for you).
Hold the plank for the allotted amount of time.
records.name: Weighted Forearm Plank

instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your hands planted on the ground.
Place a weight plate on your back or have a friend do it for you.
Pick your knees up off the ground. Hold in this position with a flat back.
records.name: Weighted Hand Plank

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your arms extended over head holding a weight plate.
Pick your upper back and your legs off the ground. Your body should be in a banana shape.
records.name: Plate Hollow Hold
