instructions: Start from a plank position. Place a plate on your back.
Go to one elbow then the other. Try to avoid rocking back and forth.
records.name: Weighted Plank Up Down

instructions: Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.
records.name: TRX Ab Rollout

instructions: Lie face down on the ground and place your forearms on the ground directly under your shoulders.
With your feet in the stirrups, kick both feet into the TRX straps and hold the handles above your head.
Tighten your abs, glutes, and legs to form a straight line from your head to your feet.
records.name: TRX Forearm Plank

instructions: Start by facing away from the TRX straps and placing your feet in the TRX handles with your palms on the ground.
Lift your knees off the ground to begin the set.
Engage your core and maintain this position for the desired amount of time, holding a steady plank.
records.name: TRX Hand Plank

instructions: Begin in a kneeling position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length.
Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
records.name: TRX Kneeling Ab Rollout

instructions: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.
records.name: TRX Knee Tuck

instructions: Start in a plank position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length. Place your feet in the TRX stirrups.
Keep your abs engaged, and bring one knee towards your chest while keeping the other leg extended behind you.
Switch legs, bringing the opposite knee towards your chest while keeping your abs engaged and your back straight.
records.name: TRX Mountain Climber

instructions: Place your feet in the stirrups and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.
records.name: TRX Pike

instructions: Lie down on your back with your feet hip-distance apart and your knees bent.
Place your hands on the floor beside your head, fingertips pointing towards your shoulders.
Push your feet and hands into the floor, lift your hips up and straighten your arms.
Lift your chest towards the ceiling and hold the pose for a few breaths before lowering back down.
records.name: Urdhva Dhanurasana Wheel Pose

instructions: Start prone, hands under shoulders.
Inhale, lift chest, arch back.
Elongate neck, gaze up. Breathe, hold. Release, exhale.
records.name: Cobra Pose

instructions: Place forearms on Bosu, elbows under shoulders.
Extend legs, keeping body straight.
Hold the plank position, engaging core.
records.name: Bosu Ball Forearm Plank

instructions: Place hands on Bosu, shoulder-width apart.
Extend legs, keeping body straight.
Hold the plank position, engaging core.
records.name: Bosu Ball Hand Plank

instructions: Start in a plank position with Bosu under feet.
Lift one leg back, squeezing glutes.
Lower the leg back down and switch sides.
records.name: Bosu Ball Plank Glute Kickback

instructions: Lie on back, bosu elevated toward the ceiling.
Sit up, engaging core muscles.
Lower back down to complete one situp.
records.name: Bosu Ball Situp

instructions: Stand on Bosu, lift one foot, tap it on the Bosu.
Alternate tapping feet while maintaining balance.
Keep the movement controlled and steady.
records.name: Bosu Ball Toe Tap

instructions: Stand next to Bosu, step up and over it.
Repeat, moving laterally side to side.
Keep a steady pace, engaging core muscles.
records.name: Bosu Ball Up And Over

instructions: Place both hands on Bosu, wider than shoulder-width.
Perform a pushup, then walk hands to the other side.
Perform another pushup, repeat back and forth.
records.name: Bosu Ball Walkover Pushup

instructions: Put a hip thrust pad on the smith machine bar at neck height. Put both arms over the bar and pull your feet off the ground.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.
records.name: Smith Machine Hanging Knee Tuck

instructions: Lay flat on the ground. With your feet on the bar.
Lift your hips off the ground.
records.name: Smith Machine Reverse Crunch Hip Raise

instructions: Set up the Smith machine bar at an appropriate height.
Lie on your back beneath the bar, gripping it with your hands.
Engage your core, lift your upper body toward the bar, and exhale.
Lower your upper body back down in a controlled manner, inhaling.
records.name: Smith Machine Situp

instructions: Place hands on the shoulder rests on feet on the footbar.
Engage core, glutes tight, body forming a straight line.
Press arms forward, protract shoulders slightly, keep neck neutral.
Hold position with steady breathing and full-body tension.
records.name: Control Front Plank Position

instructions: Lie supine, legs tabletop or extended, arms reaching long by sides.
Lift head and shoulders, engage core, gaze toward thighs.
Pump arms vigorously, inhaling five counts, exhaling five counts.
Maintain stable torso and strong abdominals for one hundred counts.
records.name: Hundred Straight Legs

instructions: Lie supine, legs tabletop or extended, arms reaching long by sides.
Lift head and shoulders, engage core, gaze toward thighs.
Pump arms vigorously, inhaling five counts, exhaling five counts.
Maintain stable torso and strong abdominals for one hundred counts.
records.name: Hundred

instructions: Place hands on footbar, shoulders over wrists, legs extended long.
Engage core and glutes, forming a straight line head to heels.
Press heels back, protract shoulders slightly, neck neutral.
Hold with steady breathing and full-body tension.
records.name: Long Stretch Plank Position

instructions: Lie supine, knees bent, arms reaching toward thighs.
Lift head, shoulders, and upper back off carriage.
Reach forward while maintaining core engagement.
Lower slowly back to starting position.
records.name: Pilates Teaser Prep

instructions: Lie supine, feet in straps, legs extended upward.
Lift hips, rolling spine off carriage.
Bend knees, bringing heels toward glutes overhead.
Roll down slowly, extending legs to start.
records.name: Pilates Short Spine

instructions: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Barbell Calf Raises

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the floor.
Explode onto your tip toes and hold for a second.
Bring your heels back to the floor then initiate the next rep.
records.name: Barbell Calf Jump

instructions: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.
records.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise

instructions: Begin by standing on a raised surface (such as a step or box) with the balls of your feet on the edge of the surface and your heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels up as high as you can.
Lower your heels back down to the starting position, allowing your calves to stretch.
records.name: Barbell Toes Up Calf Raise

instructions: Stand facing the barbell, holding the end of the barbell close to your chest in both hands with your elbows tucked in to your sides.
Drive though the balls of your feet to raise your heels off the ground, squeezing your calves, with a focus on making sure your ankles do not turn out or in.
Lower your heels back down to the ground and repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Calf Raise

instructions: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise

instructions: Start by sitting on a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand placed on each leg.
From this starting position, raise your heels as high as you can by pushing up through your toes.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise

instructions: Standing straight with a dumbbell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the dumbbell off the floor. Hold onto something for balance.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise

instructions: Walk forward and push your toe into the ground
Lift you heel off the ground each step and tense your calf muscle
Repeat on each leg and walk forward slowly
records.name: Walking Calf Raises

instructions: Point your toes into the floor.
Slowly walk forwards and backward
Keep your heels in the air as long as possible while walking.
It may be beneficial to do this last at the end of your workout.
records.name: Tip Toe Walking

instructions: Balance on the balls of your feet on the platform or plates, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the motion.
Repeat as necessary.
records.name: Calf Raises

instructions: Hold on to something for balance.
Hinge forward and maintain that position. Calf raise until you feel a contraction in your calfs.
records.name: Bodyweight Donkey Calf Raise

instructions: Hold onto something for balance. Raise one foot off the ground.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Calf Raise

instructions: Get comfortable on the machine, then place your lower thighs beneath the padded lever. Place your toes and the balls of your feet onto the foot supports.
Prevent the weight from slipping forward by gripping the handles, and release the safety bar. Lower the weight until your calves are extended.
Push your heels up to lift the padded lever and hold the contracted position, then slowly lower back down to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Machine Seated Calf Raises

instructions: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height and place your shoulders underneath the padded lever.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the calve block, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Machine Standing Calf Raises

instructions: Sit on the machine and press your back into the back pad.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the foot plate.
Let your heels lower until you feel a stretch in your calves, then press back up until you feel a contraction.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Calf Raise

instructions: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height and sit.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the calve block, your heels extended off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Machine 45 Degree Calf Raise

instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your height. Place your elbows on the pad, grab the handles. The vertical pad should be resting on your lower back.
Raise your heels toward the ceiling.
records.name: Machine Donkey Calf Raise

instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in each hand, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise

instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the kettlebell off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise

instructions: Sitting comfortably on a chair with your core stomach muscles engaged, place your feet on the floor.
Place the kettlebell on your legs, just above the knees and raise your heels upwards off the floor.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise

instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in a goblet position, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise

instructions: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.
records.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise Double

instructions: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise

instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the opposing foot off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise

instructions: Place the ball of your foot against the wall with your heel on the ground. Place your hands on the wall in front of your shoulders.
Keeping your knee straight, slowly lean towards the wall, pause for a few seconds when you feel the stretch extending through your calf muscle.
Return to the starting position, and repeat the stretch with your other leg.
records.name: Calves Stretch Variation One

instructions: With both feet flat on the ground, place one leg in front of your shoulder, your other leg should mirror this position behind your other shoulder. In the starting position both of your knees should be straight.
Place the palms of your hands against the wall at shoulder height in front of you, lean towards the wall and bend your front leg at the knee while keeping your back leg straight.
Pause at the apex of the stretch and return to the starting position. Switch the position of your legs and repeat.
records.name: Calves Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Balance the balls of your feet on the platform, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance. Engage your calves so that your feet are flat before beginning the stretch.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the stretch.
Repeat as necessary.
records.name: Calves Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.
records.name: Cable Calve Raise

instructions: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.
records.name: Cable Bar Calve Raise

instructions: Put on a dip belt and attach the cable carabiner to the chain/strap.
Take a few steps back and stand tall. Raise up onto the balls of your feet and hold for a 1 count.
records.name: Cable Belt Calf Raise

instructions: Attach band to a low anchor point.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Lean back slightly. Raise your heels straight up and down
records.name: Band Calf Raise

instructions: Hold the TRX straps under your arms and the handles in your armpits.
Lean forward against the straps.
Keep your body straight and initiate the calf raise by raising your heels off the ground.
records.name: TRX Calf Raise

instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right foot off the mat and place your right toes on top of your left heel.
Press your palms and fingers firmly into the mat and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, deepening the stretch in your hamstrings and calves.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly walking your hands back out to a downward-facing dog position.
records.name: Downward Dog Toe To Heel

instructions: Start standing with a flat and vertical block on the matt
Bend forward, placing hand on vertical block, and front of foot on the flat block.
Press the bottom of your foot towards the ground, and repeat on each side.
records.name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks

instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Walk your feet towards your hands, bending your knees as needed to allow your heels to touch the mat.
Press your palms and fingers into the mat and lift your hips up towards the ceiling to deepen the stretch in your hamstrings and calves.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly walking your hands back out to a downward-facing dog position.
records.name: Walk Your Downward Dog

instructions: Stand on Bosu with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on toes, squeezing calves.
Lower heels back down to complete one rep.
records.name: Bosu Ball Calf Raise

instructions: Start by sitting on a bench or box with the bar resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.
records.name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise

instructions: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise

instructions: Lie supine, balls of feet on bar, heels lifted.
Press bar away, fully extending legs with control.
Lower heels under bar, then lift heels as high as possible.
Bend knees to return, maintaining steady tension and ankle control.
records.name: Footwork Lower And Lift

instructions: Lie supine with feet on bar, legs fully extended.
Alternate lowering one heel while the other stays lifted.
Switch rhythmically, maintaining stable pelvis and quiet upper body.
Continue alternating, emphasizing ankle mobility and control.
records.name: Running Lying On The Back

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell Bench Press

instructions: Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press

instructions: Un-rack the bar and break at the elbows and shoulders.
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.
records.name: Barbell Floor Press

instructions: Lay flat on a decline bench with your feet in the pads. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell Decline Bench Press

instructions: Set bench to moderate incline and grip bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower bar toward upper chest or neck, keeping elbows out wide.
Press bar back up in a straight line over shoulders.
records.name: Barbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press

instructions: Set bench to high incline and grip bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower bar slowly toward upper chest or neck with elbows flared.
Press bar upward until arms fully extend without locking elbows.
records.name: Barbell Guillotine High Incline Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bench Press

instructions: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell High Incline Bench Press

instructions: Starting lying on your back perpendicularly to the barbell while holding the end of the bar in your hand that is further away from the landmine attachment. Your elbow should be rest on the ground at a 45 to 60 degree angle from your torso, with your wrist stacked over your elbow.
Drive the end of the bar upwards, squeezing your chest at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down until your elbow gently touches the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Single Arm Chest Press

instructions: Stand facing the landmine with feet hip-width apart and holding the end of the landmine barbell with both hands, keeping elbows bent and close to your body.
Step backward with the right foot, lunge down, and press the landmine away from your chest.
Push through the left heel to return to the starting position while pulling the landmine back to your chest.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge To Chest Press

instructions: Start on the bench with your shoulder blades pulled back.
As you initiate the first rep, tuck your elbows slightly until the bar is a few inches off your chest.
Pause just off your chest for 1-3 seconds. Then press explosively.
records.name: Barbell Spoto Press

instructions: Lay flat on the incline bench with your feet on the ground. Raise the dumbbells until you have straight arms.
Lower the dumbbells to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on the bench and place your feet on the ground.
Begin the exercise with the dumbbells held together above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Simultaneously lower the weights to either side.
Pause when the weights are parallel to the bench, then raise your arms to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Flys

instructions: Start by lying flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
records.name: Dumbbell Bench Press

instructions: Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly

instructions: Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
Break at one of your arms first bringing that arm to your side while keeping the other arm extended.
Press the dumbbell back to the ceiling. Fully extend that arm before initiating on the other side.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Alternating Single Arm Press

instructions: Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
Break at the elbows and bring your upper arms to your side.
Once your upper arms have reached your side, press the dumbbells back to the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on a decline bench press with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows. Bring the dumbbells out to the side, stopping the dumbbells before they pass your torso.
Bring the dumbbells together to finish the rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press

instructions: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press

instructions: Start by laying on a decline bench with two dumbbells.
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on a decline bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press

instructions: Lie on the flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position
records.name: Dumbbell Guillotine Bench Press

instructions: Lie on the incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position
records.name: Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press

instructions: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly

instructions: Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you in an overhand grip.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement. You should have an overhand grip.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on a flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.
records.name: Dumbbell Neutral Bench Press

instructions: Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.
records.name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press

instructions: Start by laying on a bench with two dumbbells.
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Press

instructions: Start by placing two dumbbells on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the dumbbells, keeping your arms straight.
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.
records.name: Dumbbell Elevated Pushup

instructions: Start in a bench press position with two dumbbells.
Break at one of your elbows first while keeping the other elbow extended.
Your working arm should reach your side before pressing back to the ceiling.
Then alternate to the other arm.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press

instructions: Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.
records.name: Dumbbell Floor Press

instructions: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell High Incline Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the dumbbells to your lower chest.
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Bench Press

instructions: Use a dip belt to attach a dumbbell to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.
records.name: Dumbbell Weighted Dip

instructions: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells with neutral grip at shoulders.
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend without locking elbows.
Lower slowly to shoulder level and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Neutral High Incline Bench Press

instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Floor Fly

instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with palms turned downward.
Lower arms out wide while maintaining internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Floor Fly

instructions: Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with palm turned downward.
Lower arm out wide while keeping internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Single Arm Floor Fly

instructions: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with arm extended.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping torso stable and level.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Chest Press

instructions: Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Floor Fly

instructions: Sit on high incline bench holding dumbbell at shoulder with arm bent.
Press dumbbell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Chest Press

instructions: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.
records.name: Push Up

instructions: Hold your body with arms locked above the equipment
Lower your body slowly while leaning forward, flare out your elbows
Raise your body above the bars until your arms are locked.
records.name: Box Dips

instructions: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform.
Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the bench.
Push body up until arms are extended.
records.name: Incline Push Up

instructions: Use a bench to elevate your feet.
Put your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the ground
Raise your body until you almost lock your elbows.
records.name: Decline Push Up

instructions: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place your feet on the stability ball.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.
records.name: Stability Ball Push Up

instructions: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight, raise one leg off the ground,  and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.
records.name: Leg Raised Push Up

instructions: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body. Bring chest all the way to the floor and raise hands off the ground.
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Hands Up Push Ups

instructions: Start by adjusting the rings straps to chest height. Stand facing the rings with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rings' handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.
records.name: Ring Standing Chest Fly

instructions: Position rings shoulder-width apart, grasp handles, extend legs behind.
Lower chest to rings, bend one elbow, while extending your other arm out to the side. Push yourself back to the start.
Then switch arms and repeat.
records.name: Ring Standing Archer Pushup

instructions: Start by setting up the rings to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the rings grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.
records.name: Ring Standing Pushup

instructions: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.
records.name: Parallel Bar Dips

instructions: Grip the edge of the boxes with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.
records.name: Bodyweight Box Assisted Dips

instructions: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Knee Push Ups

instructions: Start by placing two boxes (or one) on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the box, keeping your arms straight.
Put your knees on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the box.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.
records.name: Bodyweight Incline Knee Push Up

instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up.
Land softly, repeat for reps.
records.name: Bodyweight Explosive Push Up

instructions: Start by placing two plates or low boxes on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the boxes/plates, keeping your arms straight.
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.
records.name: Bodyweight Elevated Push Up

instructions: Begin in a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Diamond Knee Push Ups

instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up, clap hands.
Land softly, repeat for reps.
records.name: Bodyweight Clapping Push Up

instructions: Start standing with your feet hip-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Quickly jump your feet back into a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line from your head to your toes.
Perform a push-up, keeping your core tight and your elbows close to your body.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, and then jump up into the air, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower your body back into the squat position to repeat the movement.
records.name: Burpee

instructions: Sit on the machine and grab the handles.
Press the handles down until your elbows are nearly extended.
records.name: Machine Dips

instructions: Adjust seat height so handles align with chest. Put your elbows on the pads.
Slowly bring pads together in front, keeping tension. Focus on squeezing chest muscles.
Return pads to starting position with controlled motion. Keep chest up throughout. Repeat for reps.
records.name: Machine Bent Arm Pec Fly

instructions: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Low Incline Bench Press

instructions: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Decline Chest Press

instructions: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Incline Chest Press

instructions: Stand tall, partner tosses medicine ball to chest.
Catch ball and press it back to partner. Repeat.
records.name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Partner Toss

instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest, feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend arms forward, slamming ball to the ground.
Catch the ball on the rebound and repeat for reps.
records.name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Slam

instructions: Stand in front of a wall holding a medicine ball.
Press the ball forward, extending arms and tossing it.
Catch the ball and return to the starting position.
records.name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Toss

instructions: Place hands on medicine ball, in push-up position.
Perform push-up, maintaining proper form.
records.name: Medicine Ball Pushup

instructions: Place one hand on medicine ball, other on ground.
Perform push-up, walking hands to switch positions.
records.name: Medicine Ball Walkover Pushup

instructions: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Fully extend your arms, raising the kettlebell until your elbows are locked.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)

instructions: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, leave one arm resting to the side of the body.
Using the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length directly upwards of your shoulder.
Lower your arm until your upper arm to elbow is resting on the floor.
Return to starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Press

instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, with your arms to the side of your body.
Holding a kettlebell in one hand, keeping your arm fully extended with a slight bend in the elbow and your forearms facing upwards, lift the kettlebell above your chest.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Fly

instructions: Starting in a press up position with feet wide and one hand resting on the kettlebell, complete a full press up, lowering your chest towards the ground while keeping your body straight and returning to the starting position.
Swap hands on the kettlebell, placing the hand originally on the kettlebell underneath your shoulder, complete another press up.
Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup

instructions: Lie on your back holding kettlebells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring kettlebells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.
records.name: Kettlebell Floor Fly

instructions: Lie on your back holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring kettlebell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Fly

instructions: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with arm extended.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press

instructions: Sit on incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder with elbow bent.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press

instructions: Sit on high incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder height.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to start position, keeping torso stable and controlled.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press

instructions: Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press

instructions: Start flat on your back with a kettlebell extended over you.
Bring your elbow to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press

instructions: Start flat on your back with the kettlebells extended over you.
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.
records.name: Kettlebell Floor Press

instructions: Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Kettlebell Incline Bench Press

instructions: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press

instructions: Using a raised wall, place your arm at a 90 degree angle against it.
With a staggered stance, lean into the wall extending your chest.
Pause for a few seconds and then return to starting position and repeat on opposite side.
records.name: Chest Stretch Variation One

instructions: Lay on your side with one hand just in front of you.
With a slight bend in your arm, rotate your arm around your body as slowly as possible.
Return to the starting position and then repeat on the other side.
records.name: Chest Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Place your arms behind your back and clasp your hands together.
Slowly extend your elbows until they are locked then lift them away from you.
Pause in this position for a few seconds and then return them to starting position.
records.name: Chest Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Raise your arms to shoulder height, fully extended in front of you.
Slowly bring your arms behind your back still at shoulder height.
Pause for a few seconds and then return to starting position.
records.name: Chest Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Chest Press

instructions: Set the cable pin at shoulder height or just above.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable Pec Fly

instructions: Lie on bench, cables should be above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.
records.name: Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press

instructions: Lie on a bench, holding cables below shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.
records.name: Cable Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on an incline bench, holding low cables with palms facing your feet.
Sweep one arm above your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
Slowly lower the handle, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Alternating Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on bench, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.
records.name: Cable Alternating Bench Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on a bench, holding cables at shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.
records.name: Cable Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on bench, with cables above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle downward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.
records.name: Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press

instructions: Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
Start with both arms extended out.
Bring one arm forward and downward, while keeping the other arm in the same position.
Alternate arms until you complete the allotted amount of reps.
records.name: Cable Alternating Decline Bench Chest Fly

instructions: Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.
records.name: Cable Decline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on bench, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.
records.name: Cable Alternating Bench Press

instructions: Stand facing away from low cables, pressing both handles together at your chest.
Extend your arms forward while continuously squeezing the handles together.
Pause briefly, then return the handles toward your chest.
records.name: Cable Standing Svend Press

instructions: Stand between cables, holding one handle near your chest and one forward.
Press one arm forward while pulling the opposite elbow backward.
Reverse the movement under control, then switch your stance and arms.
records.name: Cable Push Pull

instructions: Stand between cable crossover with cables set just below shoulder level.
Take a neutral grip with mostly extended elbows.
While keeping elbows mostly extended, bring both fists together.
records.name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Fly

instructions: Lay on bench with cables at shoulder level.
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.
records.name: Cable Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on a bench, holding cables higher than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.
records.name: Cable Decline Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Place the cable anchor at a higher level than your shoulders.
Sit on the bench, leave your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your fists together and flex your pecs.
records.name: Cable Decline Chest Fly

instructions: Lie on a bench, holding cables lower than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.
records.name: Cable Incline Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.
records.name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Press

instructions: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward and upward until your arm is extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press

instructions: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with slight arm bend.
Bring arm across chest in a smooth arc without rotating your torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly to starting position.
records.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Fly

instructions: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at shoulder height, arm slightly bent.
Rotate palm inward and bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.
records.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.
records.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press

instructions: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Fly arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.
records.name: Cable Incline Fly Around

instructions: Set cables slightly below shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.
records.name: Cable Incline Press Around

instructions: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and downward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.
records.name: Cable Decline Press Around

instructions: Stand between low cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly

instructions: Stand between low cables with your arms extended outward.
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Fly

instructions: Stand between cables with arms extended outward and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle across your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Stand between cables, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Fly

instructions: Stand between high cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Decline Chest Fly

instructions: Stand between high cables with your arms extended outward.
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Fly

instructions: Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward and downward until your arm is extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Press

instructions: Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and downward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.
records.name: Cable Standing Decline Chest Press

instructions: Stand facing away from the cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward until your arm is fully extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.
records.name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press

instructions: Loop the band around your mid-back. The ends of the bands should be around your hands between your thumb and pointer finger.
This exercise can be done from the knees or the toes depending on experience level.
Begin by breaking at the elbows until your upper arm is by your side. Then extend at the elbows back into the top position.
records.name: Band Pushup

instructions: Attach the band to an anchor point that is about shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Extend your shoulder joint and bring your arm across your body until you feel a contraction in your pecs.
records.name: Band Single Arm Pec Fly

instructions: Stand sideways to anchor, hold band with arm slightly bent and palm turned inward.
Bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc while keeping internal rotation.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly under control.
records.name: Band Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Stand with band behind you and hold loop at chest height.
Press one arm forward and across your body in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at full extension, then return slowly and switch sides.
records.name: Band Press Around

instructions: Start with both feet hip-width apart and step on the middle of the band with both feet. Hold the handles of the band in each hand and position the band above your chest, with your palms facing down.

Keeping your elbows slightly bent, slowly raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel with the floor. Make sure to internally rotate your shoulder joints by bringing your shoulder blades together and rotating your forearms inward towards your torso.
Hold the position for a few seconds and then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping the internal rotation of your shoulder joints throughout the movement.
records.name: Band Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Loop the band around your back. The two end loops in each of your hands.
Extend your shoulder joint and elbow across your body until your arm is fully extended.
records.name: Band Standing Chest Press

instructions: Lie on your back holding band loops with elbows resting on the floor.
Press arms straight up until elbows extend without locking.
Lower elbows back to floor under control, keeping tension throughout.
records.name: Band Floor Press

instructions: Lie on bench holding band handles with arms extended above chest.
Lower arms out wide in a controlled arc, keeping slight bend in elbows.
Bring arms back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.
records.name: Band Bench Fly

instructions: Lie on bench with band looped behind your back.
Lower hands toward chest while keeping elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press upward and squeeze chest at the top, maintaining band tension.
records.name: Band Bench Press

instructions: Start in a pushup position with both hands on a plate. This will extend your range of motion.
Break at the elbows and shoulders until your upper arm travels behind the body slightly.
Then press back into the original position.
records.name: Plate Deficit Pushup

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with a plate on your chest.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling and maintain that extended position.
With your hips up, press the plate toward the ceiling.
records.name: Plate Glute Bridge to Chest Press

instructions: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place a plate on your back.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.
records.name: Weighted Push Ups

instructions: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Weighted Knee Push Ups

instructions: Use a dip belt to attach a plate to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.
records.name: Plate Weighted Dip

instructions: Start by adjusting the TRX straps to chest height. Stand facing the TRX with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.
records.name: TRX Pec Fly

instructions: Start by setting up the TRX straps to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the TRX straps, grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.
records.name: TRX Pushup

instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and bring your heels towards your buttocks.
Reach back with your hands and grab your ankles.
Inhale and lift your chest off the ground, pulling your legs up and back with your hands.
Keep your gaze forward and hold the pose for a few breaths before releasing back to the ground.
records.name: Bow Pose

instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Press your feet into the ground and engage your leg muscles.
Lift your chest and roll your shoulders back and down.
Take a deep breath in, and as you exhale, release any tension in your body and relax your muscles.
records.name: Mountain

instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs stretched out in front of you.
Place a yoga block behind you, horizontally, at the base of your spine.
Slowly recline over the block, supporting yourself with your forearms, until your back is resting on the block.
Relax your arms at your sides, palms facing up, and breathe deeply.
records.name: Supported Matsyasana Pose

instructions: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing the sole of your right foot to the inside of your left thigh.
Bring your hands together in front of your heart, or raise them overhead.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Tree Pose

instructions: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and turn it slightly inward, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and raise your arms overhead, then exhale and bend your right knee, bringing it directly over your ankle.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.
records.name: Warrior One

instructions: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and turn it slightly inward, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and raise your arms to shoulder height, parallel to the ground, with your palms facing down.
Exhale and bend your right knee, bringing it directly over your ankle while keeping your left leg straight.
Look over your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths, then inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.
records.name: Warrior Two

instructions: Stand facing a wall with your arms extended and your palms pressing into the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly begin to walk your feet away from the wall, keeping your arms straight and your hands pressing into the wall.
Walk until your arms are fully extended and your body is at a 45-degree angle to the ground.
Repeat From High to Low Angles starting above the shoulder, and ending below the chest.
records.name: Yogi Arm Clock

instructions: Stand on Bosu with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into squat position and place hands on Bosu.
Jump feet back into plank, perform a pushup, then jump back to squat.
records.name: Bosu Ball Burpee

instructions: Stand on Bosu with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into squat position and place hands on Bosu.
Jump feet back to plank, then jump back to squat.
records.name: Bosu Ball Half Burpee

instructions: Place one hand on Bosu, other on the floor.
Lower chest to the ground, keeping the body straight.
Push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Bosu Ball Offset Pushup

instructions: Place hands on Bosu, shoulder-width apart.
Lower chest to the ground, keeping the body straight.
Push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Bosu Ball Pushup

instructions: Lie on the flat bench, grasp the bar at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out.
Once you feel a stretch in your chest press the weight back up.
records.name: Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Smith Machine Bench Press

instructions: Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press

instructions: Place hands on the bar, in push-up position.
Lower yourself to the bar, maintaining proper form.
records.name: Smith Machine Pushup

instructions: Kneel tall facing straps, arms slightly forward and elevated.
Initiate movement from shoulder blades, drawing arms inward and down.
Create small teardrop shape, keeping neck relaxed.
Return to start smoothly, maintaining continuous tension.
records.name: Reverse Expansion Teardrops Inward Kneeling

instructions: Kneel tall facing straps, arms forward and slightly elevated.
Pull arms outward and down in a controlled teardrop pattern.
Emphasize upper-back engagement, ribs stacked over pelvis.
Return with control, maintaining steady breathing.
records.name: Reverse Expansion Teardrops Outward Kneeling

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Start with elbows extended, hands close to ribs, shoulders relaxed.
Extend arms straight forward, maintaining upright posture and core engagement.
records.name: Front Rowing Preps Straight Forward Seated

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps, elbows bent by sides.
Palms face up, forearms parallel, shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Extend arms forward as if offering, maintaining upright posture.
Bend elbows to return, keeping tension and controlled movement.
records.name: Front Rowing Preps Offering Seated

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Start with elbows bent, hands in front, palms facing in.
Open arms wide to second position, squeezing upper back.
Return with control, maintaining upright posture and steady strap tension.
records.name: Front Rowing Preps Second Position Seated

instructions: Lie prone on the box, chest supported, arms holding straps forward.
Start with arms straight, palms facing down, shoulders relaxed.
Pull arms back in a sweeping motion, engaging upper back.
Return to start with control, keeping neck long and torso stable.
records.name: Backstroke Prep Lying On Box

instructions: Grab a straight bar with a supinated (underhand) grip.
Kneel down next to a flat bench and place your forearms on the bench with your wrists just off the bench.
Let the barbell pull down on your wrists until they are extended.
Curl the barbell until your wrists are fully flexed.
Lower in a controlled manner and repeat.
records.name: Barbell Wrist Curl

instructions: Stand straight and hold the barbell behind you using a pronated grip with your hands and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly curl your wrists in a semi-circular motion upwards.
Hold the barbell at the apex of the motion and then slowly lower the barbell back down to starting position.
records.name: Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl

instructions: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across your knees.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.
records.name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension

instructions: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl

instructions: Brace your off arm against something stable (bench, box). Stagger your stance so your leg on the side of your working arm is back.
Try to get your torso to parallel with the ground. That will extend your range of motion.
Let your arm hang freely and then pull your elbow back. Imagine you've got a tennis ball in your armpit and squeeze it each rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Row Unilateral

instructions: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Curl

instructions: Drape one arm over a bench while holding a dumbbell. Point your palm toward the ceiling.
Extend and curl your wrist against resistance.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl

instructions: Sit by a bench or table and lean your arm on it.
Hold a dumbbell/weight/lever on one end.
Rotate the wrist so the palm faces down and up in succession.
records.name: Dumbbell Wrist Supinations Pronations

instructions: Grab a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight down.
Walk forward with a straight posture.
records.name: Dumbbell Farmer Walk

instructions: Sit on bench, forearm resting on thigh, palm facing up holding dumbbell.
Lower wrist to stretch forearm, keeping forearm flat on thigh.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm flexors at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl

instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
records.name: Inverted Row

instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
records.name: Bodyweight Overhand Inverted Row

instructions: Grab a door frame or a rack and place your feet near the frame.
Start with your elbows extended, row your body towards your hands.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
records.name: Bodyweight Standing Inverted Row

instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.
records.name: Dead Hang

instructions: Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Keep your shoulders blades pulled back and walk for a specified duration.
records.name: Kettlebell Farmers Carry

instructions: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing outwards.
Flex your wrist towards your body until the kettlebell is level with your stomach.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl

instructions: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing inwards.
Flex your wrist upwards until wrists are fully extended.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension

instructions: Grip the kettlebells with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Curl

instructions: Stand tall holding two kettlebells in each hand.
March in place for the desired amount of reps or time.
records.name: Kettlebell Farmers March

instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the knee of one leg off the floor to knee height.
Bring the leg back to standing and repeat with the other leg, keeping the kettlebell on the same side.
Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March

instructions: Standing straight with kettlebells, start walking towards a set point. Pulling your knee up toward the ceiling.
Make sure to keep your chest tall and shoulder blades pulled back.
Try to keep your stride distance roughly the same.
records.name: Kettlebell Walking Farmers March

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell in one hand.
Bend at hips, row kettlebell to chest.
Alternate hands for each row.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Row

instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, walk for a specified distance or duration.
Stay upright and don't lean to one side.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk

instructions: Place your palm flush against the wall.
Take one step forward and straighten your arm slowly to extend your bicep.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.
records.name: Forearms Stretch Variation One

instructions: Place your hand against a wall, palms facing upward, with finger tips touching.
Slowly lean into your palm.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.
records.name: Forearms Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Place your hands together.
Rotate your arms and hands 180 degrees.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.
records.name: Forearms Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Raise your arm to shoulder height at 90 degrees to your body.
Press lightly on your hand and push towards you.
Rotate the arm across your body.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Forearms Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a 90 degree angle with your palm facing down. Flex and extend at the wrist.
records.name: Cable Wrist Extension

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a 90° angle with your palm facing up. Flex and extend at the wrist.
records.name: Cable Wrist Curl

instructions: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm down. Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Bar Reverse Grip Curl

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl

instructions: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm up holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in forearm flexors.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm at the top.
records.name: Cable Braced Wrist Curl

instructions: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm down holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in top of forearm.
Extend wrist upward, contracting forearm extensors fully.
records.name: Cable Braced Wrist Extension

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and facing forwards. Grip the sides of a weight plate with your palms facing down.
Balance on one foot, as you raise the weight keep your arms and back straight, while you bring your  other foot back towards the ground
Keep four raised leg straight and in alignment with your back as you lower the plate back down to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift

instructions: Stand straight with the plate held at your side
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat
records.name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
