instructions: Stand facing the plate with your feet shoulder-width apart and the plate positioned between your feet.
Bend down and grasp the plate from the top edges with both hands, making sure your thumbs and fingers are evenly spaced.
Keep your back straight, chest up and core engaged, and stand up with the plate, keeping it close to your body.
Lower the plate back down to the ground, keeping control and maintaining good posture.
records.name: Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift

instructions: Stand tall holding two plates in each hand with a pinch grip.
Walk for the desired distance or time.
records.name: Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two plates with a pinch grip.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plates towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
records.name: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift

instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip. Place a plate on your chest.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
records.name: Plate Weighted Inverted Row

instructions: Attach weight to yourself using a dip belt. Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.
records.name: Plate Weighted Dead Hang

instructions: Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Turn your hands so that your fingers are pointing towards the sides of your mat and the tops of your hands are on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.
records.name: Table Top Pose Variation 1

instructions: Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Turn your hands so that your fingers are pointing towards your knees and the tops of your hands are on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.
records.name: Table Top Pose Variation 2

instructions: Come onto your hands and knees on the mat with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Turn your palms down and spread your fingers wide, with your fingertips pointing towards your knees.
Press into your palms and extend your arms fully to lift your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly lowering your hands to the mat and coming back to a neutral tabletop position.
records.name: Table Top Pose Variation 3

instructions: Begin in a kneeling position with your knees together and your shins and feet on the floor.
Sit back on your heels and place your palms face down on your thighs, with your fingers pointing towards your knees.
Relax your shoulders and take deep breaths.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.
records.name: Vajrasana Variation 1

instructions: Begin in a kneeling position with your knees together and your shins and feet on the floor.
Sit back on your heels and place the tops of your hands on your thighs, with your fingers pointing towards your knees.
Relax your shoulders and take deep breaths.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.
records.name: Vajrasana Variation 2

instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
records.name: Smith Machine Inverted Row

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps forward.
Begin with arms long, shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Pull arms down and back in a plow motion, engaging lats.
Return to start with control, maintaining upright posture and tension.
records.name: Plow Back Rowing Preps

instructions: Lie prone on the box, chest just off edge, arms holding straps.
Start with arms down, palms facing in, shoulders set away from ears.
Lift arms out to a T, squeezing shoulder blades, keeping neck long.
Lower with control, maintain neutral spine, repeat for smooth controlled reps.
records.name: Arms Pulling Straps Airplane Prone On The Box

instructions: Lie prone on the box, chest just off edge, arms holding straps overhead.
Start with arms long, palms down, shoulders depressed and neck neutral.
Pull arms down toward hips, squeezing lats while keeping torso stable.
Return slowly to start, maintaining control and continuous tension on straps.
records.name: Arms Pulling Straps Plow Prone On The Box

instructions: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Pull your chin back and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
Return to the start position with control. Pulling your chin back to allow the bar to pass your face safely.
records.name: Barbell Overhead Press

instructions: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
records.name: Barbell Upright Row

instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.
records.name: Barbell Front Raise

instructions: Hold the barbell in your hand just off the ground. You should be in a lunge position.
Rotate toward the landmine as you raise your back knee.
Stand, rotate forward, and press the barbell upward.
Lower the barbell to the ground and repeat.
records.name: Landmine Lunge Rotate To Press

instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.
records.name: Ez Bar Front Raise

instructions: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
records.name: Ez Bar Upright Row

instructions: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Pull your chin back and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
Return to the start position with control. Pulling your chin back to allow the bar to pass your face safely.
records.name: Ez Bar Overhead Press

instructions: Hold EZ bar with overhand grip, elbows bent, bar at upper abdomen.
Raise elbows to shoulder height while externally rotating forearms upward.
Press bar overhead once forearms are vertical and aligned.
Reverse motion slowly back to starting position.
records.name: Ez Bar Cuban Press

instructions: Hold the bar in a front rack position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the front rack position before starting the next rep.
records.name: Barbell Thruster

instructions: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders and rest it across upper traps.
Brace core, press bar upward until arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower bar slowly behind head under control and repeat.
records.name: Barbell Behind The Neck Press

instructions: Hold bar just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull bar to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press bar overhead until arms are fully extended.
records.name: Barbell Hang Clean And Press

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, grip barbell just outside thighs.
Explosively extend hips and pull bar to shoulders in one motion.
Press overhead until arms lock out, then lower bar under control.
records.name: Barbell Clean And Press

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide with an overhand grip, chest up, and back straight.
Lift the bar by driving through your legs, keeping it close to your body. Extend your hips and knees while maintaining a straight back.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar as it moves upward.
Drop into a deep squat while locking the bar overhead. Stabilize, then stand up fully to complete the lift.
records.name: Barbell Snatch

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the bar just outside your knees. Pull the bar from the floor by driving through your legs, keeping your back straight.
As the bar reaches your hips, extend explosively, shrug, and drop under to catch it in a front squat position with elbows high. Stand up tall.
Dip slightly, then drive through your legs to push the bar overhead.
Stabilize the bar overhead, lock arms, then bring feet together before lowering the bar safely.
records.name: Barbell Clean And Jerk

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide (outside shoulders), hook grip recommended.
Keep chest up, back straight, and drive through heels to lift the bar off the ground, keeping it close to your body.
As the bar reaches mid-thigh, explode upwards by extending hips, knees, and ankles, shrugging shoulders and pulling the bar high.
Drop under the bar slightly, catching it overhead with arms locked out. Stand up fully to complete the lift.
records.name: Barbell Power Snatch

instructions: Start with the barbell on your shoulders in a front rack position, feet hip-width apart. Slightly bend your knees and dip straight down.
Explosively extend your legs and push the barbell upward, generating momentum with your legs.
As the bar rises, quickly split your legs (one forward, one back) and drop under the bar, locking your arms overhead.
Bring your front foot back, then your back foot forward to a stable standing position with the bar locked overhead.
records.name: Barbell Split Jerk

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell with a wide overhand grip, and keep your back straight and core engaged.
Lift the barbell by explosively extending your hips, knees, and ankles while keeping the bar close to your body.
As the bar reaches chest level, rotate your wrists and elbows up and back, transitioning into an overhead press.
Fully extend your arms overhead, stabilize the bar, then lower it back to the starting position with control.
records.name: Barbell Muscle Snatch

instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.
records.name: Barbell Full Front Raise

instructions: Hold a barbell at shoulder height with a pronated grip.

records.name: Barbell Seated Full Front Raise

instructions: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).

records.name: Barbell Behind The Neck Seated Overhead Press

instructions: Stand up straight with dumbbells at either side, palms facing your hips.

records.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise

records.name: Dumbbell Front Raise

Lower the weights back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press

instructions: Lay on an incline bench and let your arms freely.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.
records.name: Dumbbell Bayesian Lateral Raise

instructions: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your shoulder joint, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.
records.name: Dumbbell Neutral Seated Overhead Press

instructions: Begin seated on an upright bench with your palms facing you.

As you extend your elbows fully your palms should be facing forward.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press

instructions: Start in a standing position
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press

Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
records.name: Kettlebell Kneeling Bottoms Up Overhead Press

instructions: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.
records.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Press

instructions: Hold two kettlebells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing both kettlebells overhead.
Lower kettlebells as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Single Arm Thruster

instructions: Reach one arm behind your body, with your elbow pointing upward behind your head.
Assist the stretch with your other hand on your elbow to engage your shoulder.
Pause for a few seconds, then repeat the stretch with your other arm.
records.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation One

instructions: Start with your arms at either side. Begin by pushing your shoulders forward and in towards your chest.
Continue the circular motion with your shoulders, pinching up towards your ears, and then extending your chest outwards while you finish the motion.
Repeat as necessary.
records.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Place the top of your hand into the small of your back, your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Hold your elbow with the other arm, and slowly pull the arm forward until you feel your shoulder engaged in the stretch. Pause at the apex of the stretch and return to the starting position.
Return to starting position, and repeat with your other arm.
records.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate one arm overhead and behind while keeping the other arm in front of you.
Then rotate the other arm.
Bring the original arm back to the starting position, then the other arm. Repeat.
records.name: Alternating Pole Rotation

instructions: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate both arms overhead and behind you while leaving your elbows mostly extended.
records.name: Pole Rotation

instructions: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine. Stand upright making sure to maintain a flat back. Your starting position will have your palms facing forward.
Use both your elbows and shoulders to press the weight directly overhead.
records.name: Cable Overhead Press

instructions: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arm straight out to the side.
Raise until your arm is parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise

instructions: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.
records.name: Cable Upright Row

instructions: Stand over crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Raise your arms upward and outward, forming a Y shape.
Pause near overhead, then slowly lower the handles.
records.name: Cable Y Raise

instructions: Stand between crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Pull both handles upward, leading with your elbows.
Stop near chest height, then lower the handles slowly.
records.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Upright Row

instructions: Hold low cable handles at shoulder height with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest raised and knees tracking outward.
Stand powerfully and press both handles overhead until your arms are extended.
records.name: Cable Thruster

instructions: Place the cable all the way at the bottom and stand with the cable crossing behind your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.
records.name: Cable Behind The Back Lateral Raise

instructions: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, holding it at chest height.
Press handle upward and forward at a slight diagonal, keeping torso stable.
Squeeze chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.
records.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press

instructions: Stand tall, hold the cable handle with a neutral grip, your elbow should be at a 90 degree angle.
Rotate your shoulder by bringing your forearm across your body.
records.name: Cable Internal Rotation

instructions: Use a rope attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.
records.name: Cable Rope Upright Row

instructions: Face away from the cables. Use a rope attachment.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.
records.name: Cable Rope Front Raise

instructions: Place the cable at the same height as your fist when your arms are at your side and stand with the cable crossing your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.
records.name: Cable Rope Mid Lateral Raise

instructions: Use a rope attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Rope Single Arm Low Lateral Raise

instructions: Face away from the cables.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.
records.name: Cable Bar Front Raise

instructions: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Low Bilateral Lateral Raise

instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set above height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Decline Bench Press

instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Bench Press

instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set above shoulder height.
Bring one handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Decline Single Arm Bench Press

instructions: Stand on the band with one or 2 feet depending on how heavy you want the band to be.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.
records.name: Band Front Raise

instructions: Loop band around elbows, arms bent 90 degrees at sides.
Raise both elbows outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.
records.name: Mini Band Bent Arm Lateral Raise

instructions: Loop band around elbows, arms bent 90 degrees at sides.
Raise one elbow outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.
records.name: Mini Band Alternating Bent Arm Lateral Raise

instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall on one leg.
Tap opposite foot forward, side, then back.
Maintain balance and hip stability throughout movement.
records.name: Mini Band Clock Tap

instructions: Stand with one or both feet on one end of a band. Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the band to chin level or slightly higher.
records.name: Band Upright Row

instructions: Stand on band and hold handle or loop at your side with slight elbow bend.
Raise arm out to the side until shoulder height, keeping torso still.
Lower slowly under control, maintaining constant tension on the delt.
records.name: Band Single Arm Lateral Raise

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up, lock the hips and legs, and press the plate overhead with straight arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Plate Clean And Press

instructions: Stand holding a weight plate at chest height with both hands.
Lower into a squat, extending the plate in front of you at chest height
As you stand back up, pull the plate back into your chest.
records.name: Plate Squat Reach

instructions: Hold the plate with both hands at chest height.
Keeping your core tight and your chest up, squat down as low as you can go while keeping your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the squat position and reach the plate forward, keeping your arms straight and your back straight.
Return the plate to your chest while you hold the squat position and repeat reaching the plate in front of you
records.name: Plate Squat Hold Reach

instructions: Inhale and brace your abdominals
Raise the arms vertically while keeping the elbows slightly bent
Once the arms are parallel with the floor, rotate the plate clockwise and counterclockwise.
Lower the plate back to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Car Driver

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing the thighs.
Keeping the elbows slightly bent, lift the plate up to the front of the body.
Raise the plate up until the arms are fully extended, maintaining control of the plate.
Lower the plate back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Plate Front Raise

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate held in front of your face with both hands, palms facing each other.
Rotate the plate around the head, keeping the arms extended and moving the plate in a circular motion.
Complete one full circle, then reverse the direction to complete another circle.
records.name: Plate Halo

instructions: Brace your core and press the weight plate overhead until your arms are fully extended. Keep your shoulders down and back.
While your arms are fully extended, lower the weight behind your head to perform the extension
After completing the extension, lower the weight to your chest, and perform the overhead press. Repeat
records.name: Plate Overhead Press To Tricep Extension

instructions: Stand tall holding two plates at your side.
Lateral raise the plates to your side and continue until the plates are pointed at the ceiling.
Let your shoulder joint naturally rotate. At the bottom you should have a neutral or overhand grip. By the time the plates are overhead, your palms should be facing forward.
records.name: Plate Full Lateral Raise

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip two plates in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the plates out to your sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
Lower the plates back to your sides with control. Repeat for desired number of reps.
records.name: Plate Lateral Raise

instructions: Start with the plate at chest height. Begin a squat.
Make sure to hit parallel depth. On your way back up, use the momentum you generate with your legs to help push the plate into an overhead position.
Let the plate return to chest height before initiating the next squat.
records.name: Plate Thruster

instructions: Start in a standing position with a plate against your chest.
Press the plate away from your body until your elbows are extended.
records.name: Plate Reach

instructions: Stand facing the TRX straps and hold onto the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly raise your arms forward until they are overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
records.name: TRX I Raise

instructions: Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the straps are taut.
Keep both elbows mostly extended and raise both arms out and upwards.
You should make a Y shape with your arms during the back portion of the exercise.
records.name: TRX Y Raise

instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Place your forearms on the floor and interlace your fingers.
Place the crown of your head on the floor and tuck your toes under.
Walk your feet towards your head and lift your hips up.
Straighten your legs and find your balance. Hold for several breaths and then release.
records.name: Headstand

instructions: Start standing at the top of your mat with your feet wide apart.
Interlace your fingers behind your back and inhale to expand your chest.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands up and over your head towards the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release the hands and come back up to standing.
records.name: Wide Legged Forward Fall

instructions: Start seated or standing with your arms at your sides.
Bring your hands behind your back and interlace your fingers with your palms facing up.
Inhale and draw your shoulder blades together, lifting your chest.
Exhale and gently press your hands down towards the floor as you continue to lift your chest.
records.name: Reverse Prayer

instructions: Hold the bosu vertically.
Raise the bosu toward the ceiling while keeping your elbows mostly extended.
records.name: Bosu Ball Front Raise

instructions: Place feet on Bosu, hips high, hands on the floor.
Lower the head towards the ground, then push back up.
Keep legs straight and hips elevated throughout.
records.name: Bosu Ball Pike Pushup

instructions: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
lower the bar and repeat.
records.name: Smith Machine Upright Row

instructions: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the bar to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the bar upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Rotate torso slightly, engaging obliques as you begin rolling back.
Maintain rotation and bend elbows, keeping shoulders relaxed and spine controlled.
Roll back up with control, returning to center without losing tension.
records.name: Back Rowing Preps Roll Down With Obliques

instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the barbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.
records.name: Barbell Deadlift

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back, squeezing your shoulder blades and raising your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the bar by straightening your legs, and take a step back.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.
records.name: Barbell Squat

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.
records.name: Barbell Step Up

instructions: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and push your heels into the floor.
Try to extend your knees and hips simultaneously.
records.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift

instructions: Place the bar on top of your traps.
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.
records.name: Barbell High Bar Squat

instructions: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Stand with a barbell at your shins with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend forward at your hips and keep your knees as fully extended as possible.
Grab the barbell and then extend your hips while maintaining a straight back.
From the standing position, lower the weight in a controlled manner.
You can either lower the weight to the floor or before you touch the floor, depending on your mobility.
records.name: Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlifts

instructions: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.
records.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.
records.name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Pull your shoulder blades back really hard and place the bar on your posterior delts.
Push your hips back and break at the knees to initiate the squat.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the ground. Push your heels into the floor and squat back up to a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Low Bar Squat

instructions: Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Staggered Deadlift

instructions: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Front Squat Bodybuilding

instructions: Place the bar between your traps and rear delts. Pull your shoulder blades back to give the bar a shelf to sit on.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. This means you're nearing the end of your Range of Motion with out rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you'e in a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Low Bar Good Morning

instructions: Start by pushing your hips straight back and extending your non-working leg behind you. It is ok to touch your other foot back to the ground each rep.
Leave your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstring. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: Place the bar on your traps. You may need a pad so the bar doesn't dig into your cervical spine.
Push your hips straight back. Your knees should stay MOSTLY extended (think soft knees). Also make sure to
Look for what feels like a stretch in your hamstrings. The stretch feeling means you're likely nearing the end of your Range of Motion without rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're in a standing position.
records.name: Barbell High Bar Good Morning

instructions: Position the barbell across your upper back and take a wide stance.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your chest raised and descend as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Barbell Cossack Squat

instructions: Stand beside the barbell, holding its end between your thighs.
Step wide and bend the outside knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your chest raised and lower as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then repeat.
records.name: Landmine Cossack Squat

instructions: Face the landmine, holding the barbell end against your chest.
Step wide and shift toward one side, bending that knee.
Keep the opposite leg straight and descend as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Landmine Goblet Cossack Squat

instructions: Hold the barbell end at your chest and face a stable platform.
Place one foot completely on the platform and brace your core.
Drive through the elevated foot to stand on the platform.
Step down slowly and repeat before switching legs.
records.name: Landmine Goblet Step Up

instructions: Sit against a bench with the padded barbell across one hip.
Plant one foot firmly and raise the opposite leg.
Drive through the planted foot and extend your hips upward.
Squeeze your glute, then lower your hips slowly.
records.name: Landmine Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: Sit against a bench with the padded barbell resting across your hips.
Plant your feet firmly and brace your upper back against the bench.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips upward.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower your hips under control.
records.name: Landmine Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
records.name: Barbell Pause Box Squat

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, pausing for a moment at the bottom of the movement before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
records.name: Barbell Pause Squat

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor behind you, with the weight plates on either side.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
records.name: Barbell Reverse Deadlift

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Reverse Lunge

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Side Step Up

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor in front of you, with the weight plates on either side. Make sure that the bar is directly in line with your feet.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands much wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the ground, making sure to keep your back straight and your shoulders down throughout the movement.
records.name: Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart. The bar should be in a rack or box so it's lifted off the ground.
Grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands should be much wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hing forward at the hips keeping your knees mostly extended. Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you are back in a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Snatch Grip Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Split Squat

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.
records.name: Barbell Step Up Balance

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a barbell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the barbell down towards the ground.
As the barbell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the barbell on the opposite side of your body.
records.name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Sit back and lower your body down until your glutes tap the top of the box, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand up, bringing your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Tap Pause Squat

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Zercher Good Morning

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Zercher Squat

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips, and cross one leg over the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Raise one leg up and off the box.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Place one foot about 6-9 inches in front of the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions: Set up the landmine attachment and load weight.
Stand facing the landmine, holding the weight away from your chest.
Step backward with one leg, lunge down while twisting your torso toward the front leg, return to starting position, and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge And Twist

instructions: Stand facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar at your side with one hand.

With the leg on the same side of your body as the barbell, lunge backward and across your body at a 45 degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to lower your back knee gently to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Start on your hands and knees perpendicular to the barbell with the end of the barbell resting on the inside of your knee that is closer to the bar.
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a 90 degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the barbell.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Glute Kick Back

instructions: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar in the goblet position in front of your chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Step backward and across your body with one leg at a 45 degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to gently lower your back knee to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back up and to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching legs.
records.name: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar close to your chest in the goblet position with your elbows tucked in close to your body.

Step directly out to the side with both toes pointing forward. Keep your weight on the heel of the leg you step out with as you sink down over that foot while your other leg remains straight for balance.
Drive through the heel over which you have centered your body as you step back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Goblet Lateral Lunge

instructions: Start facing away from the landmine attachment with the end of the barbell resting on one shoulder against the base of your neck while leaning slightly back into the weight of the barbell.

Squat down with control while keeping the weight of the barbell as close to centered over your midpoint as possible, then drive through your heels to stand all the way back up and return to starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch the side of your body the barbell is on every subsequent set.
records.name: Landmine Hack Squat

instructions: Stand facing the landmine with your feet shoulder width apart while holding the end of the barbell in your hands with your arms fully extended down towards the ground.
While keeping your torso tall and core engaged, step directly out to one side, using the foot you have stepped out with to sit down into the lunge while keeping your other leg straight.
Drive through your heel on your bent leg as your step together to return to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps on the same side before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Lateral Lunge

instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, holding it at at your side with your palm facing in towards your leg.

Take a step backward with your foot on the same side that you're holding the barbell, lowering your body into a lunge position. Bend both knees to lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows. Keep your torso upright, your chest lifted, and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Lunge

instructions: Stand facing the landmine attachment while holding the end of the bar with one hand at your shoulder on the same side with your elbow tucked to your body underneath your wrist.

Step back with the leg on the same side that you are holding the bar on and with control lower yourself down into a lunge position while keeping your core engaged and torso tall, then drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position.
Once your feet are back in the starting position, drive the bar up overhead until your arm is fully extended, then lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeated for the desired number of reps, then switch sides.
records.name: Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press

instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, palms facing each other, and hold it in front of your thighs.

Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and push your hips back, allowing the landmine to travel down your thighs. Lower the landmine by bending forward at the hips while keeping your back flat, allowing the barbell to move closer to the floor. Continue the movement until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your legs relatively straight but with a slight bend in the knees.
Reverse the movement by pushing your hips forward and driving through your heels while keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell with the end of the bar in front of your feet. Squat down and hold the end of the bar with your hand closer to the landmine attachment with your palm facing your body.

Drive your feet into the ground to start the motion. As your legs fully extend, pull the bar upwards with your hand and start to rotate your torso in towards the landmine attachment. As you do so, bring your other hand up to the bar and switch your grip. Press through the bar to extend your arm all the way upright, pivoting your back foot to allow for more trunk rotation.
Perform the movement in reverse to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Rotational Lift To Press

instructions: Setup a landmine with your back on a box.
Lay the end of the bar over your hip.
Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel a contraction, then bring your hips back toward the floor.
records.name: Landmine Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: Grab the end of the landmine and stand perpendicular to the bar.
Lift your inside leg and keep your outside leg planted.
Push your hips back keeping your knees mostly extended. When you feel the stretch in your hams, push your hips forward until you are standing upright.
records.name: Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Hold the end of the bar in front of you.
Pop your hips, pull your elbows up to the ceiling, and get underneath the bar.
records.name: Landmine Snatch

instructions: Hold the end of the bar in a goblet position.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Reach at least parallel with the ground before pushing through your heels back to the starting position.
records.name: Landmine Squat

instructions: Stand in a staggered position. With the back leg bent and the front mostly extended.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch through your front hamstring.
Push your hips back forward until you are standing.
records.name: Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Stand with a wide stance and straddle over the end of the bar.
Bend at the hips and knees, and grab the bar.
Stand up with the bar.
records.name: Landmine Sumo Deadlift

instructions: Hold the bar with a goblet position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the goblet position before starting the next rep.
records.name: Landmine Thruster

instructions: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Barbell Figure Four Hip Thrust

instructions: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Wrap a pair of lifting straps around the bar. Hold the ends of the straps. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.
records.name: Barbell Front Squat With Straps

instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on the ground and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other. Put one foot on a low box or plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Barbell Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Place both feet on a plate or low box. Have the barbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Bar on your back.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.
records.name: Barbell Kickstand Squat

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart with the bar on the ground at your side.
Lift the bar to your side and walk for the allotted amount of time or distance.
Set the bar down and switch sides.
records.name: Barbell Suitcase Carry

instructions: Set up for a sumo deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Barbell Sumo Pause Deadlift

instructions: Stand centered over the barbell, feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar with both hands, one in front, one behind.
Lift by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight, then lower slowly.
records.name: Barbell Jefferson Deadlift

instructions: Set up for a standard deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Barbell Conventional Pause Deadlift

instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, plates should be on blocks, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.
records.name: Barbell Block Conventional Deadlift

instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, feet should be on a plate or elevated platform, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.
records.name: Barbell Deficit Conventional Deadlift

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, and keep your back straight.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while pulling the barbell upward.
As the bar rises, pull it close to your body, leading with your elbows until it reaches chest level.
records.name: Barbell High Pull

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, gripping the barbell with a wide (snatch-width) grip. Keep your back straight, chest up, and bar close to your body.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell up explosively.
Shrug your shoulders forcefully and pull the bar as high as possible, keeping elbows above the bar.
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner and reset for the next rep.
records.name: Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull

instructions: Have the barbell in a high bar position and place your foot on a plate or a low box.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.
records.name: Barbell Quad Stomp

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet on a plate and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Step back with one foot off the plate and lower your back knee to the floor.
Push through your front leg and bring your back foot to the plate.
records.name: Barbell Zercher Deficit Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, barbell in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Barbell Front Rack Deficit Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, barbell on your back, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Barbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, bar on your back, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Barbell Deficit Lunge

instructions: Loop resistance bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, push hips back, and lower until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels, extend hips and knees, and return to standing tall.
records.name: Barbell Banded Back Squat

instructions: Loop bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, keep your back flat, and lower to grasp the bar.
Drive through heels, extend hips and knees, and stand tall with shoulders back.
records.name: Barbell Banded Deadlift

instructions: Loop bands under your feet and around the anchors, bar resting on front delts.
Keep chest tall, brace core, and lower until thighs reach parallel.
Drive through midfoot, extend hips and knees, and return to standing upright.
records.name: Barbell Banded Front Squat

instructions: Loop bands under your feet or anchors and around the barbell. Stand tall with soft knees.
Hinge at the hips, keeping the bar close and back straight throughout.
Squeeze glutes, drive hips forward, and return to full standing position.
records.name: Barbell Banded Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Loop band under front foot and around barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower back knee toward the floor while keeping front knee over ankle.
Push through front heel and drive up to starting position under control.
records.name: Barbell Banded Split Squat

instructions: Hold barbell in front rack position and place one foot on the platform.
Drive through the front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Barbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold barbell on upper back and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Barbell Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Stand inside trap bar, grip handles, stand tall.
Step one foot backward into lunge position.
Lower until front thigh is parallel to ground.
Push through front heel to return standing.
records.name: Trap Bar Reverse Lunge

instructions: Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Trap Bar Split Squat

instructions: Stand inside trap bar, lift one foot slightly off ground.
Hinge hips back while lowering bar and extending free leg behind.
Keep hips square and back neutral throughout movement.
Drive through standing foot to return upright.
records.name: Trap Bar Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: Stand inside trap bar, feet shoulder-width, grip handles.
Sit hips down and back, keeping chest upright.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.
records.name: Trap Bar Squat

instructions: Stand inside trap bar. Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Trap Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Stand on elevated surface inside trap bar, feet hip-width.
Grip handles, brace core, maintain neutral spine.
Drive through feet, extend hips and knees to stand.
Lower under control, maintaining balance on platform.
records.name: Trap Bar Deficit Deadlift

instructions: Set up inside trap bar with strong brace and neutral spine.
Lift bar slightly, pause just below knees.
Hold tension, then continue to full lockout.
Lower bar slowly back to floor.
records.name: Trap Bar Pause Deadlift

instructions: Hold trap bar, stand tall with slight knee bend.
Hinge hips back, lowering bar along thighs.
Keep back neutral and tension in hamstrings.
Drive hips forward to return upright.
records.name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.
records.name: Ez Bar Zercher Squat

instructions: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Ez Bar Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Hold the barbell near your shoulder and assume a staggered stance.
Bend both knees, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front foot flat and torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
records.name: Landmine Split Squat

instructions: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.
records.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: Place your shoulder blades against a box or bench that won't move.
Both your feet should be planted and your heels should not come off the floor. Point your toes forward.
Break at the hips. Seek the longest range of motion possible. Focus on the top end of the movement. Push your hips as high as possible on each rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Push your butt back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended.
You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward to complete the rep.
Do not push your hips all the way forward. This will hyperextend your spine. Just go to a normal standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with both feet planted. Make sure you keep your heels glued to the floor.
Place the dumbbell on your hips. Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel your glutes contract.
Then return to the floor.
records.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge

instructions: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat

instructions: Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine. This will help to stabilize your body. Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step to the side with your right foot, planting it firmly on the ground.
As you step, bend your right knee and lower your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground. Your left leg should remain straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Lateral Lunge

instructions: Hold the dumbbell in a goblet position. With your elbows directly under your fists.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended. You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Good Morning

instructions: Holding the dumbbell in a goblet squat place your foot on a bench or box.
Break at the hips and knees. Try to go to the point where your hamstring is parallel with the ground. Or until your back knee taps the floor.
Make sure to keep your back flat and your elbows directly under your fists.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest and take a wide stance.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while keeping the opposite leg straight.
Keep your chest raised and descend as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Cossack Squat

instructions: Hold dumbbell between your legs and stand with a wide stance.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while keeping the opposite leg straight.
Lower comfortably, keeping your chest raised and working foot flat.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat

instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet wide.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your torso upright and descend as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Cossack Squat

instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Dumbbell Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side and place opposite foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold dumbbells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold one dumbbell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in front rack position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Stability Ball Wall Squat

instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in each hand.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.
records.name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Wall Squat

instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.
records.name: Stability Ball Goblet Wall Squat

instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in goblet squat position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
Stand on a platform, dumbbell in goblet squat position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Deficit Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Curtsy Deficit Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge

instructions: Place your front foot on a low box and take a split stance. Put all of your weight on your front foot.
Break at the knees and lower yourself until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Push yourself back to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Quad Stomp

instructions: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Waiters Bow

instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Staggered Waiters Bow

instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Dumbbell Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in a goblet position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, dumbbell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.
records.name: Dumbbell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: Stand tall, holding dumbbells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Forward Lunge

instructions: Hold two dumbbells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Reverse Lunge

instructions: Hold one dumbbell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Lateral Lunge

instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Alternating Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Dumbbells at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.
records.name: Dumbbell Swing Lunge

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.
records.name: Dumbbell Kickstand Squat

instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Box Squat

instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Step Up

instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Step Up

instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up

instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your shoulder with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Step Up

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a dumbbell in your hands. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Side Step Up

instructions: Begin by standing beside a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Side Step Up

instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box and a dumbbell on your hips.
