Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Place both feet on a plate or low box. Have the dumbbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
flex your knees and hips and sit back into the squat while lowering your body
Continue down to full depth
Return to starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Squat

instructions: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position
records.name: Glute Bridge

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent and raise one leg.
Without changing the bend in your knee, bend at your hips, and lower your torso until it's almost parallel to the floor.
Tense your glutes and then bring yourself back to the starting position.
records.name: Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts

instructions: Get down on all fours and position your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Kick back with one leg and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to starting position by bending your knee and lowering your leg.
Switch Legs. Repeat.
records.name: Kickbacks

instructions: Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until your rear knee nearly touches the ground.
Ensure you remain upright, and your front knee stay above the front foot.
Push off the floor with your front foot until you return to the starting position. Switch legs.
records.name: Forward Lunges

instructions: Stand with your feet a little past shoulder width apart with a slight bend at your knee. Place your hands behind the back of your head.
Keeping your back straight, rotate your hips to bring your shoulders down towards the floor. Stop when your chest is parallel with the floor.
records.name: Good Mornings

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
When you land, lower your body back into the squat position.
records.name: Jump Squats

instructions: Stand with your back to a bench (or raised surface) and place one of your feet on the bench.
Squat down until your front leg is about parallel to the floor.
Go back to the starting position. After completing the desired amount of reps, switch legs and repeat.
records.name: Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: Take a slow, lateral step to the right.
Extend the left knee, and drive your weight into your right side.
Flex your knee and lower your body.
Push back to the starting position.
records.name: Side Lunges

instructions: Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position.
Push your hips up, so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Lie down with one knee bent and and one with a slight bend.
records.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes pointed slightly outward.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your chest raised and working foot flat as you descend.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Bodyweight Cossack Squat

instructions: Stand tall on platform and cross free leg diagonally behind you.
Lower body by bending standing knee, keeping hips square.
Drive through standing heel to return upright with control.
records.name: Bodyweight Curtsy Step Down

instructions: Place one knee on a bench.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Half Kneeling Hip Hinge

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, placing a stability ball between your lower back and wall.
Slowly squat down by bending knees to 90 degrees, keeping back straight and core engaged.
Press through heels, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.
records.name: Stability Ball Wall Squat

instructions: Lie face-down on a stability ball, hips centered, feet anchored, hands behind your head.
Engage your core, lift your upper body until aligned with legs, keeping your neck neutral.
Lower your torso slowly back to the starting position, maintaining control and steady breathing.
records.name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Hyperextension

instructions: Lie face down on a stability ball, hands on the floor, legs extended straight.
Engage glutes and lower back, raising legs until aligned with your torso.
Slowly lower legs back down without touching the ground, maintaining core engagement. Repeat.
records.name: Stability Ball Reverse Hyperextension

instructions: Sit on the floor, place upper back on a stability ball, feet flat, knees bent.
Drive hips upward by squeezing glutes, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower hips slowly without touching the floor, maintaining core engagement, then repeat.
records.name: Stability Ball Hip Thrust

instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a ball.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the bar.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Stability Ball Glute Bridge

instructions: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, legs straight, arms by your sides.
Press through your heels, lift hips, engage glutes and core, forming a straight line.
Slowly lower hips, maintaining control, then repeat for reps.
records.name: Stability Ball Straight Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: Lie on the ball, one foot on the ground.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Stability Ball Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: Start by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet in a staggered position on the box.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, making sure to keep your feet and knees pointing forward.
records.name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge

instructions: Stand in front of a box.
*Start with a low box if this is your first time*
Sink into a quarter of half squat and then pop your hips forward.
Try to land in the middle of the box as softly as possible to minimise impact on your joints.
records.name: Box Jump

instructions: Stand on top of a box. Step off of the box and land on the floor.
Land as softly as possible. Squat as you land to minimise impact on your joints.
Go straight into another hop after you've landed. This will help you learn to absorb impact.
records.name: Depth Jump

instructions: Setup two boxes. One to jump on and one to sit.
Go from a seated position and pop your hips forward forcefully.
Jump and land on the box softly.
records.name: Seated Box Jump

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Jump onto your box and land with one foot.
Try to land in the middle of the box and land as softly as possible.
records.name: Single Leg Box Jump

instructions: Start in a standing position.
Lunge forward, switch legs mid-air.
Land and repeat.
records.name: Bodyweight Alternating Jump Lunge

instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot resting on top of a box,  and cross one leg over the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Put your shoulder blades on a bench. Both feet on a low box or a plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Bodyweight Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Jump laterally and fall into a squat. Tap the ground.
Jump the opposite direction
records.name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge Jump

instructions: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.
records.name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat

instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.
records.name: Bodyweight Swing Lunge

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.
records.name: Bodyweight Swingthrough Lunge

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Narrow your stance while in the air, and land softly. Go directly into another rep.
records.name: In And Out Jump Squat

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, tap the floor, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Bring your feet mostly together, tap your toes back to the floor, then bring your feet back their original width.
records.name: Bodyweight Pop Squat

instructions: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.
records.name: Bodyweight Alternating Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Step right, lunge to side.
Return, then lunge left.
records.name: Bodyweight Alternating Lateral Lunge

instructions: Stand with feet together.
Step back with right foot.
Return to starting position, then lunge with left foot.
records.name: Bodyweight Alternating Reverse Lunges

instructions: Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).
records.name: Bodyweight Hip Abduction

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, bring your off leg all the way through until your leg is parallel with the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.
records.name: Bodyweight Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Lie on your back. Place one heel on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hip and knee.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heel into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.
records.name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Unilateral

instructions: Lie on your back. Place your heels on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hips and knees.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.
records.name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Bilateral

instructions: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and heels dug in.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Hold the position for the specified duration.
records.name: Hamstring Bridge Isometric Open Angle

instructions: Lie on your back. Bend your knees so your feet are flat on the floor with heels under knees
Push through your heels into the ground, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees. Squeeze your bum at the top of the movement
Maintain the top position and extend one leg at the time.
records.name: Glute Bridge Isometric Hold Single Alternate

instructions: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and raise one leg off the ground.
Lower slowly to the start position.
records.name: Glute Bridge Eccentric Unilateral

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position. Then switch legs.
records.name: Bodyweight Alternating Forward Lunge

instructions: Take a step forward shifting your weight onto the front leg.
Bend the knee of the front leg so the knee of the back leg comes close to the ground.
Stand up and go into lunging with the opposite leg.
records.name: Walking Lunge

instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
records.name: Bodyweight Box Squat

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.
records.name: Bodyweight Kickstand Squat

instructions: Sit with one leg in front of you flat on the ground.
While the other leg is to your side, also flat on the ground with your foot pointed backwards.
Hold this position for the prescribed amount of time then change sides.
records.name: Bodyweight Ninety Ninety Hip Stretch

instructions: Stand on one leg, extend the other forward for balance.
Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and core tight.
Press through your heel to stand back up, repeat.
records.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Squat

instructions: Stand on a platform, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.
records.name: Bodyweight Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Bodyweight Staggered Waiters Bow

instructions: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Bodyweight Waiters Bow

instructions: Place your foot on a plate or a low box.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.
records.name: Bodyweight Quad Stomp

instructions: Stand on a platform, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
records.name: Bodyweight Curtsy Deficit Lunge

instructions: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Machine Leg Press

instructions: Put the belt around your waist and hook the end of the belt onto the machines.
Stand up to disengage the holding mechanism. Hold the arms while you squat.
Once you've completed your set, reset the holding mechanism.
records.name: Machine Belt Squat

instructions: Lay on the pad and place your feet on the foot plate.
Lift the plate up and disengage the holding hook.
Lower the weight. Stop before your lower back rounds off the pad.
Press the weight back to the starting position.
records.name: Vertical Leg Press

instructions: Sit on the seat upright with your knees placed on the pads and your feet on the foot pads.
Push your legs outwards and backwards and flex your glutes.
records.name: Gluteator

instructions: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press

instructions: Adjust machine settings to fit your height. Sit with back flat against pad, legs together.
Slowly press legs apart against resistance. Pause at peak.
Slowly return legs to starting position. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Machine Hip Abduction

instructions: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the opposing hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg outward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.
records.name: Machine Hip And Glute Abduction

instructions: Stand on the platform and sideways on the machine.
Place the pad at just above hip height. Place the working leg over the pad.
Extend the working leg backwards and flex your glute at the end of each rep.
records.name: Machine Hip And Glute Kickback

instructions: Lay on the pad and grab the handles.
Slip your legs into the belt loop.
Push your legs back until they are horizontal with the ground.
Lower back to the starting position.
records.name: Machine Reverse Hyperextension

instructions: Position yourself in the pendulum squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Keep your back straight, and slowly lower into a squat position.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.
records.name: Machine Pendulum Squat

instructions: This particular leg press has two separate foot plates. There are holding pins on both sides. Engage the pin on one side.
Lower the weight but stop before your lower back begins to round.
Press back to the starting position.
records.name: Machine Single Leg Leg Press

instructions: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Machine Squat Press

instructions: Adjust the machine for your height, sit with your back against the pad, knees bent, feet flat on the platform.
Brace your core, push through your heels, and extend your hips upwards, lifting the weight while squeezing your glutes.
Lower the weight slowly back to the starting position, ensuring controlled movement; repeat for desired reps and sets.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Hip Thrust

instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Press through your heels to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.
records.name: Horizontal Hack Squat

instructions: Grab the handles, place one knee on the pad, and the foot of the working leg on the foot plate.
Push your working leg back until you feel your glute contract, then return to the starting position without resting the weights.
records.name: Machine Glute Kickback

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding medicine ball close.
Squat down, keeping ball close to head and chest.
Stand back up, squeezing glutes. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Medicine Ball Ball Headlock Squat

instructions: Hold medicine ball at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping ball on same side throughout movement.
Stand back up, squeezing glutes. Repeat on other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Ball Offset Squat

instructions: Hold medicine ball overhead.
Squat down, keeping back straight.
Stand back up. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Medicine Ball Overhead Squat

instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Step back into lunge position.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.
records.name: Medicine Ball Reverse Lunge

instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Step back into lunge position, extend your arms, twist torso.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.
records.name: Medicine Ball Reverse Lunge Twist

instructions: Hold medicine ball while standing on one leg.
Hinge forward on one leg, extending other leg behind.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.
records.name: Medicine Ball Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell in front of you, squat down until your thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Forward Lunge

instructions: Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Step Up

instructions: Sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted firmly on the floor, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust

instructions: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees and keep your back straight.
Return to the upright position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift (Single)

instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell between your legs, with your knees slightly bent.
Keeping your back straight, swing the kettlebell upwards until the kettlebell is level with your chest and carefully lower.
Repeat
records.name: Kettlebell Swing

instructions: Stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your back straight and hold the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Take a large step to one side, holding the kettlebell low and lunge into the bent leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat
records.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge (Single)

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend forward at the hips keeping your back and knees straight and the kettlebell close to your chest.
Return to standing position and thrust your pelvis forward.
records.name: Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, lifting one foot off the floor behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the lifted leg.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you extend your lifted leg behind you, keeping your back straight - holding out your arm to the side for balance.
Return to the upright position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
Pushing through the legs and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Glute Bridge

instructions: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell behind you, squat down until your back knee touches the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Lunge

instructions: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders and the heels slightly raised on a surface.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Heels Up Goblet Squat

instructions: Laying on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
Pushing through the bent leg and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis and the extended leg off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions: Sitting on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: Hold one kettlebell at your chest and take a wide stance.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your chest raised and working foot flat.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Kettlebell Goblet Cossack Squat

instructions: Hold kettlebell(s) between your thighs and stand with a wide stance.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your chest raised and descend as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Kettlebell Cossack Squat

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend at hips and knees to lift kettlebells.
Stand tall, then lower.
records.name: Kettlebell Conventional Deadlift (Double)

instructions: Begin with a two kettlebells between your legs, hinge at hips, then swing it upwards explosively.
As they rise, lock out arm overhead, wrist straight.
Control the descent, then repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Snatch (Double)

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebells outside legs
Hinge at hips, swing kettlebells forward, then back.
Thrust hips to swing kettlebells upward, keeping arms straight.
records.name: Kettlebell Swing (Double)

instructions: Begin seated, kettlebell on hips.
Lift hips, form figure four leg shape.
Lower, repeat thrusts.
records.name: Kettlebell Figure Four Hip Thrust

instructions: Hold kettlebell at your side.
Step forward, lunge, and return.
Repeat with opposite leg.
records.name: Kettlebell Forward Lunge (Double)

instructions: Hold kettlebells in front rack.
Step back and lunge diagonally.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)

instructions: Start with kettlebells in front rack.
Step forward into lunge.
Return to starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and swing it overhead.
Extend hips and knees, lock out arms at the top.
records.name: Kettlebell Full Swing

instructions: Hold kettlebells in front of you.
Step sideways, lunge down and let the kettlebells land between your legs.
Push off, return to start. Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge

instructions: Hold kettlebells at your side.
Step backward, lower body.
records.name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding kettlebells in front.
Hinge at hips, keeping back straight, and lower kettlebells towards ground.
Return to start position, squeezing glutes at the top.
records.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Begin with the kettlebell between your legs.
Hinge at your hips, and lift to shoulder, then press overhead.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Press

instructions: Hold kettlebell in one hand.
Step back, left leg behind right.
Return to start position. Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
Step backward, lunge. Bring your back knee to the floor.
Extend your knee back into the starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Reverse Lunge

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Squat, grip kettlebell, explode hips, and lift kettlebell overhead.
Lower kettlebell safely to start position.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs, grip with one hand, hinge at hips.
Swing kettlebell forcefully forward, using hip thrust, arm straight.
Swing kettlebell back between legs, repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing

instructions: Begin with feet hip-width apart, one foot forward, kettlebell between feet.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and stand tall.
Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift

instructions: Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.
Explosively thrust hips forward, swing kettlebell to chest height.
Repeat for desired reps, keeping core engaged and maintaining a staggered stance for balance.
records.name: Kettlebell Staggered Swing

instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Bend at hips and knees, keeping back straight, and grip the kettlebell handle.
Lift the kettlebell by extending hips and knees, stand up straight, and return to the starting position.
records.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift

instructions: Start with a kettlebell between your legs, hinge at hips, swing it upward.
Lift kettlebell to chest level, elbows high, engaging shoulders.
Lower kettlebell back down, maintaining control. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Swing To Upright Row

instructions: Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Step Up Double

instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a kettlebell in one hand
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Balance

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the kettlebell down towards the ground.
As the kettlebell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the kettlebell on the opposite side of your body.
records.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift

instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.
records.name: Kettlebell Box Squat

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.
records.name: Kettlebell Kickstand Squat

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Kettlebell at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.
records.name: Kettlebell Swing Lunge

instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Hold one kettlebell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Lateral Lunge

instructions: Hold two kettlebells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Reverse Lunge

instructions: Stand tall, holding kettlebells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.
records.name: Kettlebell Alternating Forward Lunge

instructions: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, kettlebell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.
records.name: Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions: Stand on a platform, kettlebells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Kettlebell Staggered Waiters Bow

instructions: Stand on a platform, kettlebells in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.
records.name: Kettlebell Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Kettlebell Waiters Bow

instructions: Place your foot on a plate or a low box. Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.
records.name: Kettlebell Quad Stomp

instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Hold kettlebell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and stable.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold kettlebells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold one kettlebell at your side and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive

instructions: Hold kettlebells at your shoulders and stand with your feet wide.
Shift toward one side, bending that knee while straightening the opposite leg.
Keep your torso upright and descend as deeply as comfortable.
Push through the bent leg to return, then alternate sides.
records.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Cossack Squat

instructions: On your front, place one leg forward and then stretch out the same side arm across the mat/floor.
Fully extend your leg and arm.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Glutes Stretch Variation One

instructions: Sit on the ground and lay one leg flat and the other over the top.
Hold your leg with the same side arm and slowly rotate your hips and back.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Glutes Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Lay flat and bring your left leg to 90 degrees.
Hold your left leg with both hands and slowly rotate your hips to the right hand side.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Glutes Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.
records.name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Glute Kickback

instructions: Start with a straight bar or ez bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.
records.name: Cable Bar Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Get your elbows directly underneath the bar, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.
records.name: Cable Goblet Squat

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Face sideways with the ankle attachment on your outside leg. Walk a few steps away.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).
records.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction

instructions: You can use a straight or EZ bar on this exercise. Cable should be set all to the bottom.
Grab the attachment and walk back a few steps. Take a split stance. One leg in front and one behind.
Break at the knees and hips to initiate the split squat. Make sure your back knee touches the floor.
Squat back up into a standing position.
records.name: Cable Split Squat

instructions: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.

Push your butt back to initiate the movement while lifting one of your legs.
Then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
Compete your given amount of reps, then switch to opposite leg.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back.
records.name: Cable Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: This exercise works best with a rope attachment but can be done with anything. The attachment should be set to the bottom of the machine.

Face away from the cable machine, straddle the cable itself, and grab the attachment.
Walk a few steps away.
Break at the hips while maintaining a flat back and mostly extended knees.
Push hips forward until you are back in a standing position.
records.name: Cable Pull Through

instructions: Put on a dip belt. Attach the strap/chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back. Begin to squat by flexing at the knees and hips.
Let the weight pull you forward as you squat. Then push your toes through the front of your shoes as you squat back to the start position.
records.name: Cable Belt Squat

instructions: Put on a dip belt and attach the strap/ chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back and take a split stance.
Lower into a split squat, letting the weight pull you forward. As you squat back to the starting position push yourself backwards against the resistance.
records.name: Cable Belt Split Squat

instructions: Start with handles set to the bottom of the machine. Grab a box, stand on top of the box, squat the weight up into a standing position.
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.
records.name: Cable Elevated Deadlift

instructions: Start with a straight bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
Stand with a staggered stance. Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.
records.name: Cable Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Zercher Good Morning

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
Break at the knee, push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.
records.name: Cable Standing Glute Kickback

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to halfway up the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.
records.name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Mid Kickback

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set halfway up the crossover machine.
Start with a bent knee position. Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.
records.name: Cable Standing Mid Kickback

instructions: Bring the cable all the way to the bottom of the stack. Use an ankle attachment.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to hip height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.
records.name: Cable Bench Straight Leg Kickback

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. Put the bench at incline level. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.
records.name: Cable Incline Bench Straight Leg Kickback

instructions: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Take a quadruped position with the cable going across your planted leg.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of the cables touching back down (to keep tension on the muscle).
records.name: Cable Quadruped Hip Abduction

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band loops in each of your hand.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.
records.name: Band Squat

instructions: Stand on your band with both feet.
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Push your hips back forward until you are in a standing position.
records.name: Band Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Get into a quadruped position. Loop the band around both of your wrists and one of your feet.
Extend your knee and hip straight back until you feel like contraction in the glutes.
Flex at the knee until back in the starting position.
records.name: Band Glute Kickback

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your head by the anchor point of the band, which should be 6 to 12 inches above your head
Place the band around your midfoot and extend at the knees and hip.
records.name: Band Leg Press

instructions: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Place the loops of the band behind your knees.
Perform a normal squat and extend your knees against the band at the top.
records.name: Band Spanish Squat

instructions: Anchor the band to the lowest point possible. Straddle the band and then grab with both hands.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your butt back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. Then extend the hips back into the starting position.
records.name: Band Pullthrough

instructions: Attach the band around your ankle. Stand with feet hip-width apart, feet facing forward, and hands on hips.
Lift your right leg away from your body to the side, keeping your knee straight. This is your starting position.

Maintaining proper form, move your right leg as far to the side as you can, keeping your left leg planted firmly on the ground. Hold for a second and then return your right leg to the starting position.
records.name: Band Hip Abduction

instructions: Attach a band to a stable anchor point, such as a door handle or post.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Band Hip Adduction

instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward.
Lower slowly without rotating hips backward.
records.name: Mini-Band Clamshell

instructions: Place a band either just below or above your knees.
Get into a quarter squat position.
Step side to side without letting there be any slack in the band to keep tension on the band.
records.name: Banded Side Walks

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band looped over both hands.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.
records.name: Band Goblet Squat

instructions: Stand on band and loop it around upper back, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips while keeping back flat and slight bend in knees.
Squeeze glutes to return to standing, maintaining band tension throughout.
records.name: Band Standing Good Morning

instructions: Loop band around feet, hold high plank.
Extend one leg back, squeezing glute at top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
records.name: Mini Band Plank Glute Kickback

instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward, push bottom knee into ground, and push your hips forward.
records.name: Mini Band Clamshell Raise

instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, maintaining constant band tension.
records.name: Mini Band Side Laying Hip Abduction

instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Lift hips into bridge, hold top position.
Pulse knees outward against band, controlling tension.
records.name: Mini Band Laying Glute Bridge Abduction

instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on band.
records.name: Mini Band Laying Hip Abduction

instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Drive through heels, lift hips until fully extended.
Lower slowly, keeping knees pressed outward.
records.name: Mini Band Glute Bridge

instructions: Loop band above knees, start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee outward, keeping hips level.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
records.name: Mini Band Fire Hydrant

instructions: Loop band above knees, stand feet shoulder width.
Squat down, knees pushed outward against band.
Explode upward into jump, land softly and reset.
records.name: Mini Band Jump Squat

instructions: Stand on band with one foot, hinge at hips.
Keep back flat, opposite leg extended behind.
Drive hips forward to return upright.
records.name: Mini Band Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: Loop band above knees, stand shoulder width.
Sit back and down, pushing knees outward.
Stand up, maintaining tension on band.
records.name: Mini Band Squat

instructions: Loop band above knees, slight athletic stance.
Step laterally, keeping knees pushed outward.
Continue stepping side to side under control.
records.name: Mini Band Side To Side

instructions: Loop band above knees, slight squat stance.
Step laterally, keeping constant outward knee pressure.
Continue walking side to side under control.
records.name: Mini Band Walking Side To Side

instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Extend one leg backward, squeezing glute.
Return slowly without arching lower back.
records.name: Mini Band Standing Glute Kickback

instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg out to side, torso upright.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
records.name: Mini Band Standing Hip Abduction

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands.
Keep your back straight, lower your body as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Go as low as you can while keeping your heels flat on the ground, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Squat

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up while pulling the plate towards the chest.
Keep shoulder level while keeping the elbows high and in front of the plate.
records.name: Plate Clean

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso.
Step back and across the body with the right foot, bending both legs to lower into a lunge position.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping back and across with the left foot.
Continue alternating sides for desired reps.
records.name: Plate Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate in front of the feet, and the knees slightly bent.
Bend the hips and knees to grip the plate with palms facing the body.
Keeping the back straight, stand up while lifting the plate off the ground.
Return the plate back to the starting position by bending the hips and knees, keeping control of the plate.
records.name: Plate Deadlift

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate held in front of you, and the knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping the back straight, until the torso is parallel to the floor.
Push through the hips to return to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Good Morning Anterior

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate held behind the neck and the knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping the back straight, until the torso is parallel to the floor.
Push through the hips to return to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Good Morning

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the plate held in front of the torso.
Take a step to the side with one foot, bending the knee and lowering the hips into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping to the other side with the other foot.
records.name: Plate Lateral Lunge

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the plate held in front of the torso.
Take a step forward with one foot, bending the front knee to lower the hips into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping forward with the other foot.
records.name: Plate Forward Lunge

instructions: Engage your core and straighten your legs to lift the plate off the ground.
Stand on one leg, keeping the other leg off the ground, while holding the plate in front of your body.
Keep your back straight and maintain a neutral head position while looking straight ahead.
Lower the plate back down to the ground while keeping your balance on one leg.
records.name: Plate Single Leg Deadlift

instructions: Step back with your right foot into a lunge position, both knees bent at 90 degrees.
Twist your torso to the right, keeping the plate close to your chest.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Plate Reverse Lunge Twist

instructions: Hold the plate at chest height close to your body
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
records.name: Plate Reverse Lunge

instructions: Hold a weight plate at arm's length overhead, with your arms fully extended. The plate should be directly above your head and your elbows should be locked.
Begin to bend your knees, lowering your body as far as you can while keeping the weight plate overhead. Make sure to keep your back straight and your chest lifted.
Once your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can go, pause for a moment.
Push through your heels to return to a standing position, keeping the weight plate overhead the entire time.
records.name: Plate Overhead Squat

instructions: Stand on a plate with both feet.
Step back with one foot to the floor and let your back knee get close to or tap the floor.
Push through your front leg until both feet are back on the plate.
records.name: Plate Deficit Lunge

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with a plate on your chest.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling and maintain that extended position.
Extend your elbows mostly, break at the shoulder joint while maintaining hip extension and the slight bend in your elbows.
Let the plate tap the floor (or get close) and then pull the plate back into the starting position.
records.name: Plate Glute Bridge to Pullover

instructions: Stand tall with a plate overhead.
Step with one foot forward bringing your back knee to the floor. Gently tap your knee then drive through your front leg.
Go back to a standing position and then step forward with the opposing legs.
records.name: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, with a weight plate held in both hands at chest height.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and your weight in your heels.
Go down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then pause for a moment.
Hold the squat position for the desired amount of time, keeping the weight plate steady and your core engaged.
records.name: Plate Squat Hold

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a weight plate.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plate towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once the plate is below your knees, drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Staggered Deadlift

instructions: Stand on a platform, Holding a plate to your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.
records.name: Plate Goblet Deficit Reverse Lunge

instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Plate Staggered Waiters Bow

instructions: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell. Hold a plate up to your chest.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Plate Waiters Bow

instructions: Stand tall holding plate against outer thigh or anchored between legs.
Lift leg outward to the side while keeping torso still and toes forward.
Lower slowly under control, maintaining tension on outer hip.
records.name: Plate Hip Abduction

instructions: Stand facing away from the anchor point, holding onto the TRX handles with both hands.
Step your left foot behind your right, crossing it behind your right leg, and lower yourself into a curtsy lunge.
Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat the movement with the other leg.
records.name: TRX Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the foot cradles of the TRX straps, with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Drive your hips up towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes and hamstrings at the top of the movement.
records.name: TRX Glute Bridge

instructions: Stand facing the TRX straps and place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Begin by lowering into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively jump up off the ground, using your arms for momentum if desired.
Land softly back in the squat position, making sure to absorb the impact with your legs.
records.name: TRX Jumping Squat

instructions: Grasp the TRX handles with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Step laterally to one side, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.
Lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your front knee bent at a 90-degree angle and your back leg straight.
Push off your front foot to return to the starting position, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.
records.name: TRX Lateral Lunge

instructions: Hold on to the TRX straps and step away until the strap is taut.
Step backwards with one leg in to a lunge position and gently tap your knee to the floor.
Lunge back to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
records.name: TRX Reverse Lunge

instructions: Hold the two TRX straps and step away until the straps are taut. Take a split stance.
Bring your back knee to the floor and gently tap the floor.
Use your arms and the TRX to help assist you getting back into the starting position.
records.name: TRX Split Squat

instructions: Hold the two TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Flex at the hips and knees in to a squat position.
You can use your arms and the straps to assist you back into the starting position.
records.name: TRX Squat

instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place a block under your left knee, then bend your right knee and stack it on top of your left ankle.
Flex both feet and gently press your knees towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hips.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Double Pigeon Pose

instructions: Sit on a yoga mat with legs straight in front of you.
Bend the right knee and place the right foot on top of the left thigh. Allow the right knee to fall towards the floor.
Bring the left foot onto the right thigh. Keep the spine straight and rest hands on the knees.
Hold for several breaths and then release.
records.name: Half Lotus

instructions: Extend your right leg behind you and place your right ankle on top of your left thigh, with your right knee pointing out to the side.
Sitting up straight, use your hands to gently press down on your right knee while at the same time pulling your left buttock back.
Hold for 5-10 deep breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Pigeon Pose

instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the ground.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure four shape.
Use your hands to gently pull your left knee towards your chest, feeling a stretch in your right hip.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Reclining Pigeon Pose

instructions: Start in a seated position with your legs extended in front of you.
Cross your right leg over your left leg, placing your right foot on the floor beside your left hip.
Cross your left leg over your right leg, placing your left foot on the floor beside your right hip.
Relax your arms by your sides or place them on your abdomen and take deep breaths.
records.name: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs

instructions: Lie on back, place feet on Bosu, knees bent.
Lift hips and squeeze glutes.
Lower hips back down to complete one rep.
records.name: Bosu Ball Feet Elevated Glute Bridge

instructions: Sit on Bosu, lean back, hands on the floor.
Drive hips upward, squeezing glutes.
Lower hips back down to complete one rep.
records.name: Bosu Ball Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand on Bosu, step sideways into a lunge.
Bend knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg, return to starting position.
records.name: Bosu Ball Lateral Lunge

instructions: Stand on Bosu, step backward into a lunge.
Bend knees, lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Push off the back foot, return to starting position.
records.name: Bosu Ball Reverse Lunge

instructions: Lie on back, place one foot on Bosu, knee bent.
Lift hips, squeezing glutes, one leg extended.
Lower hips back down and switch legs.
records.name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Elevated Glute Bridge

instructions: Sit on Bosu, lean back, one foot on the floor.
Drive hips upward, squeezing glutes, one leg extended.
Lower hips back down and switch legs.
records.name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: Stand in front of Bosu, one foot on the center.
Lower into a lunge position, knee at 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to starting position.
records.name: Bosu Ball Split Squat

instructions: Stand on Bosu, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping knees aligned with toes.
Push through heels to stand back up.
records.name: Bosu Ball Squat

instructions: Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Smith Machine Staggered Deadlift

instructions: Start on your hands and knees with one foot placed on the bottom of the bar.
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a 90 degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the bar.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Smith Machine Glute Kickback

instructions: Place your legs on the bar with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the floor. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Leg Press

instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on the ground and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Single Leg Hip Thrust

instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the bar over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust

instructions: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and unrack the bar
Leave your knees mostly extended and flex and extend your hips.
records.name: Smith Machine Sumo Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
records.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Take a large step forward with one leg until your shoulders are under the smith machine
lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Split Squat

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with the bar on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge

instructions: Place the bar on top of your traps. Take a narrow stance.
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.
records.name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat

instructions: Lie supine, one knee bent, opposite leg extended.
Press through one leg. Simultaneously pull the raised leg up to a table top position.
As you lower, bring your non-working leg back into extension.
records.name: Single Leg Bicycle

instructions: Lie supine, one foot planted, opposite leg in a tabletop position.
Engage core, maintain neutral pelvis.
records.name: Single Leg One Leg Bent

instructions: Lie supine, balls of feet on bar, heels lifted high.
Press bar away, extending legs while maintaining lifted heels.
Keep pelvis neutral, ribs down, and core engaged.
Bend knees to return smoothly, maintaining ankle stability and control.
records.name: Footwork High Half Toe

instructions: Lie supine, heels on bar hip-width, toes lifted slightly.
Press bar away, fully extending legs without locking knees.
Maintain neutral pelvis, ribs down, and steady core engagement.
Bend knees to return with control, keeping heels connected.
records.name: Footwork Heels On The Bar

instructions: Stand on reformer, feet on platforms, hinged forward, spine neutral.
Push carriage out.
Return to center with control, maintaining upright posture.
records.name: Side Splits Skating

instructions: Lie supine with knees bent, feet hip-width, arms relaxed by sides.
Inhale to prepare, exhale and posteriorly tilt pelvis.
Roll spine up one vertebra at a time into bridge.
Press through legs until legs are nearly extended. Lower back to start.
Then begin rolling your spine downward until your back is flat against the carriage.
records.name: Hip Rolls

instructions: Lie supine with knees bent, feet hip-width and flat. Hips slightly off the carriage.
Engage core and glutes, press through heels.
Maintain hip position as you press.
records.name: Hip Lift

instructions: Lie on reformer, heels together, toes apart on footbar.
Press carriage out by extending legs evenly.
Keep pelvis stable and core engaged.
Bend knees to return with control.
records.name: Pilates Footwork First Position

instructions: Lie on reformer, one heel on footbar, other leg extended.
Press carriage out using working leg.
Keep hips level and core engaged.
Bend knee to return with control.
records.name: Pilates Single Leg Heel

instructions: Stand beside reformer, one foot on carriage, one stable on floor.
Press carriage back by extending moving leg.
records.name: Pilates Scooter

instructions: Lay flat on a bench with a dumbbell between your feet.
Flex your knees and raise the dumbbell until the soles of your shoes are pointed at the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Leg Curl

instructions: Start by standing on one leg with a dumbbell in one hand.
Slowly bend at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground while extending your free leg behind you.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you lower the weight.
Once the dumbbell is close to the ground, push through your heel to return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift

instructions: Start by standing on one leg with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two dumbbells.
From this starting position, hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once you feel a stretch in your hamstring, slowly return to the starting position.
Make sure to keep your standing leg slightly bent and avoid rounding your back as you lower the dumbbell.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated on a step or weight plate.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the dumbbells towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once the dumbbells are below your knees, drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to swing the dumbbell between your legs.
From this starting position, explosively extend your hips and swing the dumbbell up to chest height.
Allow the momentum of the swing to carry the dumbbell back down between your legs, and then repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
records.name: Dumbbell Swing

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance holding one dumbbell. Push your butt back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended.
Reach toward the opposing leg. You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward to complete the rep.
Do not push your hips all the way forward. This will hyperextend your spine. Just go to a normal standing position.
records.name: Dumbbell Cross Body Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Go to your knees and ask someone to hold your ankles.
Put your hands in front of you
With a slight bend in your knees slowly bring your body to the ground (slower is better)
Push up and reset to the starting position.
records.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl

instructions: Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
records.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge

instructions: Lie on your back keeping both knees bent.
Have a slider under the heel of the working leg.
Extend and bend the working lag applying gentle downwards pressure.
records.name: Slider Hamstring Curl Single Leg

instructions: Lie on your back with bent knees and heels on a slider.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Extend and bend the working leg.
records.name: Single Leg Slider Hamstring Curl 2

instructions: Bend your knees so your feet are flat on the floor with heels under knees and toes raised.
Place sliders under your heels. Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the ground, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.
Extend your legs in a slow, controlled manner, to lower your bum to the ground.
Casually bend knees before repeating.
records.name: Slider Hamstring Curl Eccentric

instructions: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend and extend the non-weight bearing leg.
Knees should remain aligned.
records.name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl

instructions: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend the non-weight bearing leg and hold.
Knees should remain aligned.
records.name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl Isometric

instructions: Lie on your back with slightly bent knees and heels on sliders.
Pull your heels towards your glutes to lift your hips off the ground.
Extend knees to starting position, but do not rest hips on ground.
records.name: Slider Hamstring Curl

instructions: Hold on to something stable and pull the leg on the opposing side straight up. Hold this position.
records.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Balance Stable

instructions: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, arms flat, and core engaged.
Lift hips, curl the ball toward you using your hamstrings, keeping control and balance.
Extend legs back to start while keeping hips lifted, then repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl

instructions: Position yourself on a glute ham raise machine or find a suitable substitute like a stability ball or bench.
Adjust the equipment to fit your body by setting the footplate at an appropriate height and making sure your feet are securely anchored.
Begin the movement by slowly lowering your upper body towards the ground while keeping your torso and legs aligned.
