Once you reach the lowest point where your body is parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go, pause briefly.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings again as you push yourself back up to the starting position, using the strength of your posterior chain muscles.
records.name: Glute Ham Raise

instructions: Lay down on the machine, placing your legs beneath the padded lever. Position your legs so that the padded lever is below your calve muscles.
Support yourself by grabbing the side handles of the machine, and slowly raise the weight with your legs, toes pointed straight.
Pause at the apex of the motion, then slowly return to starting position.
records.name: Machine Hamstring Curl

instructions: Adjust the back pad and ankle pad to suit your height.
Disengage the knee pad and lower it as far as you can.
Flex your knees against resistance, then extend until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
records.name: Machine Seated Hamstring Curl

instructions: Lay down on the machine, placing your working leg beneath the padded lever. Position your leg so that the padded lever is below your calve muscle.
Support yourself by grabbing the side handles of the machine, and slowly raise the weight with your legs.
Pause at the apex of the motion, then slowly return to starting position.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Kneeling Hamstring Curl

instructions: Press yourself into the pads and put your calves against the lower pads.
Flex your knee until you feel a contraction in your hamstring, then lower back to the start.
records.name: Machine Standing Hamstring Curl

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Return to standing position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Single)

instructions: Lie down with your legs reaching up the wall. your bum should be slightly off the floor.
Bend one leg and leave the other outstretched.
Push your thigh towards the wall.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.
records.name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation One

instructions: Stand with one foot in front of the other.
Bend your rear leg as much as you can, keeping the front leg straight.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.
records.name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg outstretched and the other bent at the knee, foot resting on the opposite inner thigh.
Reach forward to touch the toes of the outstretched leg.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.
records.name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front of you.
Reach forward to try and touch your toes. Reach as far forward as you can go.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.
records.name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Use an ankle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Stand upright or try bending slightly forward.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.
records.name: Cable Hamstring Curl

instructions: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable at head height (when seated). Use an ankle attachment.
Sit on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.
records.name: Cable Seated Leg Curl

instructions: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable all the way at the bottom. Use an ankle attachment.
Lay on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.
records.name: Cable Single Leg Laying Leg Curl

instructions: Anchor the band at hip level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back while keeping your back flat until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
records.name: Band Good Morning

instructions: Start by facing the TRX straps and positioning yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ground and your feet in the TRX foot cradles.
Keeping your core engaged and body in a straight line, bend your knees and bring your heels towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
records.name: TRX Hamstring Curl

instructions: Start in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the floor.
Step your right foot forward, placing it between your hands.
Straighten your right leg and flex your toes towards your face, keeping your hands on the floor for support.
Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Half Monkey Pose

instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Reach for your feet or ankles, keeping your elbows straight.
Hold for several breaths, then release.
records.name: Seated Forward Bend

instructions: Begin in Tadasana (Mountain Pose) with two blocks at the top of your mat.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and place your heel down, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Place the blocks on either side of your right foot at a height that allows you to comfortably place your hands on them.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands to the blocks. Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Pyramid Pose Blocks

instructions: Begin in Tadasana (Mountain Pose).
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and place your heel down, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands to the floor on either side of your right foot.
Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Pyramid Pose

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a block on the ground in front of you.
Hinge forward at your hips and place your hands on the block.
Allow your head to hang heavy and feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Hold for a few breaths and then slowly roll up to a standing position.
records.name: Standing Forward Bend Blocks

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at your hips, reaching your hands towards the ground.
Allow your head to hang heavy and feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Hold for a few breaths and then slowly roll up to a standing position.
records.name: Standing Forward Bend

instructions: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and raise it off the ground, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and reach your arms forward, parallel to the ground.
Exhale and hinge forward at your hips, bringing your torso parallel to the ground and extending your left leg straight back. Keep your arms and right leg straight and hold the pose for a few breaths
inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.
records.name: Warrior Three

instructions: Start standing at the top of your mat with your feet wide apart.
Start standing at the top of your mat with your feet wide apart.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands up and over your head towards the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release the hands and come back up to standing.
records.name: Wide Legged Standing Forward Bend Holding Heels

instructions: Lie prone on long box, hips supported, straps around feet.
Start with legs extended, core engaged, pelvis neutral.
Bend knees, curling heels toward glutes using hamstrings.
Extend legs slowly, maintaining control and constant strap tension.
records.name: Feet Pulling Straps Hamstring Curls Prone On The Long Box

instructions: Lie prone, attach straps to ankles, legs extended.
Bend knees, pulling heels toward glutes.
Keep hips pressed down and core engaged.
Extend legs slowly back to start.
records.name: Pilates Hamtring Curls Prone

instructions: Lie flat on bench holding barbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower bar in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull bar back over chest using lats and triceps under control.
records.name: Barbell Pullover

instructions: Hold barbell behind hips with straight arms and palms facing back.
Keeping arms straight, lift bar slightly backward until lats engage.
Lower bar slowly to starting position while maintaining tension.
records.name: Barbell Shoulder Extension

instructions: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Row Bilateral

instructions: Grab a dumbbell and hold with both hands. Point your dumbbell at the ceiling.
Flex at the shoulder joint while keeping your elbows mostly extended.
Flex until you feel a stretch in your lats then bring the dumbbell back to the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Pullover

instructions: Start by hinging over with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing forward and your elbows slightly bent.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
records.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Extension

instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Weighted Pull Ups

instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Shoulder Extension

instructions: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower dumbbell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull dumbbell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping movement controlled.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pullover

instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.
records.name: Pull Ups

instructions: Grasp the rings with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the rings.
Lower your body back to starting position.
records.name: Ring Pull Up

instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Pull your legs up until you're in an "L" position.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.
records.name: L Sit Pull Up

instructions: Grip the bar with the palms facing forward, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width.
As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar, bring your torso back around 30 degrees while sticking your chest out.
Pull the bar down to about chin level or a little lower in a smooth movement whilst squeezing the shoulder blades together.
After a second of squeezing, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended.
records.name: Machine Pulldown

instructions: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Row

instructions: Hinge forward while keeping your back flat.
Grab the handles and pull the weight toward your chest.
Make sure to fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep. Also make sure to not use momentum.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded T Bar Row

instructions: Use the Straight Bar attachment. Hold with an underhand grip.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.
records.name: Underhand Pulldown

instructions: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing each other, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Machine Neutral Row

instructions: Place your foot on the leg pad for leverage and grab the attachment.
Start with your arms extended and your head between your arms.
Begin to pull. As you pull, lean backwards until the attachment touches your chest.
records.name: Stretcher

instructions: Lay on the chest pad and grab the handles. Lift the bar out of the holding hook.
Pull the bar to your chest and then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
records.name: Machine Chest Supported T Bar Row

instructions: Adjust the seating pad for your height.
Place your elbows on the elbow pad. Pull the bar forward until it nearly touches your stomach.
records.name: Machine Pullover

instructions: Lay on the chest after adjusting the height off the bar holding hooks to match your arm length.
Remove the bar from the hooks, then initiate the set.
Pull the bar straight back, then lower to the start position. Fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
Lay on the chest after adjusting the height off the bar holding hooks to match your arm length.
Remove the bar from the hooks, then initiate the set.
Pull the bar straight back, then lower to the start position. Fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Seal Row

instructions: Rest your upper back on the bench and place soles of your feet firmly on the floor keeping torso and thighs suspended and parallel to the floor.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands above your chest, keeping your arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight, move the kettlebell in the direction of your head until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Return to starting to position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Pullover

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart bending forward at the hips as far as comfortable. Place off-hand on the same side thigh for stability.
Hold the kettlebell in one hand, straight armed and pointing towards the floor.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell behind you as far as comfortable.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension

instructions: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower kettlebell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull kettlebell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping control.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pullover

instructions: Hold kettlebell at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Shoulder Extension

instructions: Place both hands on the wall in front of you.
Slowly lower your body until you feel the stretch.
Hold at the bottom of the stretch, return to starting position.
records.name: Lats Stretch Variation One

instructions: Stand up right and raise your hand to a full stretch above your head.
Slowly lean across your body and trace the opposite hand down your leg.
Hold at the bottom of the stretch, return to starting position and then switch sides.
records.name: Lats Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Find a wall to lean against, lay your tricep against the wall with your hand behind your back.
Slowly lean into the wall.
Return to starting position, then switch sides.
records.name: Lats Stretch Variation Three

instructions: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.
records.name: Cable Bent Over Bar Pullover

instructions: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.
records.name: Cable Lat Prayer

instructions: Stand between high cables with both arms extended outward.
Pull the handles downward and inward while keeping your elbows nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats, then slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Standing Bilateral Straight Arm Pull In

instructions: Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Straight Arm Pull In

instructions: Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage. Alternate sides with each rep.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Straight Arm Pull In

instructions: Use handle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ear should be even with your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulder and not your elbow. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Lat Prayer

instructions: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Bring one arm to your side.
You can either alternate sides or do one side at a time.
records.name: Cable Kayak Row

instructions: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.
records.name: Cable Rope Pullover

instructions: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.
records.name: Cable Rope Lat Prayer

instructions: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
Face your palm forward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.
records.name: Cable Straight Arm Pull In

instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height.
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.
records.name: Cable Archer Row

instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height.
Start with an overhand grip. As you pull your elbow back, rotate your palm until it faces upward.
records.name: Cable Supinating Row

instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm toward the midline of your body.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row

instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm upward.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row

instructions: Place the band just above our level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back slightly. Extend and flex at the shoulder joint.
records.name: Band Pullover

instructions: Loop bands around wrists,, arms extended overhead.
Pull arms outward in arc motion.
Return slowly, controlling tension throughout movement.
records.name: Mini Band Overhead Fly

instructions: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead, holding the end of the band in one hand.
Keep torso tall and pull elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return arm slowly to starting position.
records.name: Band Half Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown

instructions: Sit facing anchor with band overhead, holding handle in one hand.
Pull elbow down toward your hip while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.
records.name: Band Seated Single Arm Pulldown

instructions: Sit facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest lifted.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.
records.name: Band Seated Pulldown

instructions: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.
records.name: Band Kneeling Pulldown

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Hold each plate to the side of you.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the plates to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
One at a time, lift the plate up. Return the plate to the floor and do the other side.
records.name: Plate Alternating Deadstop Row

instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Weight hanging between your legs.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.
records.name: Weighted Pull Ups

instructions: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and extend your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.
records.name: Child Pose Arms Extended

instructions: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and extend your arms out in front of you to one side.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then repeat on the other side.
records.name: Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right

instructions: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and place your arms at your sides with your palms facing up.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.
records.name: Child Pose Arms On Side

instructions: Begin in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place your right hand on a block or the ground on the outside of your right foot.
Reach your left arm overhead and then round your spine, bringing your left hand to your right ear.
Look down towards your right foot as you reach your left arm towards the front of the room, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.
records.name: extended-side-angle-pose

instructions: Begin in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place a block on the outside of your right foot and place your right hand on top of it.
Look down towards your right foot as you reach your left arm towards the front of the room, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.
records.name: Extended side Angle Pose With Block

instructions: Begin in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart.
Extend your right leg out to the side, placing your foot flat on the ground.
Reach your right arm overhead and then round your spine, bringing your right hand to your left ear.
Look down towards your left foot as you reach your left arm towards your right foot, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.
records.name: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up

instructions: Begin in a comfortable seated position on your mat, with your legs crossed and your spine straight.
Extend your right arm up toward the ceiling and bend it at the elbow, bringing your right hand behind your head.
Reach your left arm behind your back and bend it at the elbow, bringing your left hand up between your shoulder blades.
Clasp your hands behind your back, trying to touch your fingertips together. If you can't quite reach, you can use a strap or towel to bridge the gap between your hands.
records.name: Two Arms Cow Face Pose

instructions: Lie on ground with head and shoulders supported.
Hold a bosu and lower it back over the head.
Bring the bosu back over the chest to complete one rep.
records.name: Bosu Ball Pullover

instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Leave your feet on the floor.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar. Use your legs top assist you up.
Lower your body back to starting position.
records.name: Smith Machine Assisted Pullup

instructions: Sit or lie supported, spine long, arms positioned in a t-pose.
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
Move arms down to your sides, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.
records.name: Midback Series 2

instructions: Sit or lie supported, spine long, arms positioned in a v-pose.
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
Move arms down to your sides, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.
records.name: Midback Series 3

instructions: Lie supported, spine long, arms straight up toward ceiling.
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
Move arms down towards your side, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.
records.name: Midback Series 1

instructions: Lay flat on carriage, legs in tabletop position.
Start with arms up toward ceiling.
Bring arms to your sides, then out to a t-pose, then back to start position.
records.name: Midback Series Circles Outward

instructions: Lay flat on carriage with arms toward the ceiling.
Move arms out to a t-pose.
Pull arms to your side, then raise arms back toward ceiling.
records.name: Midback Series Circles Inward

instructions: Stand on a platform holding barbell in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.
records.name: Barbell Spinal Jefferson Curl

instructions: Set barbell just below knee height in rack and stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips, grip bar firmly, and keep back flat.
Drive hips forward and stand tall, locking out at the top.
records.name: Barbell Rack Pull

instructions: Lay flat on the ground on your stomach with your arms extended overhead. Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip.
Lift your legs and chest off the ground simultaneously and hold for a 1 count at the top.
Relax your lower back and lower your legs and chest back to the floor.
records.name: Dumbbell Superman

instructions: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and make sure you force your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
When you reach parallel (hamstrings parallel with the ground) pause for 1-3 seconds. Then push through your heels back to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Pause Squat

instructions: Start by standing with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the dumbbells on the ground between your feet.
From this starting position, bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
records.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat

instructions: Lie face down on a mat.
Hold dumbbells out in front
Lift arms and legs simultaneously, squeezing lower back.
records.name: Dumbbell Superman Hold

instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of thighs with straight arms.
Slowly roll down through spine, reaching dumbbells toward feet.
Reverse motion, rolling back up one vertebra at a time.
records.name: Dumbbell Spinal Jefferson Curl

instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended in front of you.
Simultaneously raise your arms, legs and chest off of the floor and hold the position.
Slowly lower your arms, legs and chest back to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Supermans

instructions: Lie face down with arms extended straight in front of you.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off floor while squeezing glutes.
Pull elbows toward ribs, squeeze lats, then extend arms again.
records.name: Bodyweight Superman Pull

instructions: Stand tall with arms hanging toward floor and knees slightly bent.
Slowly roll down spine, one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, stacking spine back up to standing tall.
records.name: Bodyweight Spinal Jefferson Curl

instructions: Position your thighs on the padding and hook your feet on the platform supports.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend at your waist until your legs and back are at a 45° angle.
Slowly raise your body to the starting position.
records.name: Machine 45 Degree Back Extension

instructions: Sit on the machine and place your upper back on the rolling pad.
Extend your hips and lower back. Make sure not to hyperextend your spine.
records.name: Machine Back Extension

instructions: Stand tall holding kettlebells in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.
records.name: Kettlebell Spinal Jefferson Curl

instructions: Sit on the floor with the tops of your feet pointed and flat on the ground. Move your arms out in front of you in the diving position, placing your palms flat against the ground.
With your arms fully extended, rest your buttocks on the heels of your feet, you can crawl your hands forward to extend the stretch if need be.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, and return to starting position.
records.name: Lower back Stretch Variation One

instructions: Lay flat on the floor with your arms at either side.
With one leg, hook one foot under the joint of your other leg.
Rotate your hips so that your knees are pointing sideways, keeping your hooked leg flat against the floor.
Pause at the apex of the stretch and repeat with your other leg.
records.name: Lower back Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Lay on your back with your arms at either side.
Raise your knees so that they are pointing straight towards the ceiling. Keeping your legs pressed together, rotate your hips to either side.
Repeat this motion as necessary.
records.name: Lower back Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Lay flat against the ground with your knees at an angle and your feet flat against the floor.
Grab your legs just below the knees, and pull your legs towards your chest.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, then return to the starting position.
records.name: Lower back Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Place the bar in your elbows, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.
records.name: Cable Zercher Squat

instructions: Hold a plate in both hands.
Pull your arms and legs off the ground while and hold that position.
records.name: Plate Superman Hold

instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift your feet off the floor and bring your knees towards your chest.
Reach inside your knees and hold onto the outside edges of your feet.
Gently pull your knees towards your armpits and rock side to side for a few breaths.
records.name: Happy Baby

instructions: Start by lying down on your stomach on a yoga mat or a comfortable surface.
Place your elbows underneath your shoulders, keeping your forearms parallel to each other.
Press your palms and forearms firmly into the ground to lift your chest up, while keeping your hips and legs relaxed.
Make sure your shoulders are relaxed and away from your ears. Gently roll your shoulder blades down and back to open up your chest.
Lengthen your spine by lifting the crown of your head towards the ceiling, while keeping your chin tucked in slightly.
records.name: Sphinx Pose

instructions: Lie face down on Bosu, arms extended.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off the Bosu.
Hold for a moment, then lower back down.
records.name: Bosu Ball Superman

instructions: Stand straight and hold the end of the Barbell
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.
records.name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend

instructions: Kneel down facing the landmine with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it above and slightly in front of your body.

Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, twist your torso to one side, rotating your arms and the landmine along with it. Pause briefly at the end of the twist, feeling the contraction in your oblique muscles.
Slowly rotate back to the starting position, then twist to the opposite side, repeating the same motion.
Repeat both sides of the rotation for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Kneeling Twist

instructions: Stand facing the landmine, with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it at chest height. Position your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the floor, with your elbows slightly bent.

While keeping your core engaged, rotate your torso and the landmine to one side. Twist through your waist, using your oblique muscles to generate the movement. Pivot on the ball of your opposite foot as you rotate away from it.
Rotate back to the starting position, then perform the same movement in the opposite direction.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Oblique Twist

instructions: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment, holding the end of the bar in both hands slightly in front of and above your chest while holding your feet off the ground and knees bent.

Bending your elbows as little as possible and keeping your core tight and feet elevated, lower the end of the bar with control to the ground on one side of your body, then contract your obliques to return the bar to the center. Repeat on the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Russian Twist

instructions: Hold the end of the bar. Start with a shoulder width stance.
Bring both arms to one side and keep your elbows mostly extended.
Rotate back and forth and try to resist twisting too much.
records.name: Landmine Stationary Twist

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the dumbbell near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.
records.name: Dumbbell Wood Chopper

instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your shoulder blades pulled back.
The dumbbell should begin by one of your hips.
Rotate at the spine and bring the dumbbell from your hip, 180 degrees around your body. The dumbbell should land at eye level.
records.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell overhead.
From this starting position, bend to the side as far as you can while keeping your feet planted and your core engaged.
records.name: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend

instructions: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and a dumbbell on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
Your hips will do all the moving. Think, "hips up, hips down."
records.name: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down

instructions: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and a dumbbell on your hip.
Place your bottom hand on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
From this starting position, hold the side plank position for the desired amount of time, making sure to keep your body straight and your hips level.
records.name: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank

instructions: Take an elbow side plank position. Place a dumbbell on your hip.
Raise your hip up into position for the allotted amount of time.
records.name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank

instructions: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Hold a dumbbell in both hands with your arms extended straight in front of you.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell towards the ground, then return to the center. Repeat on the left side, twisting to the left and bringing the dumbbell towards the ground.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions. Keep your core engaged and avoid swinging your arms to generate momentum.
records.name: Dumbbell Long Lever Russian Twist

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your right hand on the right hip.
Hold a dumbbell with the left hand. Bend at the hips to the side.
Make sure you don't start to lean forward to try and force a longer range of motion.
records.name: Dumbbell Side Bend

instructions: Hold a dumbbell over one shoulder.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back.
Avoid doing any twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.
records.name: Dumbbell Offset Squat

instructions: Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, holding dumbbell at chest.
Rotate torso and move dumbbell toward one side without letting feet lift.
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.
records.name: Dumbbell Feet Down Russian Twist

instructions: Hover your heels just off the ground.
Stick your chest out and maintain a flat back. Make all the movement happen at your mid and upper spine.
Point your chest to the left, then rotate at the spine until your chest is pointed right.
records.name: Bodyweight Russian Twist

instructions: Start with your elbow and hip on the ground. Either neutral fist or flat hand on the ground.
Begin in a side plank position, and then drop your hips to the floor.
Pull your hips back to the ceiling to finish the rep.
records.name: Side Plank Up Down

instructions: Begin in an elbow side plank position.
Reach for the ceiling with your off hand.
Rotate at the mid and upper spine and reach through the open space between the floor and your torso.
Reach backwards, and then rotate back into the starting position.
records.name: Side Plank Reach Through

instructions: Press your elbow into the floor.
Pick your hips up off the ground and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you don't let your chest fall forward or backward.
records.name: Elbow Side Plank

instructions: Press your hand into the ground and pick up your hip off the ground.
Open your chest and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
records.name: Hand Side Plank

instructions: Start in a side plank position.
Reach your top arm under your body.
Return to the plank position.
records.name: Hand Side Plank Reach Through

instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Reach right hand to right heel.
Switch sides, left hand to left heel. Repeat.
records.name: Alternating Heel Touch

instructions: Lie on your side, knees bent, hands behind head.
Bring your elbow towards your knees and flex your obliques.
records.name: Oblique Crunch

instructions: Lie on your side, legs straight, hand behind head.
Lift both legs and upper body simultaneously.
Squeeze obliques, then lower back down. Repeat on both sides.
records.name: Oblique Jackknife

instructions: Lie on back, arms out, legs together.
Lift legs to 90 degrees.
Rotate legs side to side, keeping shoulders grounded.
records.name: Windshield Wiper

instructions: Start on all fours then bring your chest to the ground. Place one hand on the ground in front of you. The other hand behind your head/ear.
On the side of the hand that is behind your head, rotate until your elbow is pointed at the ceiling and then hold this position.
records.name: Bodyweight Thoracic Spine Rotation

instructions: Lie sideways on a stability ball, feet anchored, hands behind head, core engaged.
Crunch sideways by contracting obliques, bringing your upper body toward your hip.
records.name: Stability Ball Side Crunch

instructions: Kneel with one knee down, holding a medicine ball.
Rotate torso and until the medicine ball is pointed the opposite direction.
Repeat the movement on the other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Half Kneeling Wood Chopper

instructions: Kneel, holding a medicine ball.
Rotate torso and slam the ball diagonally down and across.
Repeat the movement on the other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Kneeling Wood Chopper

instructions: Stand facing partner, side by side.
Toss medicine ball to partner's side.
Catch and repeat toss on other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Partner Side Toss

instructions: Lift medicine ball overhead.
Slam ball down to one side.
Catch and repeat slam to the other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Rainbow Slam

instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet off ground.
Twist torso side to side, touching medicine ball to ground.
records.name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist

instructions: Hold medicine ball with both hands and arms extended.
Swing ball diagonally across body, engaging core.
records.name: Medicine Ball Wood Chopper

instructions: Stand sideways next to a wall.
Swing medicine ball across your body and toss off the wall.
Catch and repeat toss on the other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Wood Chopper Toss

instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and hold the kettle bell with both hands against your hip.
Keeping your arms straight, swing the kettlebell upwards and across your body towards your shoulder, raising the kettlebell to head height rotating your hips as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Wood Chopper

instructions: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then pull the handle back to your chest.
records.name: Cable Pallof Press

instructions: Set the cable at about nipple level. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.
records.name: Cable Wood Chopper

instructions: Set the cable just over your head. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.
records.name: Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper

instructions: Set the cable at a low position. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.
records.name: Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper

instructions: Set the cable at nipple level. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.
records.name: Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper

instructions: Set the cable just over your head. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, push the handle down until your elbow is extended. Flex your obliques until you feel a contraction.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.
records.name: Cable Oblique Pushdown

instructions: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then rotate away from the cable stack.
Then pull the handle back to your chest.
records.name: Cable Pallof Press Rotation

instructions: Set the cable at the bottom of the stack. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, grab the handle, lean away from the cable.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.
records.name: Cable Side Bend

instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward across body toward opposite shoulder.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper

instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and hold rope behind head, elbows pointed out.
Crunch torso toward hip on cable side, keeping hips stable.
Slowly return to upright, maintaining constant tension on obliques.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Oblique Crunch

instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and hold handle at chest, elbows tucked.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Hold briefly, then return handle to chest under full control.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press

instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and press handle straight forward, keeping torso stable.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body into a wood chopper motion.
Return to center and bring handle back to chest under control.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press To Wood Chopper

instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and grip handle with both hands in front of chest.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body in a smooth arc.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.
records.name: Cable Kneeling Wood Chopper

instructions: Place the band at an anchor point that is shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Start with your fingers interlocked around the band and your fists connected to your chest.
Extend at the elbows pressing the band away from your body until your elbows are fully extended.
records.name: Band Pallof Press

instructions: Anchor band at shoulder height. Stand sideways, feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend.
Grip band with both hands, arms extended.
Pull across body, rotating torso.
records.name: Band Wood Chopper

instructions: Stand with band anchored low on one side, holding handle at hip.
Lean torso away from anchor, keeping hips and legs still.
Contract obliques to return upright, maintaining smooth control.
records.name: Band Side Bend

instructions: Stand sideways to band, hold handle at chest, and brace your core.
Press arms straight forward, resisting rotation.
Rotate torso and pull band across body in a wood chopper motion, then return.
records.name: Band Pallof Press To Wood Chopper

instructions: Stand with a plate extended away from your body. Elbows mostly extended.
Rotate at the upper spine while keeping your lumbar spine in a neutral position.
Do not let the plate go behind your body.
records.name: Plate Standing Twist

instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the plate near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.
records.name: Plate Wood Chopper

instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your feet resting in the TRX foot cradles.
Prop yourself up on your forearm and engage your core to maintain a straight line from your head to your feet.
records.name: TRX Forearm Side Plank

instructions: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull both knees to your right elbow.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, then pull both knees to the left elbow.
records.name: TRX Oblique Crunch

instructions: Start on your knees and extend your right leg out to the side.
Raise your right arm above your head and reach towards the left side of the room.
Gently bend your body to the left side and rest your left hand on your left thigh.
Look up towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.
records.name: Gate Pose Variation Arm Extended on Side

instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and bring your heel towards your perineum.
Place your left hand on the outside of your right knee and twist your body to the right.
Reach your right hand towards your left foot and look up towards the ceiling. Hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.
records.name: Revolved Head To Knee

instructions: Sit comfortably on the floor with your legs crossed.
Inhale and raise your right arm above your head.
As you exhale, bend your body to the left side and rest your left hand on the ground.
Look up towards the ceiling and hold the pose for a few breaths. Then switch sides and repeat the pose on the other side.
records.name: Seated Side Bend Pose

instructions: Lie down on your back with your arms stretched out to your sides.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your chest.
Slowly twist your body to the left side, bringing your right knee across your body towards the ground on the left side.
Look towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.
records.name: Supine Twist Lying

instructions: Start in a downward facing dog position.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and foot, and lift your right leg towards the ceiling.
Slowly bend your right knee and shift your weight onto your right hand as you open up your chest towards the ceiling.
Look towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.
records.name: Wild Thing Pose

instructions: Lie on one side, forearm on Bosu, elbow under shoulder.
Lift hips to create a side plank.
Hold the side plank position, then switch sides.
records.name: Bosu Ball Forearm Sideplank

instructions: Place hand on Bosu, arm straight, facing sideways.
Stack feet and lift hips to side plank.
Hold the side plank position, then switch sides.
records.name: Bosu Ball Hand Sideplank

instructions: Start in a side plank with hand on Bosu.
Lift the top leg while keeping the body stable.
Lower the leg back down.
records.name: Bosu Ball Hand Sideplank Hip Abduction

instructions: Stand tall holding the bosu.
Swing bosu diagonally across the body.
records.name: Bosu Ball Wood Chopper

instructions: Lay on your side with your knees bent.
Hold the bar extended over you.
Lift yourself up by flexing your obliques.
records.name: Smith Machine Oblique Crunch

instructions: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and the bar on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
Your hips will do all the moving. Think, "hips up, hips down."
records.name: Smith Machine Side Plank Up Down

instructions: Stand beside the bar.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.
records.name: Smith Machine Side Bend

instructions: Kneel tall sideways, hands holding straps, arms extended forward.
Engage core, rotate torso away from anchor.
Keep hips square and shoulders stacked.
records.name: Side Twist Kneeling

instructions: Kneel sideways, one hand on bar, feet staggered.
Push knees outward and raise off hand until at shoulder height.
records.name: Star Prep

instructions: Hold the bar in a goblet position.
Stand tall, push your knees forward until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Make sure to keep your hips extended.
records.name: Barbell Landmine Sissy Squat

instructions: Start in a deep squat holding a dumbbell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.
records.name: Dumbbell Somersault Squat

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in your right hand, extending it overhead.
Inhale and begin to squat down, keeping the dumbbell overhead and your back straight.
Go down as far as you can while still maintaining control, then exhale and return to standing position, keeping the dumbbell overhead. Repeat for desired reps and then switch to the other arm.
records.name: Single Arm Overhead Squat

instructions: Place a dumbbell between your feet. Lean back slightly and hold on to the bench.
Extend your knees until you feel your quads contract hard.
records.name: Dumbbell Leg Extension

instructions: Stand with your feet on a plate. Your feet should be very close to one another, but not touching.
Begin your squat by pushing your hips back and breaking at the knees. Try to keep your chest tall while squatting.
records.name: Dumbbell Heels Up Narrow Goblet Squat

instructions: Take a half kneeling stance. The dumbbell should start over your knee that is up.
Rotate at the spine and point the dumbbell to the opposing side.
records.name: Dumbbell Heels Up Goblet Squat

instructions: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Pulse Squat

instructions: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and push your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Hit parallel depth and then drive through your heels back to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Front Rack Squat

instructions: Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Split Squat

instructions: Stand on platform with one foot off edge and torso tall.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee under control.
Drive through standing heel to stand tall again without pushing off bottom foot.
records.name: Bodyweight Step Down

instructions: Stand on platform with one foot hanging off edge.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee slightly.
Drive through standing heel to return upright under control.
records.name: Bodyweight Partial Step Down

instructions: Stand tall holding support for balance, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lean back while bending knees, keeping body straight from knees up.
Push through toes and extend knees to return upright.
records.name: Bodyweight Assisted Sissy Squat

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stability ball behind your back against a wall.
Lean back onto the ball, bend knees forward, lowering slowly while keeping hips extended.
Push through toes, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.
records.name: Stability Ball Sissy Squat

instructions: Press your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position, thighs parallel to the floor, knees above ankles.
Hold the position, maintaining tension in your core and legs.
records.name: Wall Sit

instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the cushion and adjust the machine you are using so that your knees are at a 90 degree angle at the starting position.
Raise the weight by extending your knees outward, then lower your leg to the starting position. Both movements should be done in a slow, controlled motion.
records.name: Machine Leg Extension

instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the cushion and adjust the machine you are using so that your knees are at a 90 degree angle at the starting position.
Raise the weight by extending your knees outward, then lower your leg to the starting position. Both movements should be done in a slow, controlled motion.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Leg Extension

instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Keep your back straight, and slowly lower into a squat position.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.
records.name: Machine Hack Squat

instructions: Place your feet at the bottom the platform at shoulder width. Lift your heels up.
Press against the platform and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Machine Horizontal Sissy Leg Press

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball.
Step laterally, performing a lunge, then slam the ball.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Lateral Lunge Slam

instructions: Start in a deep squat holding a kettlebell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.
records.name: Kettlebell Somersault Squat

instructions: Stand perpendicular to a wall, using one arm against the wall for balance. With your other arm, grab the top of your foot.
Pull your leg upwards and back to engage your quads, pausing at the apex of the stretch for a few seconds.
Return to starting position and repeat with your other leg.
records.name: Quads Stretch Variation One

instructions: Place one foot flat on the ground in front of you at a 90 degree angle. With your other leg, balance upon your knee, placing the tip of your foot against the wall behind you for balance.
Place your hands on your knee in front of you, and lean forward so that your knee extends over your foot.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, and slowly return to starting position. Repeat with your other leg.
records.name: Quads Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Lay flat on your belly, with both hands reach back and grab the tops of your feet.
Keeping your upper legs flat on the ground, pull both of your feet towards your buttocks.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, then return to starting position.
records.name: Quads Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Lay flat on your belly. Extend one arm out in front of you, placing your palm on the floor. With your other arm, grab the top of your foot.
Keeping your upper leg flat on the floor, pull your foot towards your buttocks to engage the stretch.
Pause for a few seconds, and then repeat the stretch with your other leg.
records.name: Quads Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Stand upright facing away from the cable crossover with the cable set to the height of your hips. Use an ankle/wrist attachment.
Extend at the knee against the cable.
records.name: Cable Standing Leg Extension

instructions: Use an ankle/wrist attachment. Pull the cable under the bench and attach it at your ankle.
Extend at the knee against the cable.
records.name: Cable Seated Leg Extension

instructions: Press your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart, holding weights at your sides.
Lower into a squat position, thighs parallel to the floor, knees above ankles.
Hold the position, maintaining tension in your core and legs.
records.name: Weighted Wall Sit

instructions: Stand straight with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Inhale and raise your arms straight up over your head.
Exhale and bend your knees, lowering your hips as if you were sitting in a chair.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then inhale and stand up straight.
records.name: Chair Pose

instructions: Begin in Runner's Lunge pose with your right foot forward.
Slowly lift your torso up and bring your arms overhead, palms facing each other.
Make sure your right knee is directly above your ankle, and your left leg is straight behind you.
Hold for a few breaths before repeating on the other side.
records.name: Crescent Moon Pose

instructions: Begin in Crescent Moon Pose with your right foot forward and a block nearby.
Place the block at the highest height under your left hand.
Reach your left arm behind you and take hold of your left foot or ankle.

Gently pull your foot towards your buttocks while pressing your left hand into the block to deepen the stretch in your left quad. Hold for a few breaths before releasing and repeating on the other side.
records.name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch

instructions: Begin in Crescent Moon Pose with your right foot forward and a block nearby.
Place the block at the highest height under your left hand.
Reach your left arm behind you and take hold of your left foot or ankle.

Gently pull your foot towards your buttocks while pressing your left hand into the block to deepen the stretch in your left quad. Hold for a few breaths before releasing and repeating on the other side.
records.name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch With Block

instructions: Begin by standing tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bring your right heel towards your glute.
Reach your right arm back and grab onto the inside of your right foot or ankle.
Inhale and lift your right foot away from your glute while extending your left arm forward. Hold for 5-10 breaths before switching sides.
records.name: Lord Of The Dance

instructions: Begin in a low lunge with your right foot forward and your left knee on the ground.
Slowly slide your left knee back while extending your right leg forward, keeping both legs straight.
Lower your body down to the ground, using your hands for support if needed.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Monkey Pose

instructions: Begin in Downward Facing Dog pose (Adho Mukha Svanasana).
Step your right foot forward between your hands.
Place your left knee on the ground behind you and slide it back until you feel a stretch in your left hip flexor.
Keep your hands on the ground or lift them to the sky and hold for a few breaths before repeating on the other side.
records.name: Runners Lunge

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back and put the bar on your back. Squeezing your shoulder blades and raise your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the smith machine by straightening your legs.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.
records.name: Smith Machine Squat

instructions: Stand facing away from the machine, positioning your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart to provide a stable base, and then reach behind you to firmly grip the bar with both hands, maintaining an overhand grip.
Initiate the movement by leaning backward, allowing your upper body to incline while simultaneously bending your knees. As you descend, maintain control
drive through your quadriceps while pushing your hips forward, gradually straightening your knees. Maintain a slow, controlled pace
records.name: Smith Machine Sissy Squat

instructions: Stand perpendicular to the barbell and hinge forward with a staggered stance.
Grip the barbell and pull your elbow outward toward shoulder height.
Squeeze your rear shoulder without rotating your torso.
Lower the barbell slowly until your arm is extended.
records.name: Landmine Rear Delt Row

instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Fly

instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly

instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, lay on an incline bench that's at about 15-30 degrees.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly

instructions: With dumbbells in either hand and an overhand grip, lay on an incline bench that is roughly 15 - 30 degrees high.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly Internally Rotated

instructions: Sit with your chest in your lap, dumbbells in hands, arms bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.
records.name: Internally Rotated Seated Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Sit on a bench with one foot on the bench.
Place the elbow on the inside of your elbow and use it for leverage.
Point your fist toward the wall andthen toward the ceiling. Rotating a total of 90 degrees.
records.name: Dumbbell Shoulder External Rotation

instructions: Sit on a bench. Put your chest in your lap. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Row

instructions: Sit with hinged over position, dumbbells in hands, arms slightly bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.
records.name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly

instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Alternating Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand,  elbow bent at 90 degrees while resting on your inner thigh/ knee.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.
records.name: Dumbbell External Rotation

instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, place your head on the top of an incline bench, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Head On Bench Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Lie facedown on a bench, holding dumbbells beneath your shoulders.
Slightly bend your elbows and raise the dumbbells outward.
Squeeze your rear shoulders when your arms reach approximately shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Stand facing rings and grab the handles.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.
records.name: Ring Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Press your chest into the chest pad and grab the horizontal handles with an overhand grip.
Pull the handles toward you, make sure your elbows stay flared out.
records.name: Machine Plate Loaded Low Row

instructions: Place your chest against the pad and grab the handles with an overhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and keep your elbows flared throughout the rep.
records.name: Machine Rear Deltoid Row

instructions: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing down, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Machine Overhand Row

instructions: Sit on machine and press your chest into the pad.
Grab the handles with an overhand grip. Keep your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your arms backwards and squeeze your scapula together.
records.name: Machine Reverse Fly

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Bring one arm behind you and rest this arm on your back. With the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length close to the floor.
Swing the kettlebell out and up towards the side of your body and then return to centre. Repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Stand with you feet shoulder width apart. Place one arm across the front of your chest at shoulder height, press the forearm of your other arm above the elbow, hooking the stretching arm with your hand.
Press the arm until it is straight and rotate your upper torso to engage the stretch even deeper.
Repeat with your other arm.
records.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Four

instructions: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Cable Rope Face Pulls

instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row

instructions: Start with the cables at the top. Use a rope attachment. Fall to a half kneeling position.
Pull the metal piece in the middle of the rope to the bridge of your nose.
records.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull

instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable High Reverse Fly

instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Internally Rotated High Reverse Fly

instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable High Internally Rotated Reverse Fly

instructions: Hold the cable handle in one hand,  elbow bent at 90 degrees going across your torso.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.
records.name: Cable External Rotation

instructions: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Cable Bar Face Pull

instructions: Sit facing cable machine and grasp bar with shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull bar toward upper face while driving elbows outward and back.
Squeeze rear delts at the end, then return bar slowly with control.
records.name: Cable Seated Bar Face Pull

instructions: Sit facing cable and hold rope with palms facing each other, arms extended.
Pull rope toward upper face while flaring elbows outward.
Squeeze rear delts and mid-traps, then slowly return to start.
records.name: Cable Seated Rope Face Pull

instructions: Sit facing cable and hold handle with arm extended at shoulder height.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt, then return slowly, maintaining control.
records.name: Cable Seated Single Arm Face Pull

instructions: Stand facing cable and hold handle at shoulder height with arm extended.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Face Pull

instructions: Grab the band with a shoulder width grip. Point your arms straight in front of you.
Retract your shoulder blades and shoulder joint until the band taps your chest.
records.name: Band Pull Apart

instructions: Anchor the band at eye level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Use an overhand grip with both hands. Pull the band to the bridge of your nose flaring your elbows out.
records.name: Band Face Pull

instructions: Start with a band anchored to a high point. Stagger your stance.
Pull the band to the bridge of your nose.
records.name: Band High Face Pull

instructions: Start by standing between the two anchored bands with your feet shoulder-width apart and the bands positioned at a high point.
Grasp the ends of each band with your hands, keeping your palms facing each other.

Keeping your arms slightly bent and your back straight, slowly pull the bands away from your body until your arms are extended straight out to the sides. Hold for a second, then slowly release back to the starting position. Repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Band Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Stand on band, hinge forward with neutral spine.
Row elbows out wide, squeezing shoulder blades back.
Lower slowly, maintaining bent-over position.
records.name: Mini Band Bent Over Rear Delt Row

instructions: Anchor band, elbow at side bent 90 degrees.
Rotate forearm outward, keeping elbow pinned.
Return slowly to start, controlling resistance.
records.name: Mini Band External Rotation

instructions: Hold band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull hands apart, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining tension throughout.
records.name: Mini Band Pull Apart

instructions: With plates in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Hinge forward with a flat back.
Maintain an overhand grip and internally rotated shoulders.
Raise your arms backward toward the ceiling while maintaining a light band in your elbows.
records.name: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Keep your back straight and bend forward slightly at the waist.
With arms extended, raise the weights out to your sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
Pause briefly and then lower the weights back to the starting position.
records.name: Plate Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.
records.name: TRX Rear Delt Fly

instructions: Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
Step away so your body is leaning away from the anchor point.
Flex your elbows and pull your elbows straight back behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbows flared outward.
records.name: TRX Rear Delt Row

instructions: Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Pull your elbows back while externally rotating your shoulder joint. Your arms should make a W shape at the back portion of the exercise.
records.name: TRX W Raise

instructions: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Walk your hands forward as you lower your chest towards the ground.
Keep your hips over your knees and extend your arms out in front of you.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.
records.name: Puppy Pose

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
Start with elbows bent, hands near chest, palms facing inward.
Open elbows wide, rotating shoulders externally while keeping chest lifted.
Return with control, maintaining upright posture and steady strap tension.
records.name: Back Rowing Preps Open Elbow Seated

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
Start with arms forward, palms facing forward, shoulders relaxed.
Pull arms out to a T, squeezing upper back without leaning.
Return slowly to start, maintaining upright posture and controlled tension.
records.name: Back Rowing Preps Airplane Seated

instructions: Kneel sideways, supporting hand under shoulder, top arm reaching long overhead.
Engage core, keep torso upright and shoulders stacked.
Pull top arm down toward hip, using lats and obliques.
Return arm overhead with control, maintaining balance and steady breathing.
records.name: Long Arm Adduction Side Kneeling

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the Barbell with both hands in front just past shoulder width.
Bend forward at the hips with a slight bend in your knees, keeping your back straight.
Engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
Release the shrug.
records.name: Barbell Silverback Shrug

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
