Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Once the barbell is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.
records.name: Barbell Shrug

instructions: Begin by sitting on the ground with your legs extended and a barbell in your hands, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, lift the barbell up from your chest and press it straight up above your head.
Lower the barbell back down to your chest.
records.name: Barbell Z Press

instructions: Hold barbell behind you with arms at a 30 degree angle with your torso.
Shrug shoulders up and slightly back toward ears, keeping elbows locked.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control to full stretch.
records.name: Barbell Behind The Back 30 Degree Shrug

instructions: Hold barbell behind your hips with overhand grip, arms straight.
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears without bending elbows.
Lower slowly, maintaining tension in traps throughout the movement.
records.name: Barbell Behind The Back Shrug

instructions: Hold barbell with a wide grip. Your arms should be at a roughly 30 degree angle.
Pull your shoulders towards your ears instead of straight up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Barbell 30 Degree Shrug

instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
Bend down and grab the bar with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the bar off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Once the bar is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.
records.name: Ez Bar Shrug

instructions: Stand inside trap bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed.
Elevate shoulders straight upward toward ears.
Pause briefly at top, squeezing traps.
Lower shoulders slowly to starting position.
records.name: Trap Bar Shrug

instructions: Stand beside the barbell and hold its end with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and raise your shoulder toward your ear.
Squeeze briefly at the top without bending your elbows.
Lower your shoulders completely and repeat.
records.name: Landmine Shrug

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding dumbbells with both hands in front just past shoulder width.
Bend forward at the hips with a slight bend in your knees, keeping your back straight.
Engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
records.name: Dumbbell Silverback Shrug

instructions: Stand tall with two dumbbells. Pull your shoulder blades up. Give a one second squeeze at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Shrug

instructions: Sit on a bench with dumbbells in both hands, palms facing your body, back straight.
Elevate your shoulders and hold the contracted position at the apex of the motion.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Shrug

instructions: Lay sideways on a bench letting your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade and joint toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying 30 Degree Shrug

instructions: Lay on an incline bench with your arms hanging freely.
Pull your shoulder blades back toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Laying Silverback Shrug

instructions: Use a bench or an object like a chair to elevate your feet.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.
records.name: Elevated Pike Shoulder Shrug

instructions: Start in a plank position and raise your hips toward the ceiling.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.
records.name: Bodyweight Pike Shrug

instructions: Have a seat on the machine, and grab each handle.
Pull your shoulder blades straight up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Machine Seated Shrug

instructions: Grab both handles and stand upright. Make sure you keep a flat back while lifting to the starting position.
Pull your shoulder blades straight up toward the ceiling.
records.name: Machine Standing Shrug

instructions: Leaning across the back section of the bench, with feet firmly on the floor and with arms hanging to the sides.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.
records.name: Kettlebell Incline Shrug

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.
records.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)

instructions: Standing up straight with feet shoulder width apart.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
Release the shrug and repeat
records.name: Kettlebell Shrug (Single)

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders upward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Kettlebell Shrug

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Upright Row Single

instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Place your left hand on your head and gently pull your head down towards your left shoulder. Then return to centre point.
Repeat, using your right hand pulling towards your right shoulder.
records.name: Traps Stretch Variation One

instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Keeping your chest facing forward, turn your head 90 degrees to the left. Then return to centre point.
Repeat, turning your head in the other direction.
records.name: Traps Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Nod your head forward, bringing your chin to your chest.
You will feel the stretch across your neck.
records.name: Traps Stretch Variation Three

instructions: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Stand up with the attachment in hand, walk a couple of steps back make sure you are standing upright and not leaning backwards.
Retract your shoulder blades and then protract to return to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Silverback Shrug

instructions: Use a handle attachment on both sides of crossover. With cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab both handles and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arms hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blades up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blades depress back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable 30 Degree Shrug

instructions: Use a handle attachment. With the cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab one handle and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blade depress back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Single Arm 30 Degree Shrug

instructions: Place the band under your feet. Stand upright.
Elevate your shoulder blades and then depress back to the starting position.
records.name: Band Shrug

instructions: Anchor the band at shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Retract your shoulder blades straight back in schools. Then protract to the starting position.
records.name: Band Horizontal Shrug

instructions: Stand tall with a weight plate overhead.
Elevated and depress your scapula.
Avoid leaning forward or backwards to keep pressure off of your lumbar spine.
records.name: Plate Overhead Shrug

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Cross your right arm over your left arm, bringing your palms together in front of your chest.
Lower your arms down so that your palms face down towards the ground, and your right elbow is resting on top of your left elbow.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides.
records.name: Criss Cross Bow Tie Pose

instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor and bring your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Cross your right arm over your left, bending both elbows so that your forearms are parallel to the floor.
Lift your elbows towards the ceiling and bring your hands together, then drop your chin towards your chest.
Hold for a few breaths, then release your arms and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Eagle Arms Chin Into Chest

instructions: Begin by sitting cross-legged on the floor.
Slowly drop your chin towards your chest, feeling a stretch in the back of your neck.
Inhale and lift your head up, then exhale and drop your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat the stretch.
records.name: Easy Pose Neck Stretch

instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor and interlace your fingers behind your head.
Drop your chin to your chest and roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Slowly roll your head back to center, then over to the left so that your left ear is close to your left shoulder.
Repeat the movement from side to side, keeping your shoulders relaxed and breathing deeply.
records.name: Half Neck Rolls

instructions: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Slide your right knee up between your hands and place your right foot close to your left wrist.
Take your left leg back and lower it down to the ground, keeping your toes tucked.
Twist your torso to the right and reach your right arm underneath your left arm, threading the needle. Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides.
records.name: Thread The Needle Hip Over Knees

instructions: Place toes on Bosu, hands on the floor.
Pike hips up, shrug shoulders, engage core.
records.name: Bosu Ball Pike Shrug

instructions: Use the Straight Bar attachment.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.
records.name: Narrow Pulldown

instructions: Use the V Bar attachment.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.
records.name: Neutral Pulldown

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides, and lean forward.
Lift your shoulders backward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.
records.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug

instructions: Stand up with your feet shoulder width apart. Place one arm across the front of your chest at shoulder height, press the forearm of your other arm above the elbow, hooking the stretching arm with your hand.
Press the arm until it is straight and rotate your upper torso to engage the stretch even deeper.
Repeat with your other arm.
records.name: Traps mid back Stretch Variation One

instructions: Sit on the ground and lay one leg flat and the other over the top.
Hold your leg with the same side arm and slowly rotate your hips and back.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.name: Traps mid back Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a row bar.
Pull the handles back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.
records.name: Cable Row Bar Standing Row

instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Inhale and arch your back, lifting your tailbone and head towards the ceiling, while lowering your belly towards the floor.
Exhale and round your spine, tucking your chin towards your chest, and bringing your tailbone towards your knees.
Repeat these movements, flowing smoothly between the two poses, for several breaths.
records.name: Cat Pose

instructions: Begin in a low lunge position with your right foot forward and your left knee on the ground.
Bring your hands together in a prayer position at your heart.
Exhale and twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee.
Hold for several breaths and then repeat on the other side.
records.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner

instructions: Begin in Warrior II pose, with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Bring your hands together in a prayer position at your heart.
Exhale and twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee.
Hold for several breaths and then repeat on the other side.
records.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands

instructions: Begin seated with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your foot on the floor next to your left thigh.
Inhale and reach your left arm up towards the ceiling.
Exhale and twist to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee. Hold for a few breaths and then repeat on the other side.
records.name: Seated Twist

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell Close Grip Bench Press

instructions: Lay on a flat bench while holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip.
Fully extend your elbows until the barbell is directly over your chest.
Begin to flex your elbows and allow the barbell to nearly touch your forehead.
Extend your elbows back to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Barbell Laying Triceps Extensions

instructions: Take a shoulder width grip. Break at the elbows. Try to keep your elbows tucked in. Don't let them flare out.
Stop the bar a few inches from your forehead and extend your elbows back up.
records.name: Barbell Skullcrusher

instructions: Be careful getting the bar into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
records.name: Barbell Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet in the pads. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Barbell Decline Close Grip Bench Press

instructions: Be careful getting the bar into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
records.name: Ez Bar Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Lie flat on bench and grip bar slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Lower bar toward upper chest by bending elbows forward, not flaring out.
Extend elbows to press bar back to starting position above chest.
records.name: Barbell J M Press

instructions: Unrack the barbell. Break at the elbows and begin lowering the barbell.
Lower the barbell to your neck before extending your elbows back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Tricep Guillotine Press

instructions: Stand facing the bar in a split stance with one leg forward and bent and the other back and straight. Hold the bar in the hand on the side of the leg that is back with the end of the bar at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.
Drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended. Pause briefly before lowering the end of the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press

instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Dip your body slightly then drive up through the ground to generate momentum as your extend your arm fully upwards. Pause briefly at the top of the rep, then lower the weight back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Single Arm Push Press

instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Press the barbell overhead by extending your arm fully, pushing the weight upward. Keep your core engaged, your back straight, and your shoulder down throughout the movement. Pause briefly at the top of the movement with your arm fully extended overhead. Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position at shoulder height with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Single Arm Overhead Press

instructions: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in one hand in front of that shoulder with your palm facing across your body.

While keeping your torso tall and your core braced, drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended, leaning forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joint. Lower the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for desired number of reps on one side, then switch sides.
records.name: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press

instructions: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest with your palms facing each other.

While keeping your torso tall and core brace, drive the end of the bar upward until your arms are fully extended. Lean forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joints. Lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Seated Overhead Press

instructions: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment with your legs open for stability while holding the end of the bar in a neutral grip with your hand resting at your shoulder and your elbow beneath your wrist.

Leaning forward slightly, press the bar up into the air until your arm is fully extended. At the top of the movement, switch which hand is holding the end of the bar and lower the bar back down to the opposite shoulder. Perform again to return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press

instructions: Stand facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar in both hands with your palms facing each other.
Extend your arms upward, pressing the end of the bar up overhead. Pause at the top of the movement, then lower the bar with control back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Overhead Press

instructions: Start lying on your back perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the bar directly over your shoulder with the hand that's closer to the bar with your palm facing down towards your feet.
While keeping your shoulder steady, bend your elbow and lower the end of the bar back towards your the ground next to your head. Keep your hinging elbow pointed down towards your feet.
Drive through your palm to extend your elbow and return the bar to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension

instructions: Start kneeling in front of the landmine, facing towards it, with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight while holding the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest.

Push the landmine up overhead by fully extending your arms until the weight is directly over your head. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the landmine back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
records.name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press

instructions: Start in a kneeling position facing the barbell with one hand holding the end of the barbell at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your wrist.
Keeping your elbow pointing forward, drive the barbell up overhead until your arm is fully extended and switch the bar to your other hand at the top of the movement.
Control the descent of the bar to your other shoulder and repeat movement for desired reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.
records.name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press

instructions: Stand facing the landmine leaning forward slightly with the end of the barbell held in one hand at your shoulder with your elbow positioned beneath your wrist.

While keeping your elbow pointed forward, drive the bar directly overhead, switching hands at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down to the other side of your body, mirroring the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.
records.name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press

instructions: Lay flat on the floor or a bench with your fists extended to the ceiling and a neutral grip.
Break at the elbows until your fists are by your temples. Then extend your elbows and flex your triceps at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher

instructions: Sit on the bench and hold a dumbbell with both hands. Raise the dumbbell overhead at arms length, holding the weight up with the palms of your hands.
Keep your elbows in while you lower the weight behind your head, your upper arms stationary.
Raise the weight back to starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Start by lying on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with your arms extended and your palms facing each other. This is the starting position.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your forehead by bending your elbows. Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms.
Once the dumbbells are close to your forehead, reverse the motion by extending your elbows and returning to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Decline Skullcrusher

instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension

instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead.
Flex at the elbows until the dumbbell is behind your head.
Then extend your elbows until the dumbbell is back in the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend at the waist and place your opposite hand on your knee for support.
From this starting position, extend your arm backwards so that the dumbbell is behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.
records.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback

instructions: Stand tall with a single dumbbell extended overhead.
Flex at the elbow letting the dumbbell travel behind your body.
Try not to let your elbow flare outward.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells extended toward the ceiling.
Maintain an overhand grip. Flex at the elbows.
The dumbbells will land on your upper chest/clavicle.
Extend your elbows bringing the dumbbells back into their starting position.
*Named after Dave Tate*
records.name: Dumbbell Tate Press

instructions: Lay flat on an incline bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Skullover

instructions: Lay sideways on an incline bench and press the elbow of the working arm into the bench.
Use your free arm to pull your upper body into the bench.
Break at the elbow until your elbow is fully flexed, then extend your elbow until the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Lay flat on a bench.
Push your elbows forward until your biceps touch your forearms. Then extend your elbows until back at the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Tricep Guillotine Press

instructions: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells above chest.
Flex elbows first, then flex the shoulders until a stretch is felt in your triceps.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.
records.name: Dumbbell High Incline Skullover

instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbells above chest with palms facing in.
Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward forehead under control.
Extend arms fully, squeezing triceps at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Incline Skullcrusher

instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbell above chest with palmsfacing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell toward forehead under control.
Extend arm fully, squeezing tricep at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Skullcrusher

instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbell overhead with one hand, arm fully extended.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbow slowly.
Extend arm back up, squeezing triceps at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Lie on flat bench holding one dumbbell above shoulder, palm facing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell beside head without moving upper arm.
Extend arm fully, contracting triceps at the top.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Skullcrusher

instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower dumbbell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press

instructions: Position your index fingers and thumbs so they are touching, forming a diamond shape
Use a standard push up position
Lower your chest towards your hands, keep your elbows close to your body
Stop just before your chest touches the floor, then push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Diamond Push Ups

instructions: Grip the edge of the bench with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.
records.name: Bench Dips

instructions: Attach the ring straps to a high point. Stand on your tip toes.
Your arms should be extended in front of you.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps. Then extend your elbows back to the start.
records.name: Ring Skullcrusher

instructions: Begin in a plank position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension

instructions: Begin in kneeling position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.
records.name: Bodyweight Knee Tricep Extension

instructions: Grip the pulley bar with palms facing down at shoulder width.
Stand straight with a small forward incline. Keep your upper arms close to your body, and slowly bring the pulley bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause when you are at the contracted position of the motion, then slowly raise the pulley bar back to the starting point.
records.name: Machine Cable V Bar Push Downs

instructions: Sit on the machine and place the back of your upper arm on the bench.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps.
Bring the weight back to the starting position.
records.name: Machine Tricep Pushdown

instructions: Adjust the pad to suit your height.
Grab the v bar (or other attachment) and extend your elbows until they are almost fully extended.
Flex your elbows and look to feel a stretch at the bottom of each rep.
records.name: Machine Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Lie flat on your back. Keeping your arm straight, hold the kettlebell above your chest with your palm facing away from your body.
Bend your arm, touching the kettlebell to the top of the shoulder opposite to the arm being worked.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Tate Press

instructions: Lie on the floor with your upper back and soles of feet on the floor, knees bent, and pelvis and lower back suspended in the air.
Hold the kettlebell in both hands directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms in place, bend your elbows to bring the kettlebell to the floor above your head.
Return the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher

instructions: Stand with legs shoulder width apart.
Hold the kettlebell in both hands behind your head.
Straighten arms bringing kettlebell above your head.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension

instructions: Lie on bench holding kettlebell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower kettlebell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press

instructions: Be careful getting the KB into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
records.name: Kettlebell Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Raise your left arm above your head, and bend at the elbow so your hand is resting at the top of your back.
Use the opposite hand to gently apply pressure to the elbow.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.
records.name: Triceps Stretch Variation One

instructions: Hold a band so it is in line with your spine. Hold the top with your right hand and the bottom with your left.
Keeping the top still, pull down on the band.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.
records.name: Triceps Stretch Variation Two

instructions: Bend your left arm so your hand is at your shoulder, and hold your elbow with the opposite hand.
Gently push on your elbow so it is raised by your head.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.
records.name: Triceps Stretch Variation Three

instructions: The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.
records.name: Cable Rope Pushdown

instructions: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Rope Skullcrusher

instructions: Either use two handles or no attachment at all. Both sides of the cable crossover should be set to the top.
Stand in the center of the machine holding each Cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a 45 degree angle with your torso.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position
records.name: Cable Cross Pushdown

instructions: You can use any attachment. The cable should be all the way to the bottom of the machine. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.
records.name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Standing between crossed cables, holding opposite handles above your shoulders.
Extend your elbows fully, keeping your upper arms stationary.
records.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Skullcrusher

instructions: Stand between crossed high cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Extend both arms downward while keeping your elbows beside your torso.
Squeeze your triceps, then slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Tricep Extension

instructions: Stand facing cable holding bar with palms down, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.
records.name: Cable Bar Rolling Pushdown

instructions: Stand facing cable holding rope, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.
records.name: Cable Rope Rolling Pushdown

instructions: Stand facing cable holding handle with palm down, elbow bent, and shoulder flexed.
First extend your shoulder (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbow.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Rolling Pushdown

instructions: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.
records.name: Cable Bar Skullcrusher

instructions: Face away from cable, hinge at hips, and grasp handle behind head.
Keep upper arm still and extend elbow until arm is straight.
Squeeze tricep at the top, then slowly return to starting position.
records.name: Cable Bent Over Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbow until you feel your tricep contract.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Pushdown

instructions: Stand in front of cable stack facing away to and lean torso slightly forward, holding handle overhead.
Break at the elbow until your forearm touch your bicep, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arm to the side of your head.
Bring your elbow back forward, then extend your elbows.
records.name: Cable Leaning Single Arm Skullover

instructions: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Face away and begin with your elbows bent and fists by your temples.
Extend your elbows until your triceps contract.
records.name: Band Skullcrusher

instructions: Stand with one or both feet on band. Go up and over your head with the band to the starting position.
Flex and extend your elbows.
records.name: Band Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Loop band around wrists.
Keep one hand at shoulder height and press your other hand down.
records.name: Mini Band Tricep Pushdown

instructions: Stand between the two anchored bands, grasp them with an overhand grip, and position the bands at shoulder level.
Brace your core and push the bands overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the bands back to shoulder level, keeping your core engaged and arms straight. Repeat for desired number of reps.
records.name: Band Overhead Press

instructions: Anchor the band to a high point and face away. Hold the band with both hands, placing your hands shoulder-width apart and keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms downward, keeping your elbows close to your body. Push the band down as far as you can, feeling the contraction in your triceps.
records.name: Band Rapunzel Pushdown

instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with your right hand, with your arm at your side.
Flex and extend your elbow.
records.name: Band Single Arm Pushdown

instructions: Stand with a band anchored to a high point. Face away from the band. Hold the loop in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in to your side. Extend your elbow. When you extend, don't let your upper arm raise. The band should land over your shoulder.
records.name: Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown

instructions: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Hinge forward. Extend and flex at the elbow.
records.name: Band Tricep Kickback

instructions: Stand or sit with a weight plate in your hands, arms extended straight above your head
Lower the weight plate behind your head by bending at the elbows.
Keep your elbows close to your head and shoulders relaxed.
Push the weight plate back up to starting position, extending your arms fully.
records.name: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Place a plate on your back. Position your index fingers and thumbs so they are touching, forming a diamond shape.
Use a standard push up position
Lower your chest towards your hands, keep your elbows close to your body
Stop just before your chest touches the floor, then push back up to the starting position.
records.name: Weighted Diamond Push Ups

instructions: Hold the two TRX straps and lean forward. The straps should be over each shoulder.
Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.
records.name: TRX Skullcrusher

instructions: Place two blocks on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Kneel in front of the blocks, and lower your torso down so that your elbows are resting on the blocks, and your forehead is resting on the floor.
Relax your arms, shoulders, and neck, and breathe deeply.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.
records.name: Child Pose Elbows On Block

instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your left knee and place your left foot on the floor, close to your right hip.
Cross your right leg over your left leg, stacking your knees on top of each other.
Bring your left arm up overhead, and bend your elbow so that your left hand reaches towards your upper back. Reach your right hand behind your back and try to clasp your left hand. Hold
records.name: One Arm Cow Face Pose

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a table, chair, or any elevated surface in front of you.
Walk your feet back until your torso is parallel to the ground, and your elbows are resting on the surface.
Relax your head and neck, and breathe deeply.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.
records.name: Pyramid Prayer

instructions: Take a shoulder width grip. Break at the elbows. Try to keep your elbows tucked in. Don't let them flare out.
Stop the bar a few inches from your forehead and extend your elbows back up.
records.name: Smith Machine Skullcrusher

instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
records.name: Smith Machine Close Grip Bench Press

instructions: Hold the smith bar and lean forward.
Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.
records.name: Smith Machine Bodyweight Skullcrusher

instructions: Lie prone supported, arms bent, elbows pointing forward.
Set shoulders down and back, engaging mid-back for stability.
Extend elbows fully, pressing arms long without shoulder movement.
Bend elbows to return, maintaining control and upper-back engagement.
records.name: Midback Series Triceps Press Lying

instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Start with elbows bent, upper arms close to sides.
Extend elbows fully, pressing straps back while keeping torso upright.
Bend elbows slowly to return, maintaining control and steady tension.
records.name: Back Rowing Preps Triceps Seated

instructions: Kneel tall facing straps, elbows bent, palms facing forward.
Keep elbows lifted and shoulders relaxed.
Press arms upward on a diagonal, extending elbows fully.
Bend elbows to return with control, maintaining vertical torso.
records.name: Reverse Expansion Salute Kneeling

instructions: Hold the bar over one shoulder. Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Dip at the hips and knees, generate some momentum and press the bar.
As you press, split your stance. Bring the leg of the working arm back and the other forward.
records.name: Landmine Split Jerk

instructions: Start facing the landmine on one knee with your other foot in front of you while holding the barbell in one hand at your shoulder on the same side as the knee that is on the ground.
Drive the bar upwards while keeping your elbow pointed forward until your arm holding the bar is fully extending, then control the bar as your lower it back to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch sides.
records.name: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press

instructions: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the end of the bar at your outer hip with your inner hand and your palm facing your body.
While keeping your core braced and your arm straight, lift the barbell diagonally up and towards the direction of the landmine attachment, then return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.
records.name: Landmine Lateral Raise

instructions: There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Sit tall and try not to arch your spine as you're pressing.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
records.name: Kettlebell Seated Overhead Press

instructions: Start with kettlebell in rack position.
Dip at knees and hips.
Explosively push kettlebell overhead, fully extending arms.
records.name: Kettlebell Push Press

instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Bench Press

instructions: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the bottom of the platform, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
records.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise

instructions: Start with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the platform.
Explode onto your toes and hold for a second.
records.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Jump

instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground. Place a barbell across your hips and grasp it with both hands.
Keeping your arms straight, push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground and raise the barbell.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, then slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.
records.name: Barbell Glute Bridge

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Step your left foot behind and to the right of your right foot, crossing it behind your right leg.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down and back, as if you were about to sit in a chair.
Push through your right heel to straighten your right leg and return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Stand with a dumbbell held on the side of your leg.
Raise that leg laterally as high as your hip range of motion allows for.
records.name: Dumbbell Standing Hip Abduction

instructions: Step your left foot diagonally behind your right leg, crossing it behind your body. Bend your knees and lower your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push through your right foot to straighten your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your other leg.
records.name: Curtsy Lunge

instructions: Stand tall with a medicine ball held against one hip.
Lift the leg on the opposite side laterally.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
records.name: Medicine Ball Hip Abduction

instructions: Sit on your butt with your knees bent and feet touching each other.
Grab your feet and lean forward until you feel a stretch in your groin.
records.name: Bodyweight Butterfly Stretch

instructions: Sit in the machine with your legs apart, pads against your outer thighs. Adjust the seat and pad position comfortably.
Slowly squeeze your legs together, focusing on using your inner thigh muscles. Pause when the pads are close together.
Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control. Avoid letting the weights slam. Repeat for desired reps and sets.
records.name: Machine Hip Adduction

instructions: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg inward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.
records.name: Machine Hip And Glute Adduction

instructions: Start with kettlebells between legs.
Swing kettlebells up to shoulder.
Press kettlebells overhead.
records.name: Kettlebell Clean And Press

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a kettlebell with one hand at your side.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell up and out, away from your body to around head height.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
records.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Lateral Raise

instructions: Anchor a band to a point that is the same height as your fist when your arms are at your side and stand with the band crossing your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.
records.name: Band Mid Lateral Raise

instructions: Use the bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.
records.name: Cable Bar Pushdown

instructions: Use the bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine. Grab the bar with n overhand grip.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.
records.name: Cable Bar Reverse Grip Pushdown

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to hip height.
Hinge forward. Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.
records.name: Cable Tricep Kickback

instructions: Use the rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Rope Pushdown

instructions: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Bar Curl

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Bayesian Curl

instructions: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Sit on a bench facing away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Curl

instructions: Stand facing away from the cables and grab two handle attachments.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, and extend.
records.name: Cable Hammer Bayesian Curl

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.
records.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Hammer Curl

instructions: You can use any attachment. The cable should be even with your mid-back. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight forward. Press the weight straight toward the ceiling.
As you return to the start, push your elbows forward. Try to touch your biceps to your forearms at the bottom of each rep.
records.name: Cable Overhead Tricep Press

instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to your mid-back. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension

instructions: Stand facing away from the cable, which is at the top of the cable stack.
Keep your elbow pointed forward, and extend and flex your elbow.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Skullcrusher

instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your hands planted on the ground.
Pick your knees up off the ground. Hold in this position with a flat back.
records.name: Hand Plank

instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your arms extended over head.
Pick your upper back and your legs off the ground. Your body should be in a banana shape.
Hold in this position.
records.name: Hollow Hold

instructions: To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a quick pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.
records.name: Mountain Climber

instructions: Lie on your back.
Bend knees, hands behind head.
Twist torso, touch elbow to opposite knee. Repeat.
records.name: Bicycle Crunch

instructions: Start in a hand plank position and walk your elbows further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.
records.name: Long Lever Forearm Plank

instructions: Sit in a v position.
Pull legs and torso together.
Extend back into the starting position.
records.name: Reverse Crunch

instructions: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.
records.name: Rower Knee Tuck

instructions: Sit on the machine. Adjust the back pad to where the leg pad is just above your knees.
Adjust the leg pad that goes on your lower leg until it's on your achilles.
Use the two handles to push your self back in the chair. Curl your legs as far as possible, and then extend your knees. (Do not hyperextend)
records.name: Seated Leg Curl

instructions: Sit back in the seat. Use the two handles to push yourself back into the chair.
Flex your ankles and point your toes upward.
Flex your knee bringing the pad backward, extend your knee without allowing the weight to touch back down.
records.name: Machine Seated Leg Curl

instructions: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Place knees on pad.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.
records.name: Machine Assisted Parallel Bar Dips

instructions: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables just below shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable Bench Chest Fly

instructions: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables above shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable Decline Bench Chest Fly

instructions: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable above shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Decline Bench Chest Fly

instructions: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable just below shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Bench Chest Fly

instructions: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.
records.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Fly

instructions: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and grab something for stability.
Press across the body going just short of extending your elbow.
records.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Press

instructions: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height with an internally rotated shoulder.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.
records.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly

instructions: Start with a box or bench behind you and one of your feet on the box/bench.
The balls of your feet should be planted on the box/bench.
Drive through the ball of your foot extending your knees until you're upright and standing on the box.
records.name: Bodyweight Reverse Step Up

instructions: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.
records.name: Machine Goblet Sissy Squat

instructions: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.
records.name: Machine Sissy Squat

instructions: Loop band around feet, lie flat on back.
Lift one leg upward, keeping knee straight.
Lower slowly and alternate sides under control.
records.name: Mini Band Laying Hip Flexion

instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg forward with straight knee.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
records.name: Mini Band Single Leg Raise

instructions: Loop band around feet or anchor behind you.
Lift one knee upward to hip height.
Lower slowly without leaning backward.
records.name: Mini Band Standing Hip Flexion

instructions: Anchor a band to a low point and stand with the band crossing your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.
records.name: Band Low Lateral Raise

instructions: Step on the plate, and place barbell on your back.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Try holding at the top for a few seconds then bring your toes back down to the floor.
records.name: Standing Tibialis Raise

instructions: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate, and place dumbbells on your quads.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
records.name: Dumbbell Seated Tibialis Raise

instructions: Place your heels on a step or plate, and hold dumbbells to your side.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Hold at the top for extra benefit. Slowly return to the starting position.
records.name: Dumbbell Standing Tibialis Raise

instructions: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
records.name: Seated Tibialis Raise

instructions: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell draped over your mid-foot.
Let the kettlebell pull your foot downward.
Raise your foot straight up and squeeze the front shin.
records.name: Kettlebell Tibialis Raise

instructions: Lie flat, knees bent.
Lift upper body.
Lower back down
records.name: Situp

instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set fairly low.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Incline Bench Press

instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set fairly low.
Bring the handle across your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.
records.name: Cable Single Arm Incline Bench Press

instructions: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, palm rotated inward before lifting.
Bring arm upward and across chest in an arc, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Squeeze upper chest at the top, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.
records.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly

instructions: Grab a barbell with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.
records.name: Barbell Wrist Extension

instructions: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.
records.name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Extension

instructions: Sit behind bench, drape arm over the bench.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in top of forearm.
Extend wrist upward, contracting forearm extensors fully.
records.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Extension

instructions: Grab two kettlebells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.
records.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Extension
